code.lotusscript: Option Public Option Explicit Use "SDSC_Image" Use "SDSC_Proposition" Use "SDSC_BonsTravail" Use "SI_DocumentsVentes" Use "SI_MSWord" Use "wsc_SDSC3" Use "x_GDK"

' Déclarations globales ' --------------------- Dim gns_FProp As NotesSession Dim gndb_FProp As NotesDatabase
Dim gnuiws_FProp As NotesUIWorkspace Dim gnuid_FProp As NotesUIDocument Dim gnd_FProp As NotesDocument
' Traitement des erreurs ' ---------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_FProp = "SL" Const gc_Element_FProp = "F_Prop"

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Sub FProp_acImporterContratsService
On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndb_SDScs As NotesDatabase Dim ndc_CSCo As NotesDocumentCollection Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Suivant_CSco As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSCo As NotesDocument Dim nv As NotesView Dim na As NotesAgent
Dim v_NoClientFmt As String Dim v_NoCS As String Dim a_NoCS ( ) As String Dim i As Integer
Dim v_DeviseProp As String Dim v_Maj As Boolean
' Initialisations Call FProp_Initialisations
' Valider / Sauvegarder le document On Error 4412 Goto FinSub Call gnuid_FProp.Save On Error 4412 Goto GererErreur
' La base SDC Contrats de service Set ndb_SDSCS = xGDK_xndbNDB("SDSCS")
If ndb_SDSCS Is Nothing Then
'la base SDS Contrats de service est introuvable, Opération annulée Messagebox xGDK_xMessage ("SDSCC", 6, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
Set nv = ndb_SDSCS.GetView("V_CSCo34") Call nv.Refresh
v_Maj = False
v_NoClientFmt = xVAR (gnd_FProp, "Prop_ClientNoFmt", "")
Set ndc_CSCo = nv.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_NoClientFmt, True)
If ndc_CSCo.Count <= 0 Then 'Le client & v_NoClientFmt & n'a aucun contrat de service de type « application hébergée ».", 16, "Opération annulée" Messagebox xGDK_xMessage ("SDSCC", 7, "", v_NoClientFmt), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "")
Else v_DeviseProp = xVAR(gnd_FProp, "Prop_Devise" , "")
If ndc_CSCo.Count = 1 Then
Set nd_CSCo = ndc_CSCo.GetFirstDocument
v_NoCS = xVAR(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , "")
'Comparer la devise du contrat de service avec la proposition sélectionée If xVAR(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_Devise" , "") <> v_DeviseProp Then
'L'importation ne peut s'effectuer car la devise du contrat de service & est differente de celle de la proposition sélectionée Messagebox xGDK_xMessage ("SDSCC", 4, "", v_NoCS), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SDSCC", 5, "", "") Exit Sub
End If
'Voulez-vous importer le contrat de service " & v_NoCS & " dans cette proposition? If gnuiws_FProp.Prompt(PROMPT_YESNO, xGDK_xMessage("SDSCC", 5, "", ""), xGDK_xMessage("SDSCC", 11, "", v_NoCS)) <> 1 Then 'Opération annulée" Print xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub Else
'Importation de contract de service If SDSPP_ImporterContratService(gnd_FProp, nd_CSCo) ="1" Then
Redim a_NoCS (0) As String a_NoCS (0) = v_NoCS
Print xGDK_xMessage("SDSCC", 9, "", "") v_Maj = True Else
'Opération annulée" Print xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") v_Maj = False End If
End If
Else 'Sélectionner le(s) contrat(s) de service a importer dans la proposition" Set ndc = gnuiws_FProp.PickListCollection (PICKLIST_CUSTOM,True,ndb_SDSCS.Server, ndb_SDSCS.FilePath, "V_CSCo34", xGDK_xMessage ("SDSCC", 5, "", ""), xGDK_xMessage ("SDSCC", 8, "", ""), v_NoClientFmt)
If ndc.Count > 0 Then
Redim a_NoCS (ndc.Count-1) As String i = 0
Set nd_Suivant_CSCo = ndc.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_Suivant_CSCo Is Nothing
Set nd_CSco = nd_Suivant_CSCo Set nd_Suivant_CSCo = ndc.GetNextDocument(nd_Suivant_CSCo)
v_NoCS = xVar(nd_CSco, "CSCo_NoContratFmt", "")
'Verifier la devise du contrat de service sélectioné If xVAR(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_Devise" , "") <> v_DeviseProp Then
'L'importation ne peut s'effectuer car la devise du contrat de service & est differente de celle de la proposition sélectionée Messagebox xGDK_xMessage ("SDSCC", 4, "", v_NoCS), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SDSCC", 5, "", "")
Else
'Création de documents produits liés au CS Call SDSPP_ImporterContratService(gnd_FProp, nd_CSCo) v_Maj = True
a_NoCS (i) = v_NoCS i = i+1
End If
Loop
Else
'Opération annulée" Print xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") End If End If End If
'Maj Historique If v_Maj Then
If SIHi_Ajouter(gnd_FProp, "", "Action - " + xGDK_xMessage ("SDSCC", 5, "", "") + Chr(13) + Implode(a_NoCS, ", ") , gns_FProp.Username, True) Then
'Rouvrir le document gnd_FProp.SaveOptions = "0"
'Forcer read mode pour contourner le problème de conflit causé par les doc locké gnuid_FProp.EditMode = False Call gnuid_FProp.Close
' Rouvrir le document en édition Set na = gndb_FProp.GetAgent("A_Edit") Call na.Run(gnd_FProp.NoteId) End If
End If
FinSub: Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FProp, gc_Element_FProp, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Sub FProp_acChangerDirecteur(p_TypePersonne As String) ' -------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de changer le Directeur de la proposition. ' -------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_Prof As NotesDocument Dim nd_Rep As NotesDocument Dim nuid As NotesUIDocument Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection
' Initialisations Call FProp_Initialisations Call xSIRR_Initialisations
' Effectuer les validations du masque de la proposition On Error 4412 GoTo FinSub Call gnuid_FProp.Refresh On Error 4412 GoTo GererErreur Set nd_Prof = gndb_FProp.GetProfileDocument("F_Prof")
' Demander le nouveau directeur Set ndc = gnuiws_FProp.PickListCollection(PICKLIST_CUSTOM, False, gndb_xSIRR.Server, gndb_xSIRR.Filepath, "V_Repr18", _ "Account Director Selection", "Select the account director of the proposal.", "60") If ndc.Count > 0 Then Set nd_Rep = ndc.GetFirstDocument
' Mettre à jour la proposition If SDSPP_ChangerDirecteur(gnd_FProp, p_TypePersonne, nd_Rep) Then gnd_FProp.SaveOptions = "0" Call gnuid_FProp.Close
' Rouvrir le document en édition Set nuid = gnuiws_FProp.EditDocument(True, gnd_FProp) Delete gnuid_FProp Set gnuid_FProp = nuid Set gnd_FProp = gnuid_FProp.Document Call gnd_FProp.RemoveItem("SaveOptions") Else Call gnuid_FProp.Refresh Print "Opération annulée" End If End If
FinSub: Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FProp, gc_Element_FProp, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Sub FProp_Initialisations If gns_FProp Is Nothing Then Set gns_FProp = New NotesSession Set gndb_FProp = gns_FProp.CurrentDatabase
Set gnuiws_FProp = New NotesUIWorkspace Set gnuid_FProp = gnuiws_FProp.CurrentDocument Set gnd_FProp = gnuid_FProp.Document End If End Sub

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Sub FProp_acAjouterPaiement On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Paie As NotesDocument
Dim v_docValide As Boolean
Call FProp_Initialisations
v_docValide = True
Set nd = gnuiws_FProp.CurrentDocument.Document Set nd_Paie = New NotesDocument(gndb_FProp) nd_Paie.Form = "F_Paie" nd_Paie.Prop_CommissionsRepresentant = xVar(nd, "Prop_CommissionsRepresentant", "") nd_Paie.Prop_CommissionsDirecteur = xVar(nd, "Prop_CommissionsDirecteur", "") nd_Paie.Prop_CommissionsDirNational = xVar(nd, "Prop_CommissionsDirNational", "") nd_Paie.Prop_CommissionsDirMondial = xVar(nd, "Prop_CommissionsDirMondial", "") nd_Paie.Prop_DeviseRepresentant = xVar(nd, "Prop_DeviseRepresentant", "") nd_Paie.Prop_DeviseDirecteur = xVar(nd, "Prop_DeviseDirecteur", "") nd_Paie.Prop_DeviseDirNational = xVar(nd, "Prop_DeviseDirNational", "") nd_Paie.Prop_DeviseDirMondial = xVar(nd, "Prop_DeviseDirMondial", "") nd_Paie.Prop_NoRepresentant = xVar(nd, "Prop_NoRepresentant", "") nd_Paie.Cle = xVar(nd, "Cle", "") nd_Paie.Prop_NoProposition = xVar(nd, "Prop_NoProposition", "") nd_Paie.Prop_Type = xVar(nd, "Prop_Type", "")
' === Validations If Not gnuiws_FProp.DialogBox("DB_Paie", True, True, False, False, False, False, "Effectuer un paiement", nd_Paie, True, False, False) Then v_docValide = False Call gnuiws_FProp.ViewRefresh End If
If xVar(nd_Paie, "Paie_Date", "") = "" And v_docValide Then Msgbox "La date est obligatoire." & Chr(10) & Chr(10) & "Sauvegarde annulée." , 48, "Erreur champ 'Date' manquante" v_docValide = False End If
If xVar(nd_Paie, "Paie_Destinataire", "") = "" And v_docValide Then Msgbox "Le destinataire est obligatoire." & Chr(10) & Chr(10) & "Sauvegarde annulée.", 48, "Erreur champ 'Destinataire' manquant" v_docValide = False End If
If xVar(nd_Paie, "Paie_Montant", "") = "" And v_docValide Then Msgbox "Le montant est obligatoire." & Chr(10) & Chr(10) & "Sauvegarde annulée.", 48, "Erreur champ 'Montant' manquant" v_docValide = False End If
If v_docValide Then nd_Paie.Paie_Montant = Round(xVar(nd_Paie, "Paie_Montant", 0),2)
Call nd_Paie.Save(True, False)
If gnuiws_FProp.CurrentDocument.Editmode Then Call gnuiws_FProp.CurrentDocument.Refresh(False) End If End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FProp, gc_Element_FProp, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Sub FProp_acRefuser ' -------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet au directeur d'accepter la proposition. ' -------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nuid As NotesUIDocument
' Initialisations Call FProp_Initialisations
If gnuid_FProp.EditMode Then ' Effectuer les validations du masque de la proposition On Error 4412 Goto FinSub Call gnuid_FProp.Save On Error 4412 Goto GererErreur End If
' Refuser la proposition If SDSPP_AssignerStatut(gnd_FProp, "12", True, "", "") Then gnd_FProp.SaveOptions = "0" Call gnuid_FProp.Close End If
FinSub: Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FProp, gc_Element_FProp, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Sub Fprop_AjouterDestinataires (p_type As String, p_No As String, p_To As Variant, p_CC As Variant)
' -------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet construire les champs DestinatiresA et FacturationCC. ' -------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_DestinatairesA As Variant Dim v_DestinatairesCC As Variant
If p_type = "Equipe" Then v_DestinatairesA = xSIRR_xVarEqui(p_No, "Equi_DestFacturation", "", True) v_DestinatairesCC = xSIRR_xVarEqui(p_No, "Equi_CCFacturation", "", True) Else
v_DestinatairesA = xSIRR_xVarRepr(p_No, "Repr_DestFacturation", "", True) v_DestinatairesCC = xSIRR_xVarRepr(p_No, "Repr_CCFacturation", "", True)
End If
'Maj To If Not IsArray(v_DestinatairesA) Then v_DestinatairesA = Evaluate(|"| & v_DestinatairesA & |"|) End If
If v_DestinatairesA(0) <> "" Then p_to = ArrayAppend (p_To, v_DestinatairesA) End If
'Maj CC If Not IsArray(v_DestinatairesCC) Then v_DestinatairesCC = Evaluate(|"| & v_DestinatairesCC & |"|) End If
If v_DestinatairesCC(0) <> "" Then p_CC = ArrayAppend (p_CC, v_DestinatairesCC) End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FProp, gc_Element_FProp, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub
End Sub

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Sub FProp_acChangerRepresentant ' -------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de changer le représentant de la proposition. ' -------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_Prof As NotesDocument Dim nd_Rep As NotesDocument Dim nuid As NotesUIDocument Dim ndc As notesdocumentcollection
' Initialisations Call FProp_Initialisations Call xSIRR_Initialisations
' Effectuer les validations du masque de la proposition On Error 4412 Goto FinSub Call gnuid_FProp.Refresh On Error 4412 Goto GererErreur Set nd_Prof = gndb_FProp.GetProfileDocument("F_Prof")
' Demander le nouveau représentant Set ndc = gnuiws_FProp.PickListCollection(PICKLIST_CUSTOM, False, gndb_xSIRR.Server, gndb_xSIRR.Filepath, "V_Repr16", _ "Sales Rep. Selection", "Select the sales rep. of the proposal.", "1") If ndc.Count > 0 Then Set nd_Rep = ndc.GetFirstDocument
' Mettre à jour la proposition If SDSPP_ChangerRepresentant (gnd_FProp, nd_Rep) Then gnd_FProp.SaveOptions = "0" Call gnuid_FProp.Close
' Rouvrir le document en édition Set nuid = gnuiws_FProp.EditDocument(True, gnd_FProp) Delete gnuid_FProp Set gnuid_FProp = nuid Set gnd_FProp = gnuid_FProp.Document Call gnd_FProp.RemoveItem("SaveOptions") Else Call gnuid_FProp.Refresh Print "Opération annulée" End If End If
FinSub: Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FProp, gc_Element_FProp, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Sub FProp_acImporterFactures On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_DB As NotesDocument Dim a_NoFacture As Variant Dim a_NoFactureDevise As Variant Dim vwsc_SDSC3 As New Cl_SDSCommissionsIII Dim v_Resultats As String Dim a_Resultats As Variant
Dim i As Integer Dim j As Integer Dim k As Integer Dim v_MSG As String
' Initialisations Call FProp_Initialisations
' Valider / Sauvegarder le document On Error 4412 Goto FinSub Call gnuid_FProp.Save On Error 4412 Goto GererErreur
' Demander les numéros de facture à importer Set nd_DB = New NotesDocument(gndb_FProp) If gnuiws_FProp.DialogBox("DB_Fact", True, True, False, False, False, False, "Importation de factures", _ nd_DB, True, False, False) Then j = 0 k = 0 a_NoFacture = xVarArray(nd_DB, "DB_NoFacture")
v_Resultats = vwsc_SDSC3.ImporterFactures(xVar(gnd_FProp, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), Implode(a_NoFacture, ";")) a_Resultats = Split(v_Resultats, ";")
Redim a_ErrNoFactureDevise(Ubound(a_NoFacture)) As String Redim a_ErrNoFacture(Ubound(a_NoFacture)) As String
For i = Lbound(a_Resultats) To Ubound(a_Resultats) Select Case a_Resultats(i) Case "0" ' pas d'erreur
Case "1" ' Erreur devise a_ErrNoFactureDevise(j) = a_NoFacture(i) j = j + 1 Case Else ' Erreur générale (2) a_ErrNoFacture(k) = a_NoFacture(i) k = k + 1 End Select Next
If j > 0 Then Redim Preserve a_ErrNoFactureDevise(j - 1) As String ' La facture 99999 n'a pas été importée car sa devise est différente de celle de la proposition. v_MSG = xGDK_xMessage("SDSCC", 0, "", Implode(a_ErrNoFactureDevise, ", ")) End If If k > 0 Then Redim Preserve a_ErrNoFacture(k - 1) As String If v_MSG = "" Then ' Les factures suivantes n'ont pas été importées : " & Implode(a_NoFacture, ", ") v_MSG = xGDK_xMessage("SDSCC", 2, "", Implode(a_ErrNoFacture, ", ")) Else ' "Les factures suivantes n'ont pas été importées : " & Implode(a_NoFacture, ", "), "Importation de factures" v_MSG = v_MSG & Chr(10) & Chr(10) & xGDK_xMessage("SDSCC", 2, "", Implode(a_ErrNoFacture, ", ")) End If End If
' Rafraichir le document On Error 4412 Goto FinSub Call gnuid_FProp.Save On Error 4412 Goto GererErreur
' Afficher le message d'erreur If v_MSG <> "" Then Messagebox v_MSG, 48, xGDK_xMessage("SDSCC", 1, "", "") End If
Call gnuid_FProp.Refresh End If
FinSub: Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FProp, gc_Element_FProp, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Sub FProp_acImprimer(p_Destinataire As String, p_Action As String, p_CheminPDF As String) '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet d'imprimer les commissions de la proposition (avec succursales et produits). ' ' Paramètres: ' p_Destinataire : "D" = Directeur, "R" = Représentant ' p_Action : "P" = Imprimer, "E" = Exporter dans un document PDF '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_Temp As NotesDocument Dim v_Langue As String Dim v_CheminAccesTemp As String Dim v_NomFichier As String Dim v_CheminRTF As String Dim v_CheminPDF As String
' Initialisations Call FProp_Initialisations
' Effectuer les validations du masque de la proposition If gnuid_FProp.EditMode Then On Error 4412 Goto FinSub Call gnuid_FProp.Save On Error 4412 Goto GererErreur End If
' Définir la langue d'impression If p_Destinataire = "D" Then v_Langue = "FR" ' Directeur toujours en français Else v_Langue = xSIRR_xVarRepr(Cstr(xVar(gnd_FProp, "Prop_NoRepresentant", "")), "Repr_Langue", "FR", True) End If
' Copier la proposition dans un document temporaire Set nd_Temp = gnd_FProp.CopyToDatabase(gndb_FProp) nd_Temp.Form = "F_Prop3" nd_Temp.Form_Destinataire = p_Destinataire nd_Temp.Form_Action = p_Action nd_Temp.Form_Langue = v_Langue
' DocumentUniqueID de la proposition nd_Temp.Prop_Unid = Cstr(gnd_FProp.UniversalId)
' Ajouter l'image de la succursale à la proposition Call SDSCIm_GenererSuccursales(nd_Temp)
If p_Action = "E" Then v_CheminAccesTemp = Environ("Temp") & "\SDSC3" On Error 75 Resume Next Mkdir v_CheminAccesTemp v_CheminAccesTemp = v_CheminAccesTemp & "\" v_NomFichier = Strleft(xVar(gnd_FProp, "Prop_NbPropositionTXT", ""), ".") & "_" & xUnique("") v_CheminRTF = v_CheminAccesTemp & v_NomFichier & ".rtf" v_CheminPDF = v_CheminAccesTemp & v_NomFichier & ".pdf"
nd_Temp.Form_CheminRTF = v_CheminRTF End If
Call nd_Temp.Save(True, False)
' Pour tester - Ouvre le document TEMP ******************************** DEBUG ********************************** ' nd_Temp.Form_Debug = "1"
' Imprimer la propositions Call gnuiws_FProp.EditDocument(False, nd_Temp)
If p_Action = "E" Then If SIMW_DemarrerWord(False) Then If SIMW_OuvrirDocument(v_CheminRTF) Then If SIMW_EnregistrerDocumentPDF(False, v_CheminPDF) Then p_CheminPDF = v_CheminPDF End If
Call SIMW_FermerDocument End If
Call SIMW_FermerWord End If Kill v_CheminRTF End If
' Mettre le document temporaire dans la corbeille Call SIDS_CorbeilleDocument(nd_Temp, "", "")
FinSub: Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FProp, gc_Element_FProp, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Sub FProp_acVerifierProduits '-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Ce script compare, pour chaque produit de la proposition, la commission avec SDS Base II. ' La commission du produit est mise à jour si différente. '-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Maj As Boolean
Call FProp_Initialisations
v_Maj = SDSPP_VerifierProduits(gnd_FProp, "Equi") v_Maj = SDSPP_VerifierProduits(gnd_FProp, "Logi") Or v_Maj v_Maj = SDSPP_VerifierProduits(gnd_FProp, "Serv") Or v_Maj
If v_Maj Then Call gnuid_FProp.Refresh End If
Print "Vérification des produits disponibles terminée"
FinSub: Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FProp, gc_Element_FProp, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Sub FProp_acImprimerPDF (p_Destinataire As String) ' ----------------------------- ' Le script permet d'imprimer et envoyer un courriel a Représentant/Directeur. ' ----------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_SICT As NotesDocument Dim ndb_SITmp As NotesDatabase Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_DB As NotesDocument Dim nd_temp As NotesDocument
Dim nrtitem As NotesRichTextItem Dim nrt_body As NotesRichTextItem
Dim neo As NotesEmbeddedObject Dim na As NotesAgent
Dim v_docValide As Boolean Dim v_CheminPDF As String Dim v_NoRepresentant As String Dim v_Langue As String Dim v_Message As String Dim v_Etapefmt As String Dim v_Etape As String Dim v_NoEquipe As String Dim v_EquipeTypeMembres As String Dim v_NoMessage As integer
Dim v_To As Variant Dim v_CC As Variant Dim v_etapeDesc As String
Call FProp_Initialisations Call xSDSBB_Initialisations
v_docValide = True
Set nd = gnuiws_FProp.CurrentDocument.Document Set nd_DB = New NotesDocument(gndb_FProp)
Set ndb_SITmp = xGDK_xndbNDB("SITp") Set nd_temp = New NotesDocument(ndb_SITmp)
nd_DB.Destinataire = p_Destinataire nd_DB.Cle = xVar(nd, "Cle", "") nd_DB.Prop_NoProposition = xVar(nd, "Prop_NoProposition", "") nd_DB.Prop_Type = xVar(nd, "Prop_Type", "")
' ----- Validations If Not gnuiws_FProp.DialogBox("DB_Mesg", True, True, False, False, False, False, "Message courriel", nd_DB, True, False, False) Then v_docValide = False Call gnuiws_FProp.ViewRefresh Exit Sub End If
v_Message = xVar(nd_DB, "DB_Message", "") v_Etape = xVar(nd_DB, "Mesg_Etape", "")
'---------- Definir la langue If p_Destinataire = "D" Then v_Langue = "FR" ' Directeur toujours en français 'v_To = xVarProf("Prof_DirecteurDestinataire", "") v_To = xVar(nd, "Prop_IdDirecteur", "") 'Req# 42249 v_etapeDesc = "Reste à payer" v_NoMessage = 13 'Employé de SERTI
Else v_NoRepresentant = CStr(xVar2(gnd_FProp, "Repr_NotesID", "Prop_NoRepresentant", "")) v_Langue = xSIRR_xVarRepr(v_NoRepresentant, "Repr_Langue", "FR", True) If v_Langue = "EN" Then v_etapeDesc = "Balance Due" Else v_etapeDesc = "Reste à payer" End If
'Verifier si le Repr est un employé de Serti ou fait parti d'une Equipe de Serti
v_NoEquipe = xSIRR_xVarRepr(v_NoRepresentant, "Repr_NoEquipe", "", True) v_EquipeTypeMembres = xSIRR_xVarEqui(v_NoEquipe, "Equi_TypeMembres", "", True)
If v_NoEquipe = "" Or (v_NoEquipe <> "" And v_EquipeTypeMembres = "1") Then
v_NoMessage = 13 'Employé de SERTI Else v_NoMessage = 12
End If
End If
Set nrtitem = New NotesRichTextItem (nd_temp, "MessageDescription")
If v_Etape = "R" Then v_etapefmt = xGDK_xMessage ("SDSCC", v_NoMessage, v_Langue, "") & " " & v_etapeDesc
Else v_etapefmt = xGDK_xMessage ("SDSCC", v_NoMessage, v_Langue, "") & " " & xSDSBB_xDescTabl(v_Etape, "Comm_Paiements" & v_Langue , False) '---message sur GDK
End If
Call nrtitem.AppendText (v_etapefmt) Call nrtitem.AddNewLine( 2 )
If Not (v_Message = "") Then Call nrtitem.AppendText (v_Message) Call nrtitem.AddNewLine( 2 ) End If
Call nd_temp.save(True, False)
' ------------------------------------------------ ' Exporter les commissions dans un fichier PDF ' ------------------------------------------------ Call FProp_acImprimer(p_Destinataire, "E", v_CheminPDF) If v_CheminPDF = "" Then Exit Sub End If
' Définir la langue d'impression If p_Destinataire = "R" Then
v_To = Evaluate(|"| & xSIRR_xVarRepr(v_NoRepresentant, "Repr_NotesId", "", True) & |"|)
'Noms CC existants dans Courriel Type v_CC = xVarSICT("EnvoyerCommPDF", "SICT_CC", "", True)
If Not IsArray(v_CC) Then v_CC = Evaluate(|"| & v_CC & |"|) End If
v_NoEquipe = xSIRR_xVarRepr(v_NoRepresentant, "Repr_NoEquipe", "", True)
If v_NoEquipe = "" Then
Call FProp_AjouterDestinataires ("Representant", v_NoRepresentant, v_To, v_CC)
Else Call FProp_AjouterDestinataires ("Equipe", v_NoEquipe, v_To, v_CC)
End If
End If
' ------------------------------ ' Envoyer le PDF au représentant/directeur ' ------------------------------
Set nd_SICT = SICT_ConstruireMessage(gnd_FProp, "EnvoyerCommPDF", v_Langue, v_To, v_CC, "", False, "") If nd_SICT Is Nothing Then ' Courriel type non sélectionné ou Erreur sur le courriel type. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage ("SI", 231, "", ""), 48, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
Set nrt_body = nd_SICT.GetFirstItem( "Body" )
Call nrtitem.AppendRTItem(nrt_body) Call nd_SICT.RemoveItem("Body") Call nrtitem.CopyItemToDocument(nd_SICT, "Body" )
Set nrt_body = nd_SICT.GetFirstItem( "Body" ) Call nrt_body.AddNewLine( 2 ) Set neo = nrt_body.embedobject(EMBED_ATTACHMENT, "", v_CheminPDF)
Call nd_SICT.Send(False)
' ------------------------------------------------ ' Supprimer les fichiers local + autres nettoyages ' ------------------------------------------------ Kill v_CheminPDF
' -------------- ' MAJ historique ' -------------- If p_Destinataire = "D" Then Call SIHi_Ajouter(gnd_FProp, "", "Action : Envoyer au directeur", gns_FProp.Commonusername, False) Else Call SIHi_Ajouter(gnd_FProp, "", "Action : Envoyer au représentant", gns_FProp.Commonusername, False) End If
' Permettre à l'utilisateur de changer le statut de la proposition If Not FProp_acChangerStatut(False) Then ' Sauvegarder le document Call SIHi_BatirHistorique(gnd_FProp) Else Call gnd_FProp.save(True, False) End If
' Réouvrir le document gnd_FProp.SaveOptions = "0" 'Forcer read mode pour contourner problème de conflit causé par les doc locké gnuid_FProp.EditMode = False
Call gnuid_FProp.Close
Set na = gndb_FProp.GetAgent("A_Edit") Call na.Run(gnd_FProp.NoteId)
FinSub: Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FProp, gc_Element_FProp, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Function FProp_acChangerStatut(p_FermerDocument As Boolean) As Boolean ' ------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet demander le statut à changer pour la proposition. ' ------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim p_Statut As String Dim nd_Box As NotesDocument Dim nd_DB As NotesDocument Dim v_CleTable As String Dim v_Message As String Dim v_Statut As String Dim p_Commentaire As String Dim a_NoBonsCommandeEnCours As Variant
FProp_acChangerStatut = False
' Initialisations Call FProp_Initialisations
' Effectuer les validations du masque de la proposition If gnuid_FProp.EditMode Then On Error 4412 Goto FinSub Call gnuid_FProp.Save On Error 4412 Goto GererErreur End If
' Demander le statut désiré Set nd_Box = New NotesDocument(gndb_FProp) v_CleTable = "StatProp_" nd_Box.DB_TableStatuts = v_CleTable & xLangue() nd_Box.DB_StatutActuel = xVar(gnd_FProp,"Prop_Statut","") v_Message = xGDK_xMessage("SI", 97, xLangue, "")
If gnuiws_FProp.DialogBox("DB_Stat", True,True,False,False,False,False,_ v_Message, nd_Box,True,False,True) = False Then Exit Function End If
p_Statut = xVar(nd_Box,"DB_Statut","") p_Commentaire = xVar(nd_Box, "DB_Commentaire", "") If Len(p_Statut) = 0 Then Exit Function End If
'Validation 'Si 90-Commissioné ou 92-Completé sans commission If p_Statut = "90" Or p_Statut = "92" Then If Not SDSBT_BonsTravailFacture(gnd_FProp, a_NoBonsCommandeEnCours) Then If IsArray(a_NoBonsCommandeEnCours) Then
Set nd_DB = New NotesDocument(gndb_FProp) nd_DB.DB_Message = xGDK_xMessage ("SDSCC", 14, "", xDescTabl(p_Statut, "StatProp_" & xLangue, True)) nd_DB.DB_BonsTravail = a_NoBonsCommandeEnCours Call gnuiws_FProp.Dialogbox("DB_LBT", True, True, True, False, False, False, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", ""), nd_DB, True, False, False)
Exit Function End if End if End if
'Assigner le statut et sauvegarder If SDSPP_ChangerStatutProposition(gnd_FProp,p_Statut,p_Commentaire, "") Then If p_FermerDocument Then gnd_FProp.SaveOptions = "0" Call gnuid_FProp.Close End If FProp_acChangerStatut = True End If
FinSub: Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FProp, gc_Element_FProp, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Sub FProp_acAccepter ' -------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet au directeur d'accepter la proposition. ' -------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nuid As NotesUIDocument Dim v_StatutActuel As String Dim v_Statut As String
' Initialisations Call FProp_Initialisations
If gnuid_FProp.EditMode Then ' Effectuer les validations du masque de la proposition On Error 4412 Goto FinSub Call gnuid_FProp.Save On Error 4412 Goto GererErreur End If
'Req# 49322
v_StatutActuel = xVar(gnd_FProp,"Prop_Statut","")
Select Case v_StatutActuel Case "25" : 'Accepter signature v_Statut = "30" Case "55" : 'Accepter installation v_Statut = "60"
Case Else : Call SIGE_TraiterErreurManuelle(gc_TypeElement_FProp, gc_Element_FProp, GetThreadInfo(1), LSI_Info(1), _ "Proposition : Statut " & v_Statut & " non supporté.", "", False) Exit Sub End Select
' Accepter la proposition 'If SDSPP_AssignerStatut(gnd_FProp, "45", True, "") Then If SDSPP_AssignerStatut(gnd_FProp, v_Statut, True, "", "") Then gnd_FProp.SaveOptions = "0" Call gnuid_FProp.Close End If
FinSub: Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FProp, gc_Element_FProp, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
