code.lotusscript: Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_Insertions" Use "SI_WsDisgen" Use "x_SDSI" Use "x_SIRR"

' Déclarations globales ' --------------------- Dim gns_SFProp As NotesSession Dim gndb_SFProp As NotesDatabase
Dim gnuiws_SFProp As NotesUIWorkspace Dim gnuid_SFProp As NotesUIDocument Dim gnd_SFProp As NotesDocument
Dim gnv_Inst21_SFProp As NotesView Dim g_DateSignature_SFProp As Variant Dim g_DateInstallation_SFProp As Variant Dim g_DeviseProposition_SFProp As String
' Traitement des erreurs ' ---------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SFProp = "SL" Const gc_Element_SFProp = "SF_Prop"

Function SFProp_RecalcTauxChange As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Date As Variant
SFProp_RecalcTauxChange = False
'Taux Change Signature v_Date = xVar(gnd_SFProp, "Prop_DateSignature", "") If v_Date <> g_DateSignature_SFProp Then Call SFProp_TrouverTauxChange("Prop_DateSignature", "Prop_TauxChangeSignature") g_DateSignature_SFProp = v_Date SFProp_RecalcTauxChange = True End If
'Taux Change Installation v_Date = xVar(gnd_SFProp, "Prop_DateInstallation", "") If v_Date <> g_DateInstallation_SFProp Then Call SFProp_TrouverTauxChange("Prop_DateInstallation", "Prop_TauxChangeInstallation") g_DateInstallation_SFProp = v_Date SFProp_RecalcTauxChange = True End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIWsD, gc_Element_SIWsD, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SFProp_Initialisations(pnuid As NotesUIDocument) If gns_SFProp Is Nothing Then Set gns_SFProp = New NotesSession Set gndb_SFProp = gns_SFProp.CurrentDatabase
Set gnuiws_SFProp = New NotesUIWorkspace Set gnuid_SFProp = pnuid Set gnd_SFProp = pnuid.Document
g_DeviseProposition_SFProp = xVar(gnd_SFProp, "Prop_Devise", "CAD") End If End Sub

Sub SFProp_PostModeChange(pnuid_Source As NotesUIDocument) On Error Goto GererErreur
If pnuid_Source.EditMode Then ' Initialisations Call SFProp_Initialisations(pnuid_Source)
On Error 4412 Resume Next Call pnuid_Source.Refresh End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SFProp, gc_Element_SFProp, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub SFProp_Queryrecalc(Source As NotesUIDocument, Continue As Variant) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String Dim v_TypeProposition As String Dim nd_Inst As NotesDocument Dim v_Date As Variant Dim a1 As Variant Dim a2 As Variant Dim v_DeviseRepresentant As String
' Maj la date d'installation v_ClientNoFmt = xVar(gnd_SFProp, "Prop_ClientNoFmt", "") If v_ClientNoFmt <> "" Then v_TypeProposition = xVar(gnd_SFProp, "Prop_Type", "") If v_TypeProposition = "0" Or v_TypeProposition = "1" Then If gnv_Inst21_SFProp Is Nothing Then Call xSDSI_Initialisation Call xnv(gndb_xSDSI, "V_Inst21", gnv_Inst21_SFProp) End If
a1 = Evaluate(|"0" : "1"|) a2 = Evaluate(|"I" : "N"|) Set nd_Inst = gnv_Inst21_SFProp.GetDocumentByKey(v_ClientNoFmt & ";" & Replace(v_TypeProposition, a1, a2), True) If Not (nd_Inst Is Nothing) Then v_Date = xVar(nd_Inst, "Inst_DateInstallation", "") If v_Date <> "" Then Call SIIx_MajItem(gnd_SFProp, "Prop_DateInstallation", v_Date, True) End If End If End If End If
' Mettre à jour les taux de change v_DeviseRepresentant = xSIRR_xVarRepr(xVar(gnd_SFProp, "Prop_NoRepresentant", ""), "Repr_DeviseCommissions", g_DeviseProposition_SFProp, True) If g_DeviseProposition_SFProp <> "CAD" Or v_DeviseRepresentant <> g_DeviseProposition_SFProp Or v_DeviseRepresentant <> xVar(gnd_SFProp, "Prop_DeviseRepresentant", "") Then gnd_SFProp.Prop_DeviseRepresentant = v_DeviseRepresentant Call SFProp_RecalcTauxChange End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SFProp, gc_Element_SFProp, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub SFProp_TrouverTauxChange(p_NomItemDate As String, p_NomItemTaux As String) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_TauxChange As Double Dim v_Date As Variant
v_Date = xVar(gnd_SFProp, p_NomItemDate, "") If v_Date = "" Then Call gnd_SFProp.Replaceitemvalue(p_NomItemTaux, "") Elseif Isdate(v_Date) Then v_TauxChange = SIWsD_TrouverTauxChange(v_Date, "USD") If v_TauxChange < 0 Then Messagebox "Une erreur est survenue lors de l'obtention du taux de change. (" & Cstr(v_TauxChange) & ")", 16 Else Call gnd_SFProp.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItemTaux, v_TauxChange) End If Else Messagebox "Le champ " & p_NomItemDate & " contient une date invalide.", 16 End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIWsD, gc_Element_SIWsD, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub SFProp_PostOpen(pnuid_Source As NotesUIDocument) On Error Goto GererErreur
If pnuid_Source.EditMode Then ' Initialisations Call SFProp_Initialisations(pnuid_Source)
On Error 4412 Resume Next Call pnuid_Source.Refresh End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SFProp, gc_Element_SFProp, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Option Public Option Declare
Use "SI_Insertions" Use "SI_DatabaseScript" Use "x_SIDoc" Use "x_Tabl" Use "x_SICl"

Dim gns_SIDoc As NotesSession Dim gndb_SIDoc As NotesDatabase
Dim g_Archivage_SIDoc As String Dim g_DossierBranche_SIDoc As Boolean Dim g_AccesDocuments_SIDoc As String
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SIDoc = "SL" Const gc_Element_SIDoc = "CPA_Documents"
' Debug Const gc_Debug_SDSCMD = True

Sub SIDoc_Initialisations If gns_SIDoc Is Nothing Then Set gns_SIDoc = New NotesSession Set gndb_SIDoc = gns_SIDoc.CurrentDatabase
g_Archivage_SIDoc = xVarProf("Prof_Archivage", "") If gns_SIDoc.IsOnServer Then g_AccesDocuments_SIDoc = xVarProf("Prof_ServeurArchivage", "") g_DossierBranche_SIDoc = False Else g_AccesDocuments_SIDoc = xVarProf("Prof_AccesDocuments", "") End If If Right(g_AccesDocuments_SIDoc, 1) = "\" Then g_AccesDocuments_SIDoc = Left(g_AccesDocuments_SIDoc, Len(g_AccesDocuments_SIDoc) - 1) End If
If xSIDoc_Initialisations = False Then Messagebox "La base de documents « SI Documents » n'est pas disponible.", 16, "Opération annulée" End End If End If End Sub

Function SIDoc_SupprimerDocument(pnd As NotesDocument) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur On Error 75 Resume Next ' *** À VALIDER: PAS TESTÉ ' *************************** SIDoc_SupprimerDocument = False
' Supprimer le document (Domino) Call SIDS_CorbeilleDocument(pnd,"", "")
SIDoc_SupprimerDocument = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDoc, gc_Element_SIDoc, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIDoc_ArchiverDocument(p_CheminAcces As String, p_NoDocument As String) As String ' *** À VALIDER: PAS TESTÉ ' *************************** On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_CheminAcces As String Dim v_Lien As String
Call SIDoc_Initialisations
%REM If gns_CPAD.IsOnServer Then If g_DossierBranche_CPAD = False Then If CPADR_BrancherDossierArchivage(g_AccesDocuments_CPAD) = False Then Exit Function End If g_DossierBranche_CPAD = True End If End If %END REM
If Left(g_AccesDocuments_SIDoc, 1) = "\" Then v_Lien = g_AccesDocuments_SIDoc & p_NoDocument Else v_Lien = g_AccesDocuments_SIDoc & "\" & p_NoDocument End If
' Archiver le document On Error 53 Goto FinSub On Error 70 Goto FinSub Filecopy p_CheminAcces, v_Lien SIDoc_ArchiverDocument = v_Lien FinSub: Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDoc, gc_Element_SIDoc, GetThreadInfo(1), p_CheminAcces & " --> " & v_Lien, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIDoc_CreerDocument(p_Origine As String, p_CleParent As String, p_DescParent As String, _ p_TypeDocument As String, p_TypeTable As String, ByVal p_ClientNoFmt As String, p_Disponible As String, _ p_Format As String, p_CheminAcces As String, p_Description As String, p_datDate As Variant) As Notesdocument '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de créer un nouveau document. ' p_Disponible : Applications utilisées ' p_Format : 0 = Lien, 1 = Document, 2 = URL, 3- Non défini, 4=Réseau '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_Clie As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd2 As NotesDocument Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem Dim nd_TDoc As NotesDocument Dim ni As NotesItem Dim nd_gdk As NotesDocument Dim ni_lecteursAdmin As NotesItem Dim ni_auteurs As NotesItem
Dim v_ErreurArchivage As Boolean Dim v_Lien As String Dim v_NoDocument As String Dim v_TypeDocumentDispo As Variant
Set SIDoc_CreerDocument = Nothing Call SIDoc_Initialisations v_ErreurArchivage = False
' Initialisations Set nd = New Notesdocument(gndb_xSIDoc) nd.Form = "F_Docu"
' Champs de la section parent nd.Docu_OrigineParent = p_Origine nd.Docu_CleParent = p_CleParent nd.Docu_DescParent = p_DescParent
' Champs de la section client If Len(p_ClientNoFmt) > 0 Then nd.Docu_ClientNoFmt = p_ClientNoFmt nd.Docu_ClientNom1 = xSICl_xVarClie(p_ClientNoFmt, "Clie_ClientNom1", "", true) nd.Docu_ClientNom2 = xSICl_xVarClie(p_ClientNoFmt, "Clie_ClientNom2", "", true) End If
' Champs de la section Documents Set nd_gdk = xGDK_xndNDB(p_Origine, true) nd.Docu_TypeDocument = xVar(nd_gdk, "NDB_Categorie","")
nd.Docu_TypeDocumentDesc = xDescTabl(p_TypeDocument, p_TypeTable, True) nd.Docu_FormatDesc = xDescTabl(p_Format, p_TypeTable, True)
If IsDate(p_datDate) Then Call SIIx_AssignerDate(nd, "Docu_Date" , p_datDate) Else p_datDate = CDat(p_datDate) If IsDate(p_datDate) Then Call SIIx_AssignerDate(nd, "Docu_Date" , p_datDate) Else Call SIIx_AssignerDate(nd, "Docu_Date" , Today) End If End If
' v_TypeDocumentDispo = xVar(nd_TDoc, "TDoc_Disponible", "") Set ni = xni(nd, "Docu_TypeDocumentDispo", "") ni.Values = v_TypeDocumentDispo
If p_Disponible <> "" And Not ni.Contains(p_Disponible) Then If ni.Values(0) = "" Then ni.Values = p_Disponible Else Call ni.AppendToTextList(p_Disponible) End If End If
If p_Format = "1" Or p_Format = "4" Then ' Attacher le document v_Lien = ""
If g_Archivage_SIDoc = "1" Then Do v_NoDocument = xUnique("") Set nd2 = xSIDoc_xndDocu(v_NoDocument, False) Loop Until nd2 Is Nothing v_Lien = SIDoc_ArchiverDocument(p_CheminAcces, v_NoDocument) If v_Lien <> "" Then p_Format = "4" Else v_ErreurArchivage = True End If End If
If v_Lien = "" Then Set nrti = New NotesRichTextItem(nd, "Docu_Document") Call nrti.EmbedObject(EMBED_ATTACHMENT, "", p_CheminAcces, "") p_Format = "1" End If
nd.Docu_NomFichier = Strrightback(p_CheminAcces, "\") End If
If v_NoDocument = "" Then Do v_NoDocument = xUnique("") Set nd2 = xSIDoc_xndDocu(v_NoDocument, False) Loop Until nd2 Is Nothing End If
nd.Docu_NoDocument = v_NoDocument ' pas nécessaire??? nd.Docu_Description = p_Description nd.Docu_Lien = p_CheminAcces nd.Docu_Format = p_Format nd.Docu_FormatDesc = xDescTabl(p_Format, "Docu_Format", True) nd.Docu_FormatIcone = xIcnTabl(p_Format, "Docu_Format", True)
nd.Cle = v_NoDocument nd.Description = p_Description
' ====== Les droits , rôles Set ni_lecteursAdmin = New NotesItem(nd, "LecteursAdmin", "[LecteurTous]", READERS) Set ni_auteurs = New NotesItem(nd, "AuteursAdmin", "[Admin]:[AuteurTous]", AUTHORS)
nd.HistoDC = Now nd.HistoUC = gns_SIDoc.Username Call nd.Save(True, False)
Set SIDoc_CreerDocument = nd
If v_ErreurArchivage Then Messagebox "Le document n'a pas pu être copié dans le dossier d'archivage. Il a été attaché à la base de documents Notes.", 48, "Avertissement" End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDoc, gc_Element_SIDoc, GetThreadInfo(1), p_CheminAcces, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIDoc_acAttacherDocument(p_NoDoc As String, p_TypeDocumentDispo As String, p_TypeDocumentDefaut As String, p_TypeDocumentModif As Boolean, p_FormatDefaut As String, p_FormatModif As Boolean, p_Multiple As Boolean) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de créer un nouveau document. ' p_TypeFolio : 1 = Permanent, 2 = Temporaire ' p_Formats dans dialogbox : 0 = Lien, 1 = Document, 2 = URL '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' *** À VALIDER: PAS TESTÉ ' *************************** On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nuiws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim nd_DB As NotesDocument Dim nd_Docu As NotesDocument Dim v_Format As String Dim v_Docu_Lien As Variant ' Initialisations '------------------- SIDoc_acAttacherDocument = False Call SIDoc_Initialisations
' Créer le document de sélection ' --------------------------------------------- Set nd_DB = New NotesDocument(gndb_SIDoc) nd_DB.Form = "F_Docu" ' nd_DB.Docu_TypeFolio = p_TypeFolio nd_DB.Docu_NoDoc = p_NoDoc ' nd_DB.Docu_RaisonSociale = Fulltrim(Implode(xeRaisonSociale(p_NoFolio, True), " ")) ' nd_DB.Docu_NoSalarie = p_NoSalarie ' nd_DB.Docu_NomSalarie = xsNomSalarie(p_NoSalarie, True)
' nd_DB.Docu_TypeIdentifiant1 = p_TypeIdentifiant1 ' nd_DB.Docu_TypeIdentifiant1Desc = xiDescTabl(p_TypeIdentifiant1, "Docu_TypeIdentifiant", True) ' nd_DB.Docu_Identifiant1 = p_Identifiant1 ' nd_DB.Docu_TypeIdentifiant2 = p_TypeIdentifiant2 ' nd_DB.Docu_TypeIdentifiant2Desc = xiDescTabl(p_TypeIdentifiant2, "Docu_TypeIdentifiant", True) ' nd_DB.Docu_Identifiant2 = p_Identifiant2
' nd_DB.Docu_TypeDocumentDispo = p_TypeDocumentDispo nd_DB.Docu_TypeDocument = p_TypeDocumentDefaut ' If p_TypeDocumentModif Then ' nd_DB.Docu_TypeDocumentModif = "1" ' End If nd_DB.Docu_Format = p_FormatDefaut ' If p_FormatModif Then ' nd_DB.Docu_FormatModif = "1" ' End If
' If p_Multiple Then ' nd_DB.Docu_SelectionMultiple = "1" ' Else ' nd_DB.Docu_SelectionMultiple = "0" ' End If
' Sélectionner le Document à attacher ' -------------------------------------------------- If Not nuiws.DialogBox("DB_Docu", True, True, False, False, False, False, _ "Attacher un document", nd_DB, True, False, False) Then Exit Function End If %REM v_Format = xVar(nd_DB, "Docu_Format", "") If v_Format = "1" Then If xiVarProf("Prof_Archivage", "") = "1" Then v_Format = "4" End If End If %END REM ' Créer le document de document ' -------------------------------------------------- v_Docu_Lien = xVar(nd_DB, "Docu_Lien", "") If Instr(v_Docu_Lien,",") <> 0 Then v_Docu_Lien = Split (xVar(nd_DB, "Docu_Lien", ""), ",") End If If Isarray(v_Docu_Lien) Then Forall lien In v_Docu_Lien ' Set nd_Docu = SIDoc_CreerDocument(p_NoDoc, xVar(nd_DB, "Docu_TypeDocument", ""), "", v_Format, Cstr(lien), xVar(nd_DB, "Docu_Description", ""), Today) End Forall Else ' Set nd_Docu = SIDoc_CreerDocument(p_NoDoc, xVar(nd_DB, "Docu_TypeDocument", ""), "", v_Format, Cstr(v_Docu_Lien), xVar(nd_DB, "Docu_Description", ""), Today) End If
If Not (nd_Docu Is Nothing) Then SIDoc_acAttacherDocument = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDoc, gc_Element_SIDoc, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIDoc_DetacherDocument(pnd As NotesDocument, p_CheminAcces As String) As Boolean ' p_CheminAcces contient le chemin incluant le nom du fichier à detacher ' - si p_CheminAcces est vide, il le utilise le TEMP de l'OS ' *** À VALIDER: PAS TESTÉ ' *************************** On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem Dim ni As NotesItem
Dim v_NomFichier As String Dim v_LienArchive As String Dim v_NoDocument As String Dim v_Chemin As String Dim v_Format As String
Dim v_CheminAccesOriginal As String Dim v_CheminAccesTemp As String
Call SIDoc_Initialisations SIDoc_DetacherDocument = False
v_NomFichier = xVar(pnd, "Docu_NomFichier", "") If p_CheminAcces = "" Then On Error 75 Resume Next v_CheminAccesTemp = Environ("Temp") & "\CPA_DOCS" Mkdir v_CheminAccesTemp v_CheminAccesTemp = v_CheminAccesTemp & "\" v_Chemin = v_CheminAccesTemp & v_NomFichier Else v_Chemin = p_CheminAcces End If Kill v_Chemin On Error 75 Goto GererErreur
v_Format = xVar(pnd, "Docu_Format", "") If v_Format = "1" Then ' Format document attaché
'Sauvegarde le fichier sous chemin réseau Set nrti = xni(pnd, "Docu_Document", "") If Not Isempty(nrti.EmbeddedObjects) Then ' détach Call nrti.Embeddedobjects(0).ExtractFile( v_Chemin) End If
Else SIDoc_DetacherDocument = False Exit Function End If ' v_Format
p_CheminAcces = v_Chemin SIDoc_DetacherDocument = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDoc, gc_Element_SIDoc, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_NotesAPI" Use "SI_FichierWIN"

' Déclarations globales ' ----------------------------------
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SIND = "SL" Const gc_Element_SIND = "SI_NotesDocument"
'Const APIModule = "NNOTES"
'Declare Function MailGetMessageBodyComposite Lib APIModule Alias "MailGetMessageBodyComposite" ( ByVal hNT As Long, ByVal N As String, ByVal D As String, nD As Long) As Integer 'Declare Function ExportRTF Lib "nxrtf" Alias "ExportRTF" (ByVal sTempFile As String, ByVal flags As Long, hmod As Long, ByVal altlibrary As String, ByVal sRTFFile As String) As Integer

Function SIND_AccesAuteur(pnd As NotesDocument) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim v_AccessLevel As Integer Dim a_UserNamesList As Variant Dim a_Items As Variant Dim ni As NotesItem
Dim i As Integer Dim j As Integer
' Vérifier l'accès à la base de documents Set ndb = pnd.ParentDatabase v_AccessLevel = ndb.CurrentAccessLevel
If v_AccessLevel < ACLLEVEL_AUTHOR Then SIND_AccesAuteur = False Elseif v_AccessLevel > ACLLEVEL_AUTHOR Then SIND_AccesAuteur = True Else ' Vérifier l'accès au document a_UserNamesList = Evaluate("@Usernameslist") a_Items = pnd.Items For i = 0 To Ubound(a_Items) Set ni = a_Items(i) If ni.IsAuthors() Then For j = 0 To Ubound(a_UserNamesList) If Not Isnull(Arraygetindex(ni.Values, a_UserNamesList(j))) Then SIND_AccesAuteur = True Exit Function End If Next End If Next End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIND, gc_Element_SIND, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIND_ValeurItemEgale(pnd As NotesDocument, p_NomItem As String, p_Valeur As Variant, ByVal p_Date As Boolean) As Boolean ' Vérifie si la valeur de l'item p_NomItem est égale à p_Valeur On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_ValeurDifferente As Boolean Dim a_ValeurOrig As Variant Dim i As Integer Dim ndt As New NotesDateTime("")
SIND_ValeurItemEgale = False v_ValeurDifferente = False
' Extraire les valeurs actuelles a_ValeurOrig = xVarArray(pnd, p_NomItem) If p_Date Then If IsArray(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' Dates - retirer la portion heure For i = LBound(a_ValeurOrig) To UBound(a_ValeurOrig) ndt.LSLocalTime = a_ValeurOrig(i) Call ndt.SetAnyTime a_ValeurOrig(i) = ndt.LSLocalTime Next End If
' Si la nouvelle veleur contient des dates, retirer la portion heure If IsArray(p_Valeur) Then For i = LBound(p_Valeur) To UBound(p_Valeur) ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Valeur(i) Call ndt.SetAnyTime p_Valeur(i) = ndt.LSLocalTime Next ElseIf p_Valeur <> "" Then ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Valeur Call ndt.SetAnyTime p_Valeur = ndt.LSLocalTime End If End If
' Vérifier si la nouvelle valeur est différent de la valeur actuelle If IsArray(p_Valeur) Then If IsArray(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' Les deux valeurs sont des tableaux If UBound(p_Valeur) <> UBound(a_ValeurOrig) Then v_ValeurDifferente = True Else For i = LBound(p_Valeur) To UBound(p_Valeur) If CStr(p_Valeur(i)) <> CStr(a_ValeurOrig(i)) Then v_ValeurDifferente = True Exit For End If Next End If Else ' p_Valeur est un tableau mais pas a_ValeurOrig If UBound(p_Valeur) > 0 Then v_ValeurDifferente = True ElseIf CStr(p_Valeur(0)) <> CStr(a_ValeurOrig) Then v_ValeurDifferente = True End If End If ElseIf IsArray(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' a_ValeurOrig est un tableau mais pas p_Valeur If UBound(a_ValeurOrig) > 0 Then v_ValeurDifferente = True ElseIf CStr(a_ValeurOrig(0)) <> CStr(p_Valeur) Then v_ValeurDifferente = True End If ElseIf CStr(p_Valeur) <> CStr(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' Ni p_Valeur ni a_ValeurOrig n'est un tableau v_ValeurDifferente = True End If
SIND_ValeurItemEgale = Not v_ValeurDifferente Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIND, gc_Element_SIND, GetThreadInfo(1), p_NomItem, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIND_AddedToFile(pnd As NotesDocument) As String
Dim db As String Dim s As String Dim ns As Integer
With pnd.ParentDatabase db = String$(1024, " ") SINAPI_OSPathNetConstruct 0, .Server, .FilePath, db End With
Dim hDB As Long SINAPI_NSFDbOpen db$, hDB If hDB = 0 Then Exit Function
Dim hNT As Long Dim T(1) As Long SINAPI_NSFNoteOpen hDB, Clng("&H" & pnd.NoteID), 0, hNT If Not hNT = 0 Then SINAPI_NSFNoteGetInfo hNT, 13, T(0) SINAPI_NSFNoteClose hNT s = Space(80) SINAPI_ConvertTIMEDATEToText 0, 0, T(0), s, 80, ns SIND_AddedToFile = Left$(s, ns) End If
SINAPI_NSFDbClose hDB End Function

Sub SIND_Initialisations
End Sub

Function SIND_DecrypterDocument(pnd As NotesDocument) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur On Error 17 Goto ErreurEncrypt
SIND_DecrypterDocument = False
If pnd.HasItem("Encrypt") Then ' Décryptage des champs ' --------------------------------- Forall ni In pnd.items If ni.isencrypted Then ni.isencrypted = False End If End Forall
' Crypter le document avec une clé bidon ' ------------------------------------------------------ Dim temp As New NotesItem(pnd, "x_Decrypter", "Cryptage") temp.IsEncrypted=True Call pnd.encrypt Call pnd.save(True, False)
' Retirer les champs relatifs au cryptage ' ---------------------------------------------------- Call pnd.removeitem("$Seal") Call pnd.removeitem("$SealData") Call pnd.removeitem("SecretEncryptionKeys") Call pnd.removeitem("Encrypt")
' Retirer le champ temporaire ' --------------------------------------- Call pnd.removeItem("x_Decrypter") Call pnd.Save(True, False) End If
SIND_DecrypterDocument = True Exit Function
ErreurEncrypt: Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIND, gc_Element_SIND, Getthreadinfo(1), Cstr(pnd.UniversalID), False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIND_DetacherFichiersAttaches(pnd As NotesDocument, p_CheminAcces As String, p_NomItemCle As String) As Long '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Ce script extrait le.s fichier.s attaché.s d'un document et le.s place dans le chemin d'accès spécifié (p_CheminAcces). ' ' Paramètres: ' pnd : document qui contient un ou des fichiers attachés ' p_NomItemRT : nom du champ RichText à traiter ' p_CheminAcces : chemin incluant le nom du fichier à détacher; si p_CheminAcces est vide, le TEMP de l'OS est alors utilisé ' p_NomItemCle : clé du document; ce texte est ajouté à la fin du nom du fichier. Exemple: <NoCandidat>_<NomFichier> ' ' Exemple: Fichier "ABC.PDF" et p_NomItemCle = 12345; le fichier sera nommé "12345_ABC.PDF" et s'il y a plusieurs fichiers au même nom alors ' le deuxième deviendra "12345_ABC (2).PDF". ' ' Valeur retournée: ' 0 : pas de fichier attaché dans le document ' -1 : une erreur s'est produite ' nombre de fichiers attachés traités '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim a_NomFichierAttaches As Variant Dim i As Integer Dim neo As NotesEmbeddedObject
Dim v_NomFichier As String Dim v_LienArchive As String Dim v_NoDocument As String Dim v_Chemin As String Dim v_Format As String Dim s As String
Dim v_NbMaj As Long
' Initialisations Call SIND_Initialisations SIND_DetacherFichiersAttaches = 0
a_NomFichierAttaches = Evaluate(|@AttachmentNames|, pnd) If a_NomFichierAttaches(0) = "" Then Exit Function End If
' Boucler sur tous les fichiers attachés du champ For i = 0 to UBound(a_NomFichierAttaches)
' Créer le dossier où sera placé le fichier If p_CheminAcces = "" Then On Error 75 Resume Next p_CheminAcces = Environ("Temp") & "\SIND" MkDir p_CheminAcces p_CheminAcces = p_CheminAcces & "\" Else s = Dir$(p_CheminAcces, 16) If s = "" Then MkDir p_CheminAcces End If End If
Set neo = pnd.Getattachment(a_NomFichierAttaches(i)) v_NomFichier = p_NomItemCle & "_" & neo.name v_Chemin = SLFWIN_NomFichierUnique(p_CheminAcces & "\" & v_NomFichier) v_NomFichier = StrRightBack(v_NomFichier, "\")
' Extraire le fichier et le placer dans le chemin indiqué Call neo.ExtractFile(v_Chemin) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1
Next
SIND_DetacherFichiersAttaches = v_NbMaj Exit Function
GererErreur: SIND_DetacherFichiersAttaches = -1 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIND, gc_Element_SIND, GetThreadInfo(1), v_NomFichier & " --> " & p_CheminAcces, False) Exit Function End Function

%REM Description: Converts a NotesDocument to an RTF-Document and saves it under the filePath Generates and removes some temporary Files while Working %END REM
Function SIND_ConvertirDocumentRTF(pnd As NotesDocument, p_CheminAccesRTF As String) As boolean On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
Dim nd_Temp As NotesDocument Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem Dim v_CheminFichier_Body As String Dim v_CheminFichier_Fonts As String Dim v_CheminFichier_Temp As String Dim v_FileSize As Long
Dim i As Integer Dim f As Integer Dim fnew As Integer
SIND_ConvertirDocumentRTF = False
Set nd_Temp = pnd.ParentDatabase.CreateDocument() Set nrti = nd_Temp.CreateRichTextItem("Body")
Call pnd.RenderToRTItem(nrti)
v_CheminFichier_Body = p_CheminAccesRTF & "_Body.cd" v_CheminFichier_Fonts = p_CheminAccesRTF & "_Fonts.cd" v_CheminFichier_Temp = p_CheminAccesRTF & ".cd"
Call SINAPI_MailGetMessageBodyComposite(nd_Temp.handle , "Body", v_CheminFichier_Body, v_FileSize) Call SINAPI_MailGetMessageBodyComposite(nd_Temp.handle , "$Fonts", v_CheminFichier_Fonts, v_FileSize)
' Concatener le body et les polices dans un seul fichier fnew = FreeFile Open v_CheminFichier_Temp For Binary As #fnew
' $fonts f = FreeFile Open v_CheminFichier_Fonts For Binary As #f Do Until EOF (f) Get #f,,i Put #fnew,, i Loop Close #f
' rich text Open v_CheminFichier_Body For Binary As #f ' skip 2 bytes Seek #f, 3 Do Until EOF (f) Get #f,,i Put #fnew,, i Loop Close ' Fin concatener
Call SINAPI_ExportRTF(v_CheminFichier_Temp, 0, 0, "", p_CheminAccesRTF)
SIND_ConvertirDocumentRTF = True Kill v_CheminFichier_Body Kill v_CheminFichier_Fonts Kill v_CheminFichier_Temp
Exit Function
ErrorHandler: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIND, gc_Element_SIND, GetThreadInfo(1), CStr(pnd.UniversalID), False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIND_NotesURL(pnd As NotesDocument) As String ' Retourne l'URL permettant d'ouvrir un document dans Notes. ' Format: Notes://DbReplicaId/ViewNoteUNID/DocUNID On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim v_Serveur As String Dim nv As NotesView Dim v_URL As String
If pnd Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
Set ndb = pnd.ParentDatabase v_Serveur = ndb.Server If v_Serveur = "" Then Exit Function End If
Set nv = ndb.GetView("V_AdmT") If nv Is nothing Then Exit Function End If
v_URL = "Notes://" & StrRight(StrLeft(v_Serveur, "/"), "=") & "/" & ndb.Replicaid & "/" & nv.UniversalId & "/" & pnd.UniversalId SIND_NotesURL = v_URL
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIND, gc_Element_SIND, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Extractions" Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "SI_Insertions" Use "x_NAB"

' Déclarations globales ' --------------------- Dim gns_SINM As NotesSession Dim gndb_SINM As NotesDatabase
' Traitement des erreurs ' ---------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SINM = "SL" Const gc_Element_SINM = "SI_NotesMail"

Function SINM_AjouterRendezVous(pndb As NotesDatabase, Byval p_Date As Variant, Byval p_HeureDebut As Variant,_ Byval p_HeureFin As Variant, p_Objet As String, p_Endroit As String, p_Categorie As Variant,_ p_Origine As String, p_OrigineCle As String) As NotesDocument ' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script créé un document de type "Rendez-vous" dans la base de documents de courrier électronique. ' Paramètres: ' pndb : nom de la base des courriels de l'utilisateur ' p_Date : date du rendez-vous ' p_HeureDebut: heure de début du rendez-vous ' p_HeureFin : heure de fin du rendez-vous ' p_Objet : titre du rendez-vous ' p_Endroit : lieu du rendez-vous ' p_Categorie : catégorie du rendez-vous ' p_Origine : code de la base de documents d'origine (ex: SRSPc pour SRS Placements) ' p_OrigineCle: valeur de la clé du document source ' ' Valeur retournée: ' NotesDocument: document du rendez-vous dans l'agenda ' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_Prof As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_Maj As Boolean
Dim v_Date As Variant Dim i As Integer Dim v_Principal As String
' Initialisations Set SINM_AjouterRendezVous = Nothing Call SINM_Initialisations
' Validations If pndb Is Nothing Then Exit Function Elseif Not pndb.IsOpen Then Exit Function End If
If Not Isdate(p_Date) Then Exit Function End If
If p_Objet = "" Then Exit Function End If
v_Maj = False
' Extraire le profil de la base de courriel Set nd_Prof = pndb.GetProfileDocument("CalendarProfile")
' Vérifier que le RV n'existe pas dans la db de courriels Set nd = SINM_ndAppointment(pndb, p_Origine, p_OrigineCle) If nd Is Nothing Then ' Création du rendez-vous dans l'agenda Set nd = New NotesDocument(pndb) nd.Form = "Appointment" nd.AppointmentType = "0" If p_Origine = "SIEv_Reference" Then ' Compatibilité avec version < 2.0 Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("SIEv_Reference", p_OrigineCle) Else Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("SINM_Origine", p_Origine) Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("SINM_OrigineCle", p_OrigineCle) End If
v_Principal = xVar(nd_Prof, "Owner", gns_SINM.UserName)
Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$AlarmDisabled", "1") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$AltPrincipal", v_Principal) Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$BusyName", v_Principal) Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$BusyPriority", "1") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$CSVersion", "2") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$ExpandGroups", "3") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$HFFlags", "1") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$IconSwitcher", "Appointment") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$PublicAccess", "1") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("ExcludeFromView", Evaluate(|"D" : "S"|))
nd.AltChair = v_Principal nd.Chair = v_Principal nd.From = v_Principal nd.Principal = v_Principal nd.SchedulerSwitcher = "1" nd.SequenceNum = 1 nd.UpdateSeq = 1 nd.OrgTable = "P0" Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("_ViewIcon", 160)
v_Maj = True End If
v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "Subject", p_Objet, False) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "Location", p_Endroit, False) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "Categories", p_Categorie, False) Or v_Maj
' Date et heure de début du rendez-vous v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "StartDate", p_Date, True) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "StartDateTime", p_Date + p_HeureDebut, False) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "StartTime", p_HeureDebut, False) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "CalendarDateTime", p_Date + p_HeureDebut, False) Or v_Maj
' Date et heure de fin du rendez-vous v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "EndDate", p_Date, True) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "EndDateTime", p_Date + p_HeureFin, False) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "EndTime", p_HeureFin, False) Or v_Maj
If v_Maj Then If nd.IsNewNote Then Call nd.Save(True, False) nd.ApptUNID = Cstr(nd.UniversalID) End If
Call nd.Save(False, False) End If
Set SINM_AjouterRendezVous = nd Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINM, gc_Element_SINM, Getthreadinfo(1), pndb.Title, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SINM_ndAppointment(pndb As NotesDatabase, p_Origine As String, p_OrigineCle As String) As NotesDocument ' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script extrait le document "Appointment" qui se trouve dans l'agenda. ' Paramètres: ' pndb : nom de la base des courriels de l'utilisateur ' p_Origine : code de la base de documents d'origine (ex: SRSPc pour SRS Placements) ' p_OrigineCle: valeur de la clé du document source ' ' Valeur retournée: ' NotesDocument: document "Appointment" dans l'agenda ' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection
Dim v_Formule As String
Set SINM_ndAppointment = Nothing
' Construction de la formule de recherche v_Formule = |Form = "Appointment"| If p_Origine = "SIEv_Reference" Then ' Compatibilité avec version < 2.0 v_Formule = v_Formule & | & SIEv_Reference = "| & p_OrigineCle & |"| Else v_Formule = v_Formule & | & SINM_Origine = "| & p_Origine & |"| & | & SINM_OrigineCle = "| & p_OrigineCle & |"| End If
Set ndc = pndb.Search(v_Formule, Nothing, 0) If ndc.count > 1 Then Call SIGE_EnregistrerErreurManuelle(gc_TypeElement_SINM, gc_Element_SINM, Getthreadinfo(1), 0, _ "Plusieurs documents d'agenda ont été trouvés dans la base de courriels " & pndb.Title & ".", p_Origine & | ; | & p_OrigineCle) Exit Function End If
Set SINM_ndAppointment = ndc.GetFirstDocument
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINM, gc_Element_SINM, Getthreadinfo(1), pndb.Title, False) Exit Function End Function
Sub SINM_Initialisations If gns_SINM Is Nothing Then Set gns_SINM = New NotesSession End If End Sub

Function SINM_SupprimerAppointment(pndb As NotesDatabase, p_Origine As String, p_OrigineCle As String) As Boolean ' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script supprime le document "Appointment" de l'agenda. ' Paramètres: ' pndb : nom de la base des courriels de l'utilisateur ' p_Origine : code de la base de documents d'origine (ex: SRSPc pour SRS Placements) ' p_OrigineCle: valeur de la clé du document source ' ' Valeur retournée: ' Boolean: True si le document a été supprimé ' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument
SINM_SupprimerAppointment = False
Set nd = SINM_ndAppointment(pndb, p_Origine, p_OrigineCle) If Not (nd Is Nothing) Then If nd.Remove(True) Then SINM_SupprimerAppointment = True Else Messagebox "Impossible de supprimer le rendez-vous (clé: " & p_OrigineCle &_ ") de l'agenda. Svp, vérifiez l'agenda", 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 0, "", "") End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINM, gc_Element_SINM, Getthreadinfo(1), pndb.Title, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SINM_AjouterReunion(pndb As NotesDatabase, Byval p_Date As Variant, Byval p_Heure As Variant, _ Byval p_NbHeures As Double, p_Objet As String, p_Endroit As String, p_Categorie As Variant, p_Invites As Variant, _ p_Origine As String, p_OrigineCle As String) As NotesDocument ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script créé un document de type "Réunion" dans la base de documents de courrier électronique. ' Paramètres: ' pndb : nom de la base des courriels de l'utilisateur ' p_Date : date de la réunion ' p_Heure : heure de la réunion ' p_NbHeures : nombre d'heures de la réunion ' p_Objet : titre de la réunion ' p_Endroit : lieu de la réunion ' p_Categorie : catégorie de la réunion ' p_Invites : noms des personnes invitées à la réunion ' p_Origine : code de la base de documents d'origine (ex: SRSPc pour SRS Placements) ' p_OrigineCle: valeur de la clé du document source ' ' Valeur retournée: ' NotesDocument: document de la réunion dans l'agenda ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_Prof As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim ndt As New NotesDateTime("") Dim v_Maj As Boolean
Dim v_Date As Variant Dim i As Integer Dim v_Principal As String
' Initialisations Call SINM_Initialisations
' Validations If pndb Is Nothing Then Exit Function Elseif Not pndb.IsOpen Then Exit Function End If If Not Isdate(p_Date) Then Exit Function End If If p_Objet = "" Then Exit Function End If
v_Maj = False
' Extraire le profil de la base de courriel Set nd_Prof = pndb.GetProfileDocument("CalendarProfile")
' Vérifier que la réunion n'existe pas dans la db de courriels Set nd = SINM_ndAppointment(pndb, p_Origine, p_OrigineCle) If nd Is Nothing Then ' Création du document de l'agenda Set nd = New Notesdocument(pndb) nd.Form = "Appointment" nd.AppointmentType = "3" If p_Origine = "SIEv_Reference" Then ' Compatibilité avec version < 2.0 Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("SIEv_Reference", p_OrigineCle) Else Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("SINM_Origine", p_Origine) Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("SINM_OrigineCle", p_OrigineCle) End If
v_Principal = xVar(nd_Prof, "Owner", gns_SINM.UserName) Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$AlarmDisabled", "1") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$AltPrincipal", v_Principal) Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$BusyName", xVar(nd_Prof, "Owner", gns_SINM.UserName)) Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$BusyPriority", "1") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$CSVersion", "2") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$ExpandGroups", "3") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$HFFlags", "1") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$IconSwitcher", "AllDayEvent") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$PublicAccess", "1") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("ExcludeFromView", Evaluate(|"D" : "S"|))
nd.AltChair = v_Principal nd.Chair = v_Principal nd.From = v_Principal nd.Principal = v_Principal nd.SchedulerSwitcher = "1" nd.SequenceNum = 1 nd.UpdateSeq = 1 nd.OrgTable = "C0" Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("_ViewIcon", 158)
v_Maj = True End If
v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "Subject", p_Objet, False) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "Location", p_Endroit, False) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "Categories", p_Categorie, False) Or v_Maj
' Date et heure de début du rendez-vous v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "StartDate", p_Date, True) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "StartDateTime", p_Date + p_Heure, False) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "StartTime", p_Heure, False) Or v_Maj ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Date + p_Heure v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "CalendarDateTime", ndt.LSLocalTime, False) Or v_Maj
' Date et heure de fin du rendez-vous v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "EndDate", p_Date, True) Or v_Maj Call ndt.AdjustHour(p_NbHeures) v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "EndDateTime", ndt.LSLocalTime, False) Or v_Maj Call ndt.SetAnyDate v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "EndTime", ndt.LSLocalTime, False) Or v_Maj
' Invités à la réunion v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "RequiredAttendees", p_Invites, False) Or v_Maj
If v_Maj Then If nd.IsNewNote Then Call nd.Save(True, False) nd.ApptUNID = Cstr(nd.UniversalID) End If
Call nd.Save(False, False) End If
Set SINM_AjouterReunion = nd Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINM, gc_Element_SINM, Getthreadinfo(1), pndb.Title, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SINM_ndbCourriel(p_Nom As String) As NotesDatabase ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de retouner la base de documents de courriel de l'utilisateur. ' Paramètre: ' p_Nom : nom de l'utilisateur (NotesSession.UserName) ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim nd As NotesDocument
Dim v_NomBase As String
' Initialisations Set SINM_ndbCourriel = Nothing Call SINM_Initialisations If gns_SINM Is Nothing Then Set gns_SINM = New NotesSession End If
' Extraire le Person Document du carnet d'adresses Set nd = xNAB_xndPerson(p_Nom, True) If nd Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
If xVar(nd, "MailSystem", "") <> "1" Then Exit Function End If
v_NomBase = xVar(nd, "MailFile", "") If v_NomBase = "" Then Exit Function Elseif Lcase(Right(v_NomBase, 4)) <> ".nsf" Then v_NomBase = v_NomBase & ".nsf" End If
On Error 4060 Resume Next Set ndb = gns_SINM.GetDatabase(xVar(nd, "MailServer", ""), v_NomBase, False) If Not (ndb Is Nothing) Then If ndb.IsOpen Then Set SINM_ndbCourriel = ndb End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINM, gc_Element_SINM, Getthreadinfo(1), p_Nom, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SINM_AjouterEvenement(pndb As NotesDatabase, Byval p_DateDebut As Variant, _ Byval p_DateFin As Variant, Byval p_NbJours As Integer, p_Objet As String, p_Endroit As String, _ p_Categorie As Variant, p_Origine As String, p_OrigineCle As String) As NotesDocument ' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script créé un document de type "Event" dans la base de documents de courrier électronique. ' Paramètres: ' pndb : nom de la base des courriels de l'utilisateur ' p_DateDebut : date de début de l'évènement ' p_DateFin : date de fin de l'évènement ' p_NbJours : nombre de jours de l'évènement ' p_Objet : titre de l'évènement ' p_Endroit : lieu de l'évènement ' p_Categorie : catégorie de l'évènement ' p_Origine : code de la base de documents d'origine (ex: SRSPc pour SRS Placements) ' p_OrigineCle: valeur de la clé du document source ' ' Valeur retournée: ' NotesDocument: document de l'évènement dans l'agenda ' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_Prof As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument
Dim v_Date As Variant Dim i As Integer Dim v_Principal As String
' Initialisations Call SINM_Initialisations
' Validations If pndb Is Nothing Then Exit Function Elseif Not pndb.IsOpen Then Exit Function End If If Not Isdate(p_DateDebut) Then Exit Function End If If Not Isdate(p_DateFin) Then If p_NbJours = 0 Then p_DateFin = p_DateDebut Else p_DateFin = p_DateDebut + p_NbJours - 1 End If Elseif p_DateFin < p_DateDebut Then p_DateFin = p_DateDebut End If If p_Objet = "" Then Exit Function End If
' Extraire le profil de la base de courriel Set nd_Prof = pndb.GetProfileDocument("CalendarProfile")
' Vérifier que l'évènement n'existe pas dans la db de courriels Set nd = SINM_ndAppointment(pndb, p_Origine, p_OrigineCle) If nd Is Nothing Then ' Création du document de l'agenda Set nd = New Notesdocument(pndb) nd.Form = "Appointment" nd.AppointmentType = "2" If p_Origine = "SIEv_Reference" Then ' Compatibilité avec version < 2.0 Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("SIEv_Reference", p_OrigineCle) Else Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("SINM_Origine", p_Origine) Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("SINM_OrigineCle", p_OrigineCle) End If End If
nd.Subject = p_Objet nd.Location = p_Endroit nd.Categories = p_Categorie Call SIIx_AssignerDate(nd, "StartDate", p_DateDebut) nd.StartDateTime = p_DateDebut + Timenumber(4, 0, 0) nd.StartTime = Timenumber(4, 0, 0) Call SIIx_AssignerDate(nd, "EndDate", p_DateFin) nd.EndDateTime = p_DateFin + Timenumber(20, 0, 0) nd.EndTime = Timenumber(20, 0, 0)
Redim a(p_DateFin - p_DateDebut) As Variant v_Date = p_DateDebut For i = Lbound(a) To Ubound(a) a(i) = v_Date + Timenumber(4, 0, 0) v_Date = v_Date + 1 Next nd.CalendarDateTime = a
v_Principal = xVar(nd_Prof, "Owner", gns_SINM.UserName) Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$AlarmDisabled", "1") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$AltPrincipal", v_Principal) Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$BusyName", xVar(nd_Prof, "Owner", gns_SINM.UserName)) Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$BusyPriority", "1") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$CSVersion", "2") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$ExpandGroups", "3") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$HFFlags", "1") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$IconSwitcher", "AllDayEvent") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$PublicAccess", "1") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("ExcludeFromView", Evaluate(|"D" : "S"|)) nd.AltChair = v_Principal nd.Chair = v_Principal nd.From = v_Principal nd.Principal = v_Principal nd.SchedulerSwitcher = "1" nd.SequenceNum = 1 nd.UpdateSeq = 1 nd.OrgTable = "P0" Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("_ViewIcon", 9) Call nd.Save(True, False)
nd.ApptUNID = Cstr(nd.UniversalID) Call nd.Save(False, False)
Set SINM_AjouterEvenement = nd Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINM, gc_Element_SINM, Getthreadinfo(1), pndb.Title, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SINM_AjouterAlarme(pnd As NotesDocument, p_Moment As Integer, p_Unite As String) As Boolean
' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 'Ce script permet d'ajouter une Alarme RDV dans le calendrie de l'invité 'Paramètres: 'pndb : nom de la base des courriels de l'utilisateur 'pnd : le RDV a laquelle sera associé l'Alarme 'p_Moment : Moment d'affichage de la notification d'Alarme (tmpOffset) 'P_Unite : Declenchement d'alarme :Jour(s)|D, Minute(s)|M et Heure(s)|H ($AlarmUnit) 'Avant -----> tmpOffsetDir ="1" ' ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Maj As Boolean Dim v_offset As Integer
SINM_AjouterAlarme = False v_Maj = False
'Activer l'alarme v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pnd, "$Alarm", 1, False) Or v_Maj ' System flag v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pnd, "$AlarmDisabled", "", False) Or v_Maj ' System flag v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pnd, "$AlarmUnit", p_Unite, False) Or v_Maj ' Unit (J/H/M)
v_offset = p_Moment Select Case p_Unite Case "M" : v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pnd, "$AlarmOffset", v_offset * -1, False) Or v_Maj Case "H" : v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pnd, "$AlarmOffset", v_offset * -60, False) Or v_Maj Case Else : v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pnd, "$AlarmOffset", v_offset * -1440, False) Or v_Maj End Select
If v_Maj Then Call pnd.Save (True, False) SINM_AjouterAlarme = True End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINM, gc_Element_SINM, Getthreadinfo(1), Cstr(pnd.UniveralId), False) Exit Function End Function
Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_GestionErreurs" ' ' Les fonctions définies dans cette bibliothèque permettent de manipuler des chaînes de caractères.
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SItS = "SL" Const gc_Element_SItS = "SI_tString"

Function SItS_NomPrenom(Byval p_NomComplet As String, p_Nom As String, p_Prenom As String) As Integer '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de séparer le nom du prénom d'une chaîne de caractères '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
SItS_NomPrenom = False
p_Nom = "" p_Prenom = "" p_NomComplet = Fulltrim(p_NomComplet) If p_NomComplet <> "" Then If Instr(p_NomComplet, ",") > 0 Then p_Nom = Trim(Strleft(p_NomComplet, ",")) p_Prenom = Trim(Strright(p_NomComplet, ",")) Elseif Instr(p_NomComplet, " ") > 0 Then p_Nom = Strrightback(p_NomComplet, " ") p_Prenom = Strleftback(p_NomComplet, " ") Else p_Nom = p_NomComplet End If End If
SItS_NomPrenom = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SItS, gc_Element_SItS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SItS_FormaterCodePostal(Byval p_CodePostal As String) As String '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de formater un code postal. Function SItS_Trouver(p_Chaine As String, pa_Valeurs As Variant, Byval p_Debut As Integer, p_Max As Integer) As Integer '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de trouver le premier occurence d'un des éléments de "pa_Valeurs" ' Ne tient pas comte des majuscules-miniscules. ' p_Max = si > 0, cherche la dernière occurence avant la position '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Continuer As Boolean Dim i As Integer Dim v_Pos As Integer
SItS_Trouver = 0
If Isarray(pa_Valeurs) Then Do v_Continuer = True
For i = Lbound(pa_Valeurs) To Ubound(pa_Valeurs) v_Pos = Instr(p_Debut, p_Chaine, pa_Valeurs(i), 5) If p_Max > 0 Then If v_Pos < p_Max And v_Pos > SItS_Trouver Then SItS_Trouver = v_Pos p_Debut = v_Pos + 1 If p_Debut < p_Max Then v_Continuer = False End If Exit For End If Else If SItS_Trouver = 0 Or v_Pos < SItS_Trouver Then SItS_Trouver = v_Pos End If End If Next Loop Until v_Continuer Else SItS_Trouver = Instr(p_Debut, p_Chaine, pa_Valeurs, 5) End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SItS, gc_Element_SItS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SItS_AjouterLigne(p_Chaine As String, Byval p_Ligne As String, Byval p_Separateur As String) As Integer '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet d'ajouter une ligne à une chaine. Un séparateur est ajouté entre les lignes '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
SItS_AjouterLigne = False
If p_Chaine = "" Then p_Chaine = p_Ligne Elseif p_Ligne <> "" Then p_Chaine = p_Chaine & p_Separateur & p_Ligne End If
SItS_AjouterLigne = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SItS, gc_Element_SItS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SItS_TelephoneValide(Byval p_Pays As String, Byval p_Telephone As String, _ p_TelephoneFmt As String) As Boolean '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de valider un numéro de téléphone. ' Un numéro de téléphone doit avoir 10 chiffres. '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim i As Integer Dim v As Integer Dim v_Somme As Integer
SItS_TelephoneValide = False p_TelephoneFmt = p_Telephone
' Canada & Etats-Unis If p_Pays = "CA" Or p_Pays = "US" Then p_Telephone = Replace(p_Telephone, " ", "") p_Telephone = Replace(p_Telephone, "(", "") p_Telephone = Replace(p_Telephone, ")", "") p_Telephone = Replace(p_Telephone, "-", "") If p_Telephone Like "##########" Then SItS_TelephoneValide = True p_TelephoneFmt = Left(p_Telephone, 3) & " " & Mid(p_Telephone, 4, 3) & _ "-" & Right(p_Telephone, 4) End If Else SItS_TelephoneValide = True End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SItS, gc_Element_SItS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SItS_Remplacer(p_Chaine As String, Byval p_ValeurDe As String, Byval p_ValeurA As String) As Boolean '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de remplacer toutes les occurences de "p_ValeurDe" par "p_ValeurA" dans la chaîne ' "p_Chaine". ' Ne tient pas comte des majuscules-miniscules. '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
SItS_Remplacer = False
Do Until Instr(1, p_Chaine, p_ValeurDe, 5) = 0 p_Chaine = Strleft(p_Chaine, p_ValeurDe, 5) & p_ValeurA & _ Strright(p_Chaine, p_ValeurDe, 5) Loop
SItS_Remplacer = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SItS, gc_Element_SItS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SItS_MotDePasseValide(p_MotDePasse As String, p_LongeurMin As Integer, p_Options As String) As String '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de valider un mot de passe. ' Paramètres : ' p_MotDePasse Le mot de passe à valider ' p_LongeurMin La longueur minimale du mot de passe. 0 = pas de minimum. ' p_Options Validations à effectuer. ' "A" = Au moins une lettre majuscule ' "a" = Au moins une lettre minuscule ' "N" = Au moins un chiffre ' "S" = Au moins une caractère spécial ' Valeur retournée: ' "" = Mot de passe valide ' Liste des codes des erreurs rencontrées '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_ListeValeurs As String
SItS_MotDePasseValide = ""
If p_LongeurMin > 0 Then If Len(p_MotDePasse) < p_LongeurMin Then SItS_MotDePasseValide = SItS_MotDePasseValide & "L" End If End If
If Instr(1, p_Options, "A", 0) > 0 Then If Not (p_MotDePasse Like |*[ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ]*|) Then SItS_MotDePasseValide = SItS_MotDePasseValide & "A" End If End If
If Instr(1, p_Options, "a", 0) > 0 Then If Not (p_MotDePasse Like |*[abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz]*|) Then SItS_MotDePasseValide = SItS_MotDePasseValide & "a" End If End If
If Instr(1, p_Options, "N", 0) > 0 Then If Not (p_MotDePasse Like |*[0123456789]*|) Then SItS_MotDePasseValide = SItS_MotDePasseValide & "N" End If End If
If Instr(1, p_Options, "S", 0) > 0 Then If Not (p_MotDePasse Like |*[_!@#$%&*()]*|) Then SItS_MotDePasseValide = SItS_MotDePasseValide & "S" End If End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SItS, gc_Element_SItS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SItS_FormaterTexte(Byval p_Texte2 As String, p_NbCarParLigne As Integer, p_TrimLignesVides As Boolean, _ p_NbMaxLignes As Integer) As Variant '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de formater du texte selon une longeur maximale de ligne. ' p_NbCarParLigne = Nombre de caractères de chaque ligne ' p_NbMaxLignes = nombre maximal de lignes - le surplus sera coupé. 0 = sans limite (999) ' Valeur retournée : Tableau des lignes '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Redim a_Lignes(999) As String Dim v_Texte As String Dim i As Integer Dim a_Separateurs As Variant Dim v_Pos As Integer Dim v_NbCar As Integer Dim v_Ligne As String
SItS_FormaterTexte = "" v_Texte = Replace(p_Texte2, Chr$(13) & Chr$(10), Chr$(13)) a_Separateurs = Evaluate(|" " : "." : "," : ":" : "!" : "?"|) i = 0
Do Until v_Texte = "" v_Pos = SItS_Trouver(v_Texte, Chr$(13), 1, p_NbCarParLigne) If v_Pos > 0 And v_Pos <= (p_NbCarParLigne + 1) Then v_NbCar = v_Pos - 1 Elseif Len(v_Texte) <= p_NbCarParLigne Or Mid(v_Texte, p_NbCarParLigne + 1) = " " Then v_Pos = Len(v_Texte) v_NbCar = Len(v_Texte) Else v_Pos = SItS_Trouver(v_Texte, a_Separateurs, 1, p_NbCarParLigne) If v_Pos > 0 Then If Mid(v_Texte, v_Pos, 1) = " " Then v_NbCar = v_Pos - 1 Else v_NbCar = v_Pos End If Else v_Pos = p_NbCarParLigne v_NbCar = p_NbCarParLigne End If End If
v_Ligne = Left(v_Texte, v_NbCar) If Fulltrim(v_Ligne) <> "" Or p_TrimLignesVides = False Then a_Lignes(i) = v_Ligne i = i + 1 End If
v_NbCar = Len(v_Texte) - v_Pos If v_NbCar > 0 Then v_Texte = Ltrim(Right(v_Texte, v_NbCar)) Else v_Texte = "" End If Loop
If i < 1 Then Redim Preserve a_Lignes(i) As String Else Redim Preserve a_Lignes(i - 1) As String End If SItS_FormaterTexte = a_Lignes Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SItS, gc_Element_SItS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SItS_FormaterMatches(p_Expression As String, p_NomItem As String) As String '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de prendre une expression de recherche de de la transformer en formule ' exemples .: ' ABC Or DEF ---> @Matches(NomItem; "*ABC*")|@Matches(NomItem; "*DEF*") ' (ABC or DEF) and GHI ---> (@Matches(NomItem; "*ABC*")|@Matches(NomItem; "*DEF*"))&@Matches(NomItem; "*GHI*") ' (((ABC Or DEF))) ---> (((@Matches(NomItem; "*ABC*")|@Matches(NomItem; "*DEF*")))) ' Les astérixes dans l'expression sont ignorés. ' ABC* Or *DEF ---> @Matches(NomItem; "*ABC*")|@Matches(NomItem; "*DEF*") '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim a_RemplacerDe As Variant Dim a_RemplacerPar As Variant Dim v_Expression As String Dim v_MotCle As Boolean Dim v_Apostrophes As Boolean Dim v_Formule As String Redim a_Elements(100) As String Dim v_NbElem As Integer
Dim i As Long Dim j As Long Dim c As String Dim v As Variant
SItS_FormaterMatches = "" v_Formule = "" v_Expression = Fulltrim(p_Expression)
' Séparer la chaine de caractère en éléments For i = 1 To Len(v_Expression) c = Mid(v_Expression, i, 1)
If c = |"| Then ' Chaine avec plusieurs mots If v_Apostrophes Then a_Elements(v_NbElem) = a_Elements(v_NbElem) & c v_Apostrophes = False Else j = Instr(i+1, v_Expression, |"|) If j > 0 Then v_NbElem = v_NbElem + 1 a_Elements(v_NbElem) = a_Elements(v_NbElem) & c v_Apostrophes = True End If End If
Elseif v_Apostrophes Then a_Elements(v_NbElem) = a_Elements(v_NbElem) & c
Elseif c = " " Then v_MotCle = False
Elseif Instr("()|&", c) > 0 Then ' Opérateur ou séparateur If v_NbElem = 0 Or a_Elements(v_NbElem) <> "" Then v_NbElem = v_NbElem + 1 End If a_Elements(v_NbElem) = a_Elements(v_NbElem) & c v_MotCle = False
Elseif c <> "*" Then ' Ignorer les étoiles If v_MotCle = False Then v_NbElem = v_NbElem + 1 v_MotCle = True End If a_Elements(v_NbElem) = a_Elements(v_NbElem) & c End If
If v_NbElem Mod 100 = 0 Then Redim Preserve a_Elements(v_NbElem + 100) As String End If Next
' Remplacer les mots clés par l'équivalent en formule a_RemplacerDe = Evaluate(|"and" : "et" : "or" : "ou"|) a_RemplacerPar = Evaluate({"&" : "&" : "|" : "|"}) v_MotCle = False
' Traiter les éléments For i = 1 To v_NbElem If Instr("()", a_Elements(i)) Then ' Parenthèse If a_Elements(i) = "(" And v_MotCle Then v_Formule = v_Formule & " | " v_MotCle = False End If v_Formule = v_Formule & a_Elements(i) Elseif Instr("|&", a_Elements(i)) Then ' Opérateur ou séparateur v_Formule = v_Formule & " " & a_Elements(i) & " " v_MotCle = False Else v = Arraygetindex(a_RemplacerDe, a_Elements(i), 1) If Not Isnull(v) Then v_Formule = v_Formule & " " & a_RemplacerPar(Cint(v)) & " " v_MotCle = False Else If v_MotCle Then v_Formule = v_Formule & " | " End If If Left(a_Elements(i), 1) = |"| Then ' Apostrophe v_Formule = v_Formule & |@Matches(| & p_NomItem & |; "| & Trim(a_Elements(i)) & |")| Else ' Mot-clé v_Formule = v_Formule & |@Matches(| & p_NomItem & |; "*| & Trim(a_Elements(i)) & |*")| End If v_MotCle = True End If End If Next
SItS_FormaterMatches = v_Formule Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SItS, gc_Element_SItS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SItS_TelephoneLD(Byval p_Pays As String, Byval p_Telephone As String) As String '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet d'ajouter le 1 devant le numéro de téléphone pour les ' appels longue distance. '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Telephone As String Dim v_CodeRegional As String Dim v_Prefixe As String
If p_Pays = "CA" Or p_Pays = "US" Then If SItS_TelephoneValide(p_Pays, p_Telephone, v_Telephone) Then v_CodeRegional = Left(v_Telephone, 3) v_Prefixe = Mid(v_Telephone, 5, 3) If xGDK_xValeurExisteTabl("CRL", v_CodeRegional, True) _ Or xGDK_xValeurExisteTabl("CR" & v_CodeRegional, v_Prefixe, True) Then SItS_TelephoneLD = v_Telephone Else SItS_TelephoneLD = "1 " & v_Telephone End If Else SItS_TelephoneLD = "" End If Else SItS_TelephoneLD = p_Telephone End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SItS, gc_Element_SItS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SItS_Initiales(Byval p_NomComplet As String, p_Methode As String) As String '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de séparer le nom du prénom d'une chaîne de caractères ' Méthodes: ' "1" ou "" : Première lettre du prénom et première lettre du nom de famille (Jean-Francois Grolier retourne JG) (longeur 2) ' "2" : Première lettre de chaque portion d'un nom composé (Jean-Francois Grolier retourne JFG) (longeur variable) ' "3" : Première lettre du prénom et deux première lettres du nom de famille (Jean-Francois Grolier retourne JGR) (longeur 3) ' "4" : Première lettre du prénom et deux première lettres du nom de famille (Jean-Francois Grolier retourne JFG) (longeur 3) '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim a As Variant Dim i As Integer
SItS_Initiales = ""
p_NomComplet = Ucase(Fulltrim(p_NomComplet)) If p_Methode = "2" Or p_Methode = "4" Then a = Evaluate(|@Explode("| & p_NomComplet & |"; " -")|) Else a = Split(p_NomComplet) End If
If p_Methode = "2" Or (p_Methode = "4" And Ubound(a) = 2) Then If Ubound(a) = 0 Then SItS_Initiales = Left(a(0), 2) Else For i = Lbound(a) To Ubound(a) SItS_Initiales = SItS_Initiales & Left(a(i), 1) Next End If Elseif p_Methode = "3" Or p_Methode = "4" Then If Ubound(a) = 0 Then SItS_Initiales = Left(a(0), 3) Elseif p_Methode = "3" Or Ubound(a) = 1 Then SItS_Initiales = Left(a(0), 1) & Left(a(Ubound(a)), 2) Else SItS_Initiales = Left(a(0), 1) & Left(a(Ubound(a) - 1), 1) & Left(a(Ubound(a)), 1) End If Else If Ubound(a) = 0 Then SItS_Initiales = Left(a(0), 2) Else SItS_Initiales = Left(a(0), 1) & Left(a(Ubound(a)), 1) End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SItS, gc_Element_SItS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SItS_FormaterTelephone(Byval p_Telephone As String, p_Langue As String) As String '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de formater un numéro de téléphone. ' Le format généré est 999 999-9999 x9 ou x9 représente un numéro d'extension. '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Telephone As String
SItS_FormaterTelephone = p_Telephone
v_Telephone = Lcase(p_Telephone) Call SItS_Remplacer(v_Telephone, " ", "") Call SItS_Remplacer(v_Telephone, "-", "") Call SItS_Remplacer(v_Telephone, "(", "") Call SItS_Remplacer(v_Telephone, ")", "") Call SItS_Remplacer(v_Telephone, ".", "") Call SItS_Remplacer(v_Telephone, "ext", "") Call SItS_Remplacer(v_Telephone, "x", "")
If Len(v_Telephone) > 0 And Isnumeric(v_Telephone) Then If Len(v_Telephone) > 10 And Left(v_Telephone, 1) = "1" Then v_Telephone = Right(v_Telephone, Len(v_Telephone) - 1) End If
If Len(v_Telephone) = 7 Then SItS_FormaterTelephone = Left(v_Telephone, 3) & "-" & Right(v_Telephone, 4) Elseif Len(v_Telephone) >= 10 Then If Ucase(p_Langue) = "EN" Then SItS_FormaterTelephone = "(" & Left(v_Telephone, 3) & ")" & " " & Mid(v_Telephone, 4, 3) & "-" & _ Mid(v_Telephone, 7, 4) Else SItS_FormaterTelephone = Left(v_Telephone, 3) & " " & Mid(v_Telephone, 4, 3) & "-" & _ Mid(v_Telephone, 7, 4) End If If Len(v_Telephone) > 10 Then SItS_FormaterTelephone = SItS_FormaterTelephone & " x" & _ Right(v_Telephone, Len(v_Telephone) - 10) End If End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SItS, gc_Element_SItS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SItS_NASValide(Byval p_NAS As String) As Integer '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de valider un numéro d'assurance sociale. ' Un numéro d'assurance sociale doit avoir 7 chiffres. '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim i As Integer Dim v As Integer Dim v_Somme As Integer
SItS_NASValide = False
p_NAS = Replace(p_NAS, " ", "") If p_NAS Like "#########" Then For i = 1 To 8 If i Mod 2 = 0 Then v = Cint(Mid(p_NAS, i, 1)) * 2 If v > 9 Then v_Somme = v_Somme + (v \ 10) + (v Mod 10) Else v_Somme = v_Somme + v End If Else v_Somme = v_Somme + Cint(Mid(p_NAS, i, 1)) End If Next
If (10 - (v_Somme Mod 10)) Mod 10 = Cint(Right(p_NAS, 1)) Then SItS_NASValide = True End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SItS, gc_Element_SItS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIwsD_TrouverTauxChange(p_Date As Variant, p_Devise As String) As Double ' ============================================= ' p_Date : La date pour laquelle on veut obtenir le taux ' p_Devise : La devise recherchée (ex.: "USD") ' Retourne le taux de change vs le dollar canadien pour la date spécifiée ' Ex.: 1 USD = 1,307 CAD ' ============================================= On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Date As String Dim v_Devise As string Dim wsc As NOTESRServices_n5 Dim n0_Input As RtvexchangerateInput_n5 Dim n0_Output As RtvexchangerateResult_n5
Dim v_Resultat As Variant Dim v_TauxChange As Double
Call SIwsD_Initialisations SIwsD_TrouverTauxChange = -1 If p_Date = "" Then v_Date = Format(Today, "YYYYMMDD") Else v_Date = Format(p_Date, "YYYYMMDD") End If v_Devise = xGDK_xCompTabl(p_Devise, "ISO4217xEN", "1", False) If v_Devise = "" Then SIwsD_TrouverTauxChange = -2 Exit function End If
Set wsc = New NOTESRServices_n5 Set n0_Input = New RtvexchangerateInput_n5 Set n0_Output = New RtvexchangerateResult_n5
n0_Input.E_curr = v_Devise Set n0_Input.E_date = New xsd_decimal If Len(v_Date) = 8 And Isnumeric(v_Date) Then Call n0_Input.E_date.Setvaluefromstring(v_Date) End If
Set n0_Output = wsc.rtvexchangerate(n0_Input) v_Resultat = n0_Output.E_ERRMSG If v_Resultat = "" Then v_Resultat = n0_Output.E_EXCHRATE.Getvalueasstring() v_TauxChange = SItN_cdbl(v_Resultat) If v_TauxChange <= 0 Then SIwsD_TrouverTauxChange = -3 Else SIwsD_TrouverTauxChange = v_TauxChange End If End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIwsD, gc_Element_SIwsD, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
