Declare Sub DoSleep Lib "kernel32" (ByVal dwMilliseconds As Long)
Declare Function FindExecutable Lib "shell32.dll" Alias "FindExecutableA" (ByVal lpFile As String,_ ByVal lpDirectory As String, ByVal lpResult As String) As Long

Sub PressKey(ByVal varVk As Variant, ByVal varScan As Variant) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PressKey PURPOSE: Picks up keys being pressed CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: varVK - the virtual key code of the key being pressed varScan - the keyboard scan code of the key being pressed CALLED BY: sub PushAKey CALLS: API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM keybd_event varVk, varScan, 0, 0 keybd_event varVk, varScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End Sub

Sub PushAKey(ByVal strChar As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushAKey PURPOSE: Traps the character being pressed via an API call CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strChar - character being pressed CALLED BY: subs PushKeys & PushShiftKey CALLS: sub PressKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intVirtualKey As Integer Dim intScan As Integer Dim strOEMChar As String
' // Get the virtual key code for this character intVirtualKey = VkKeyScan(Asc(strChar)) And &HFF
strOEMChar = " " ' // 2 character buffer CharToOem strChar, strOEMChar
' // Get the keyboard scan code for this key intScan = OemKeyScan(Asc(strOEMChar)) And &HFF
' // Press the key PressKey intVirtualKey, intScan End Sub

Sub PushKeys(ByVal strSource As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushKeys PURPOSE: Main routine which takes input and calls sub-routines to put together SendKeys CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strSource - text representing the key(s) we want to press CALLED BY: Whatever routine requires SendKeys CALLS: subs PushFNKey, PushAKey, PushShiftKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim lngCtr As Long Dim intVKScan As Integer Dim strSubString As String Dim intBracketCount As Integer Dim strOpenBracket As String Dim strCloseBracket As String Dim strTempChar As String
intShiftOn = False intControlOn = False intAltOn = False
' // Add a space to solve Mid$ problems. We won't process it. strSource = strSource + " " lngCtr = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) - 1
Select Case Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Case "+" ' // Shift key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, 0, 0 intShiftOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn shift off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intShiftOn = False Else ' // The next key is shifted lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 PushShiftKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) End If
Case "^" ' // Control key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intControlOn Then ' // Turn control on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, 0, 0 intControlOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn control off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intControlOn = False Else ' // The next key is controlled lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 If Not intControlOn Then intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If
Case "%" ' // Alt key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intAltOn Then ' // Turn Alt on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, 0, 0 intAltOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn alt off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intAltOn = False Else ' // The next key is Alted lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 If Not intAltOn Then intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If
Case "{" ' // Function keys lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" Do While lngCtr < Len(strSource) And Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) <> "}" strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Loop If Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) = "}" And Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) = "}" Then ' // Right brace PushShiftKey "}" lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Else PushFNKey strSubString End If
Case "A" To "Z", "!", "@", "#", "$", "&", "*", "(", ")", "_", "|", """", ":", "?", ">", "<" ' // Shifted keys PushShiftKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1)
Case "~" ' // The enter key PushFNKey "ENTER"
Case Else PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1)
End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Loop
If intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If If intControlOn Then ' // Turn control off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If If intAltOn Then ' // Turn alt off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If End Sub

Sub PushFNKey(strKeyCode As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushFNKey PURPOSE: Routine to handle function key presses - e.g. when shift or CTRL are required CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strKeyCode - CALLED BY: sub PushKeys when " { " is encountered which is SendKeys parlance denotes a function key like ALT, SHIFT or CTRL CALLS: MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intScanKey As Integer Dim lngNumberOfPushes As Long Dim lngCtr As Integer Dim strFunctionKey As String Dim strOriginalCode As String
On Error GoTo lblPushFNKey_Errs
' // Work out which function key to push and how many times If InStr(strKeyCode, " ") > 0 Then ' // We're doing this multiple times ' // Find the rightmost space, because we want to allow people to ' // output multiple words with spaces in them. e.g. "{Seven times 7}" lngCtr = Len(strKeyCode) Do While lngCtr > 1 And Mid$(strKeyCode, lngCtr, 1) <> " " lngCtr = lngCtr - 1 Loop strOriginalCode = Left$(strKeyCode, lngCtr - 1) strFunctionKey = UCase(strOriginalCode) ' // This may fail if not a number, in which case lngNumberOfPushes will be 1 lngNumberOfPushes = CInt(Right$(strKeyCode, Len(strKeyCode) - lngCtr)) Else ' // Once only lngNumberOfPushes = 1 strFunctionKey = UCase(strKeyCode) strOriginalCode = strKeyCode End If
' // Function Keys ' // BTW, if you're reading my code, I do the for-next loop in each case rather ' // than outside the select because I figured it might be faster to do one Select ' // and the for-next loop n-times than do both the for-next and the Select >n-times. Select Case strFunctionKey Case "BACKSPACE", "BS", "BKSP" ' // Backspace intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BACK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BACK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "BELL" ' // Bell = ^G intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BELL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BELL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "BREAK" ' // Break = ^C intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BREAK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BREAK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "CAPSLOCK", "CAPS" ' // Capslock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_CAPITAL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_CAPITAL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "DELETE", "DEL" ' // Delete intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DELETE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DELETE, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "DOWN" ' // Down Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DOWN, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DOWN, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "END" ' // End intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_END, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_END, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "ENTER", "RETURN" ' // Enter = ^M intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RETURN, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_RETURN, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "ESCAPE", "ESC" ' // Escape = ^[ intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_ESCAPE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_ESCAPE, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "FORMFEED", "FF" ' // Form feed = ^L intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_CLEAR, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_CLEAR, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "HELP" ' // Help intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_HELP, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_HELP, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "HOME" ' // Home intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_HOME, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_HOME, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "INSERT", "INS" ' // Insert intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_INSERT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_INSERT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "LEFT" ' // Left Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LEFT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_LEFT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "LINEFEED", "LF" ' // Linefeed = ^J intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LINEFEED, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_LINEFEED, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NEWLINE", "NL" ' // New line = Carriage return & Line Feed = ^M^J For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RETURN, 0) PressKey VK_RETURN, intScanKey intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LINEFEED, 0) PressKey VK_LINEFEED, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMLOCK" ' // Numeric Lock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMLOCK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMLOCK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PGDN", "PAGEDOWN", "NEXT" ' // Page Down intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NEXT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NEXT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PGUP", "PAGEUP", "PRIOR" ' // Page Up intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_PRIOR, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_PRIOR, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PRINTSCREEN", "PRTSC" ' // Print Screen intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_PRINT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_PRINT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "RIGHT" ' // Right Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RIGHT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_RIGHT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "SCROLLLOCK", "SCRLK" ' // Scroll lock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_SCROLL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_SCROLL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "TAB" ' // Tab = ^I intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_TAB, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_TAB, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "UP" ' // Up Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_UP, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_UP, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "SLEEP" ' // We sleep for a few seconds DoSleep lngNumberOfPushes * 1000 Case "F1" ' // F1 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F1, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F1, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F2" ' // F2 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F2, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F2, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F3" ' // F3 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F3, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F3, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F4" ' // F4 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F4, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F4, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F5" ' // F5 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F5, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F5, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F6" ' // F6 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F6, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F6, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F7" ' // F7 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F7, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F7, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F8" ' // F8 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F8, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F8, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F9" ' // F9 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F9, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F9, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F10" ' // F10 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F10, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F10, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F11" ' // F11 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F11, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F11, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F12" ' // F12 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F12, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F12, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F13" ' // F13 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F13, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F13, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F14" ' // F14 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F14, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F14, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F15" ' // F15 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F15, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F15, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F16" ' // F16 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F16, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F16, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F17" ' // F17 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F17, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F17, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F18" ' // F18 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F18, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F18, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F19" ' // F19 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F19, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F19, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F20" ' // F20 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F20, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F20, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F21" ' // F21 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F21, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F21, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F22" ' // F22 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F22, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F22, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F23" ' // F23 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F23, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F23, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F24" ' // F24 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F24, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F24, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD0" ' // Numeric Keypad 0 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD0, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD0, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD1" ' // Numeric Keypad 1 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD1, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD1, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD2" ' // Numeric Keypad 2 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD2, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD2, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD3" ' // Numeric Keypad 3 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD3, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD3, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD4" ' // Numeric Keypad 4 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD4, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD4, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD5" ' // Numeric Keypad 5 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD5, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD5, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD6" ' // Numeric Keypad 6 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD6, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD6, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD7" ' // Numeric Keypad 7 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD7, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD7, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD8" ' // Numeric Keypad 8 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD8, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD8, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD9" ' // Numeric Keypad 9 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD9, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD9, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADMULTIPLY", "NUMPAD*" ' // Numeric Keypad Multiply intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_MULTIPLY, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_MULTIPLY, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADADD", "NUMPAD+" ' // Numeric Keypad + intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_ADD, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_ADD, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADSUBTRACT", "NUMPAD-" ' // Numeric Keypad - intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_SUBTRACT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_SUBTRACT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADDECIMAL", "NUMPAD." ' // Numeric Keypad . intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DECIMAL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DECIMAL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADDIVIDE", "NUMPAD/" ' // Numeric Keypad / intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DIVIDE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DIVIDE, intScanKey Next lngCtr
Case "~", "!", "@", "#", "$", "%", "^", "&", "*", "(", ")", "_", "+","|", "{", "}",_ """", ":", "?", ">", "<" ' // Shifted keys For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PushShiftKey strOriginalCode Next lngCtr
Case Else ' // Ordinary keys For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PushKeys strOriginalCode Next lngCtr End Select Exit Sub
lblPushFNKey_Errs: ' // Should only occur when the number of pushes isn't an integer lngNumberOfPushes = 1 Resume Next End Sub

Sub PushShiftKey(ByVal strChar As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushShiftKey PURPOSE: Routine to handle key presses whcih include the "SHIFT" key CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strChar - key being pressed CALLED BY: subs PushKeys, PushFNKey CALLS: sub PushAKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intVKScan As Integer
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If
' // Push key PushAKey strChar
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If End Sub

Call Service.setCredentials( v_Utilisateur, v_MotDePasse) Call Service.SetSSLOptions(NOTES_SSL_ACCEPT_SITE_CERTS + NOTES_SSL_ACCEPT_EXPIRED_CERTS) Call Service.setTimeout(240000)

Const n5 = "http://notesr.wsbeans.iseries/" Class NOTESRServices_n5 As PortTypeBase
Sub NEW Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim nn As New NotesName(ns.CurrentDatabase.Server) Dim v_Serveur As String
If Lcase(nn.Common) = "zulu" Then v_Serveur = "sertidvp.serti.com:10043" Else v_Serveur = "serti.serti.com:10010" End If Call Service.Initialize ("HttpNotesrWsbeansIseriesNOTESR", _ "NOTESR.NOTESRServicesPort", "http://" & v_Serveur & "/web/services/NOTESRService/NOTESR", _ "NOTESRServices_n5")
End Sub
Function rtvexchangerate(arg0 As RtvexchangerateInput_n5) As RtvexchangerateResult_n5 Set rtvexchangerate = Service.Invoke("rtvexchangerate", arg0) End Function
End Class

code.lotusscript: Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Extractions" Use "x_GDK" ' ' Cette bibliothèque de script permet d'extraire un document ou un item d'un document. Les documents ' à extraire ne se trouvent pas dans la base de documents courante. Il faut rechercher la base de documents ' à utiliser dans le GDK. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être "x_NAB" ou "NAB" est ' l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' 2. Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, le nom de l'item qui contient ' la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Declarations). ' 3. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "NAB" par l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés. ' 4. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "Group" par l'identifiant du type de document. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés.

' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_xELrod Dim gndb_xNAB As Notesdatabase
' Section 2 - Définition des valeurs conservées dans la cache Dim gnv_Person_xNAB As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnv_PersonCN_xNAB As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Person_xNAB As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Group_xNAB As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Group_xNAB As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Server_xNAB As NotesView ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Server_xNAB As NotesDocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées
' Section 3 - Les constantes à définir Const gc_NomBD_xNAB = "Address Book" ' Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, tel que déclaré dans le GDK. Const gc_NomItemClePerson_xNAB = "" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVuePerson_xNAB = "V_Person23" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomVuePersonCN_xNAB = "V_Person21" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleGroup_xNAB = "ListName" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueGroup_xNAB = "V_Group20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleServer_xNAB = "ServerName" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueServer_xNAB = "($ServersLookup)" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche

Function xSDSI_xContainsTypI(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_Valeur As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Boolean ' Cette fonction vérifie si un champ multi-valeur contient la valeur recherchée. Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim ni As NotesItem
xSDSI_xContainsTypI = False Set nd = xSDSI_xndTypI(p_Cle, p_Cache) If Not (nd Is Nothing) Then If nd.HasItem(p_NomVar) Then Set ni = nd.GetFirstItem(p_NomVar) If ni.Contains(p_Valeur) Then xSDSI_xContainsTypI = True End If End If End If End Function

Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Extractions" Use "x_GDK" ' ' Cette bibliothèque de script permet d'extraire un document ou un item d'un document. Les documents ' à extraire ne se trouvent pas dans la base de documents courante. Il faut rechercher la base de documents ' à utiliser dans le GDK. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être "x_SICl" ou "SICl" est ' l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' 2. Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, le nom de l'item qui contient ' la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Declarations). ' 3. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "SICl" par l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés. ' 4. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "Clie" par l'identifiant du type de document. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés.

' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_xELrod Dim gndb_xSICl As Notesdatabase
' Section 2 - Définition des valeurs conservées dans la cache Dim gnd_Prof_SICl As NotesDocument Dim gnv_Tabl_xSICl As Notesview Dim gnd_Tabl_xSICl As Notesdocument Dim gnv_Clie_xSICl As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Clie_xSICl As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Clie23_xSICl As NotesView ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_GCli_xSICl As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_GCli20_xSICl As NotesView ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document
' Section 3 - Les constantes à définir Const gc_NomBD_xSICl = "SICl" ' Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents ' de recherche, tel que déclaré dans le GDK. Const gc_NomItemCleClie_xSICl = "Clie_ClientNoFmt" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueClie_xSICl = "V_Clie20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleGCli_xSICl = "GCli_NoGroupe" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueGCli20_xSICl = "V_GCli20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche

Function xSICl_xVarProf(Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable du profil de la base de documents.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSICl_Initialisation
' Extraire le document de profil If gnd_Prof_SICl Is Nothing Then Set gnd_Prof_SICl = gndb_xSICl.Getprofiledocument("F_Prof") End If
If gnd_Prof_SICl Is Nothing Then xSICl_xVarProf = p_ValeurNulle Else xSICl_xVarProf = xVar(gnd_Prof_SICl, p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End If End Function

Function xSICl_xValeurExisteTabl(Byval p_Cle As Variant, p_Valeur As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Integer Dim ni As NotesItem
xSICl_xValeurExisteTabl = False
If Not (xSICl_xndTabl(p_Cle, True) Is Nothing) Then Set ni = gnd_Tabl_xSICl.GetFirstItem("Tabl_Valeurs") If ni.Contains(p_Valeur) Then xSICl_xValeurExisteTabl = True End If End If End Function

Function xSICl_xDescTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As String ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Descriptions As Variant Dim i As Long
xSICl_xDescTabl = ""
' Extraire les valeurs et les descriptions v_Valeurs = xSICl_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Descriptions = xSICl_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Descriptions", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Descriptions) And i <= Ubound(v_Descriptions) Then xSICl_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then xSICl_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(0) Else xSICl_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions End If End If End If End Function

Function xSICl_xIcnTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Integer ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Icones As Variant Dim i As Long
xSICl_xIcnTabl = 0
' Extraire les valeurs et les Icones v_Valeurs = xSICl_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Icones = xSICl_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Icones", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Icones) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Icones) And i <= Ubound(v_Icones) Then xSICl_xIcnTabl = v_Icones(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Icones) Then xSICl_xIcnTabl = v_Icones(0) Else xSICl_xIcnTabl = v_Icones End If End If End If End Function

Function xSICl_xndClie(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document du type approprié.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSICl_Initialisation
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Call xnd(gc_NomItemCleClie_xSICl, p_Cle, p_Cache, gndb_xSICl, gc_NomVueClie_xSICl, gnv_Clie_xSICl, gnd_Clie_xSICl)
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xSICl_xndClie = gnd_Clie_xSICl End Function

Function xSICl_xVarClie(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document.
Dim nd As NotesDocument
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xnd) Set nd = xSICl_xndClie(p_Cle, p_Cache) xSICl_xVarClie = xVar(nd, p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End Function

Function xSICl_xndTabl(Byval pCle As Variant, Byval pCache As Integer) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document de type F_Tabl.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSICl_Initialisation
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Call xnd("Tabl_Nom", pCle, pCache, gndb_xSICl, "V_Tabl20", gnv_Tabl_xSICl, gnd_Tabl_xSICl) ' Paramètres: 1 String. Le nom du champs servant de clé dans le document recherché. ' 2 Variant. La valeur de la clé recherchée. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 3 Boolean. Indiquer True pour réutiliser le document en mémoire lorsqu'il correspond ' au document recherché. Si vous indiquez False, le document est relu même s'il est ' déjà en mémoire. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 4 Notesdatabase. La base de documents dans laquelle le document sera recherché. ' ** Déclarée dans les variables globales ** ' 5 String. Le nom de la vue de recherche. ' 6 Notesview. La vue de recherche. ** Déclarée dans les variables globales ** ' ' 7 Notesdocument. Le document recherché. S'il est déjà en mémoire et que Cache ' contient True, le document envoyé sera retourné. ' ** Déclarée dans les variables globales **
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xSICl_xndTabl = gnd_Tabl_xSICl End Function

Function xSICl_xVarTabl(Byval pCle As Variant, Byval pNomVar As String, Byval pValeurNulle As Variant, _ Byval pCache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document de type F_Tabl.
Dim nd As NotesDocument
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xnd) Set nd = xSICl_xndTabl(pCle, pCache) xSICl_xVarTabl = xVar(nd, pNomVar, pValeurNulle) ' Paramètres: 1 Notesdocument. Le document contenant la valeur recherchée. ' ** Appel de la fonction d'extraction du document ** ' 2 String. Le nom de la variable contenant la valeur recherchée. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 3 Variant. La valeur à retourner si la variable recherchée n'existe pas dans le document ' recherché. ** Ne pas modifier ** End Function

Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Extractions" Use "x_GDK" ' ' Cette bibliothèque de script permet d'extraire un document ou un item d'un document. Les documents ' à extraire ne se trouvent pas dans la base de documents courante. Il faut rechercher la base de documents ' à utiliser dans le GDK. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être "x_CPADoc" ou "CPADoc" est ' l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' 2. Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, le nom de l'item qui contient ' la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Declarations). ' 3. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "CPADoc" par l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés. ' 4. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "Docu" par l'identifiant du type de document. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés.

' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_xELrod Dim gndb_xSIDoc As Notesdatabase
' Section 2 - Définition des valeurs conservées dans la cache Dim gnd_Prof_xSIDoc As NotesDocument Dim gnvTabl_xSIDoc As Notesview Dim gndTabl_xSIDoc As Notesdocument Dim gnv_Docu_xSIDoc As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Docu_xSIDoc As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_TDoc20 As NotesView Dim gnd_TDoc As NotesDocument
' Section 3 - Les constantes à définir Const gc_NomBD_xSIDoc = "SI Documents" ' Nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, tel que déclaré dans le GDK. Const gc_NomItemCleDocu_xSIDoc = "Docu_NoDocument" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueDocu_xSIDoc = "V_Docu20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche

Function xSIDoc_xVarDocu(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document.
Dim nd As NotesDocument
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xnd) Set nd = xSIDoc_xndDocu(p_Cle, p_Cache) xSIDoc_xVarDocu = xVar(nd, p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End Function

Function xSIDoc_xndDocu(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document du type approprié.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSIDoc_Initialisations
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Call xnd(gc_NomItemCleDocu_xSIDoc, p_Cle, p_Cache, gndb_xSIDoc, gc_NomVueDocu_xSIDoc, gnv_Docu_xSIDoc, gnd_Docu_xSIDoc)
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xSIDoc_xndDocu = gnd_Docu_xSIDoc End Function

Function xSIDoc_Initialisations As Boolean xSIDoc_Initialisations = False
' Initialisation des variables globales If gndb_xSIDoc Is Nothing Then Set gndb_xSIDoc = xGDK_xndbNDB(gc_NomBD_xSIDoc) End If
If Not (gndb_xSIDoc Is Nothing) Then If gndb_xSIDoc.IsOpen Then xSIDoc_Initialisations = True End If End If End Function
Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_Extractions" Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "SI_Insertions"
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_A = "A" Const gc_Element_A = "os_46195"

Sub Initialize '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Ce script corrige les champs Prop_StatutDescFR et Prop_StatutDescEN. ' Exemple: "05-New" devient "05 - New" '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ns As Notessession Dim ndb As Notesdatabase Dim nv As Notesview Dim nd As Notesdocument Dim nd_Suivant As Notesdocument
Dim v_Maj As Boolean Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long Dim v_StatutEN As String Dim v_StatutDescEN As String Dim v_StatutFR As String Dim v_StatutDescFR As String
Print "Début" Call SIGE_OuvrirLog(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A)
Set ns = New Notessession Set ndb = ns.Currentdatabase Set nv = ndb.Getview("V_Prop20") ' Vue des propositions
Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1
' S'il n'y a pas d'espace de chaque côté du tiret du statut, corriger les descriptions
' Description en français v_StatutFR = StrLeft(xVar(nd, "Prop_StatutDescFR", ""), "-") If Len(v_StatutFR) = 2 Then v_StatutDescFR = StrRight(xVar(nd, "Prop_StatutDescFR", ""), "-") v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "Prop_StatutDescFR", v_StatutFR & " - " & v_StatutDescFR, False) End If
' Description en anglais v_StatutEN = StrLeft(xVar(nd, "Prop_StatutDescEN", ""), "-") If Len(v_StatutEN) = 2 Then v_StatutDescEN = StrRight(xVar(nd, "Prop_StatutDescEN", ""), "-") v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "Prop_StatutDescEN", v_StatutEN & " - " & v_StatutDescEN, False) Or v_Maj End If
' Sauvegarder les modifs If v_Maj Then Call nd.save(True, True) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 v_Maj = False End If
If (v_NbLus Mod 1000) = 0 Then Print Cstr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & Cstr(v_NbLus) End If Loop
Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Fin " & Cstr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & Cstr(v_NbLus), 0, 0, True) If v_NbMaj <> 0 Then Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), "", True) Exit Sub End Sub

Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "x_GDK" Use "x_SDSP3" Use "SI_Insertions" Use "x_SDSBB"

Dim g_NbMaj As Long Dim g_NbLus As Long
Const c_ndbAlias = "SDSP3" Const c_ndbAliasMSG = "SDSPP" ' Traitement des erreurs ' ---------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_A = "A" Const gc_Element_A = "OS_ExempterCommissions"

Sub Initialize %REM Boucler sur tous les équipements, logiciels Maj le champ XXXX_ExempterCommissions à partir de SDS Base (au besoin - SIIx_MajItem) Lister les maj dans un log pouvoir générer le log seulement
Dans le log, mettre # prop, type produit, code produit %END REM On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_MajEqui As Long Dim v_MajLogi As Long
Call A_Initialisations
' Log Call SIGE_OuvrirLog(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_TypeElement_A) Call SIGE_AjouterLog(" | Type | #Proposition | Code produit | Description | CleProposition",0,0, False) Call gnv_Prop.refresh()
' MAJ v_MajLogi = A_Maj("Logi") ' Logiciels v_MajEqui = A_Maj("Equi") ' Equipements
Print "Fin A_MajJ: " & CStr(g_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(g_NbLus) & " --- Equi: " & CStr(v_MajEqui) & " -- Logi: " & CStr(v_MajLogi) Call SIGE_AjouterLog( "Fin A_MajJ: " & CStr(g_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(g_NbLus) & " --- Equi: " & CStr(v_MajEqui) & " -- Logi: " & CStr(v_MajLogi), 0 , 0, False)
Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, LSI_Info(2), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
Sub A_Initialisations If gns_A Is Nothing Then Set gns_A = New NotesSession Set gndb_A = gns_A.Currentdatabase Set gnv_Prop = gndb_A.GetView("V_Prop20") ' Propositions End If End Sub

function A_Maj(p_Prefix As string) As Long On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nv As NotesView Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd_Base As NotesDocument Dim nd_Proposition As NotesDocument
Dim v_NoProposition As String Dim v_CleProposition As String Dim v_CodeProduit As String Dim v_DescProduit As String Dim v_nomChamp As String Dim v_nouvValeur As Variant Dim v_vue As string Dim v_MajDocument As Boolean
Dim v_Maj As Long
If p_Prefix = "Equi" Then v_Vue = "V_Equi11" ElseIf p_Prefix = "Logi" then v_Vue = "V_Logi11" Else Exit Function End If
Set nv = gndb_A.Getview(v_Vue) Call nv.refresh() Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
g_NbLus = g_NbLus + 1 v_MajDocument = False
Set nd_Base = xSDSBB_xndProd_Code( xVar(nd, p_Prefix & "_Code", ""), True)
v_nomChamp = p_Prefix & "_ExempterCommission" If xVarContient(nd_Base, "Prod_PropOptions", "EC") Then v_nouvValeur = "1" 'xVar(nd_Base, "Prod_PropOptions", "") else v_nouvValeur = "" End if
v_MajDocument = SIIx_MajItem(nd, v_nomChamp, v_nouvValeur, False) ' Or v_MajDocument If v_MajDocument Then
' Call nd.save(True, True) g_NbMaj = g_NbMaj + 1 v_Maj = v_Maj + 1 v_CleProposition = xVar(nd, "CleProposition", "") If v_CleProposition <> "" Then Set nd_Proposition = gndb_A.getdocumentbyUNID(v_CleProposition) v_NoProposition = xVar(nd_Proposition, "Prop_NbProposition", "--ND--") ' ====== CHAMP à DÉTERMINER End If v_CodeProduit = xVar(nd, p_Prefix & "_Code", "--ND--") v_DescProduit = xVar(nd, p_Prefix & "_DescriptionFR", "") Call SIGE_AjouterLog(" | " & p_Prefix & " | " & v_NoProposition & " | " & v_CodeProduit & " | " & v_DescProduit & " | " & v_CleProposition,0,0, False) End If
If (g_NbLus Mod 1000) = 0 Then Print CStr(g_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(g_NbLus) End If Loop
A_Maj = v_Maj Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, LSI_Info(2), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCIm_GenererSuccursale(pnd_Succ As notesdocument, pnrti_Body As NotesRichTextItem) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de générer le document image lié à une succursale. ' ' Paramètres: ' pnd_Succ : document de la succursale. ' pnrti_Body : champ Rich Text qui recevra l'image de la succursale. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_T_Succ As NotesDocument Dim nrti_SICT_Message As NotesRichTextItem
' Initialisations SDSCIm_GenererSuccursale = False
Set nd_T_Succ = xndSICT("T_Succ", False) Set nrti_SICT_Message = nd_T_Succ.GetFirstItem("SICT_Message" & g_LangueProp_SDSCIm)
If Not pnrti_Body Is Nothing Then
' Générer l'entête de la succursale If Not SDSCIm_GenererEnteteSucc(pnd_Succ, nrti_SICT_Message) Then Exit Function End If
' Générer l'identification de la succursale If Not SDSCIm_GenererIdentificationSucc(pnd_Succ, nrti_SICT_Message) Then Exit Function End If
' Générer le résumé de la succursale If Not SDSCIm_GenererResumeSucc(pnd_Succ, nrti_SICT_Message) Then Exit Function End If
' Ajouter au document image Call pnrti_Body.AppendRTItem(nrti_SICT_Message)
' Générer l'équipement de la succursale If Not SDSCIm_GenererEquipement(pnd_Succ, pnrti_Body) Then Exit Function End If
' Générer les logiciels de la succursale If Not SDSCIm_GenererLogiciels(pnd_Succ, pnrti_Body) Then Exit Function End If
' Générer les services de la succursale If Not SDSCIm_GenererServices(pnd_Succ, pnrti_Body) Then Exit Function End If End If
SDSCIm_GenererSuccursale = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCIm, gc_Element_SDSCIm, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCIm_AjouterLogiciels(pnd_Logiciels() As NotesDocument, pnrti_Body As NotesRichTextItem) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de générer le tableau des logiciels de la succursale. ' ' Paramètres: ' pnd_Logiciels : document des logiciels ' pnrti_Body : champ Rich Text qui recevra le tableau des logiciels de la succursale '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim rt_Body As notesrichtextitem Dim nrti_gnd_T_Succ_LogiEnt As notesrichtextitem Dim nrti_pnd_PrIM As notesrichtextitem Dim nrti_SICT_Message As notesrichtextitem
' Initialisations SDSCIm_AjouterLogiciels = False
' Ajouter entête du logiciel Set nrti_SICT_Message = gnd_T_Succ_LogiEnt.GetFirstItem("SICT_Message" & g_LangueProp_SDSCIm) Call pnrti_Body.AppendRTItem(nrti_SICT_Message)
' Construire le tableau des logiciels Set rt_Body = New notesrichtextitem(gnd_T_Succ_LogiEnt,"Body") 'créer un champ body temporaire pour générer le tableau Call rt_Body.AppendText("[Succ_Resume_Logiciel]") Call SICT_AjouterTableau(gnd_T_Succ_LogiEnt, "[Succ_Resume_Logiciel]", pnd_Logiciels, ga_Formules_LG, ga_Couleurs, ga_LargeurColonnes_LG, _ ga_Entetes_LG, 0 )
' Ajouter le tableau dans le document image Set nrti_gnd_T_Succ_LogiEnt = gnd_T_Succ_LogiEnt.GetFirstItem("Body") Call pnrti_Body.AppendRTItem(nrti_gnd_T_Succ_LogiEnt)
SDSCIm_AjouterLogiciels = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCIm, gc_Element_SDSCIm, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCIm_GenererResumeSucc(pnd_Succ As NotesDocument, pnrti_SICT_Message As notesrichtextitem) As Boolean '-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de générer l'image du résumé de la succursale ' ' Paramètres: ' pnd_Succ : document de la succursale ' pnrti_SICT_Message : champ Rich Text qui recevra l'image du résumé de la succursale '-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim Succ_ResumeNomChamps(14) As String Dim Succ_ResumeValeurChamps(14) As Variant Dim v_Succ_PrixTotalEQ As Double Dim v_Succ_CoutTotalEQ As Double Dim v_Succ_PrixTotalLG As Double Dim v_Succ_CoutTotalLG As Double Dim v_Succ_PrixTotalSV As Double Dim v_Succ_CoutTotalSV As Double Dim v_Succ_EntretienAnnuelEQ As Double Dim v_Succ_EntretienAnnuelLG As Double Dim v_Succ_EntretienAnnuelSV As Double
' Initialisations SDSCIm_GenererResumeSucc = False
' Champs du résumé de la succursale ' Succursale - Equipement Succ_ResumeNomChamps(0) = "Prop_PrixTotalEQ" Succ_ResumeNomChamps(1) = "Prop_CoutTotalEQ" Succ_ResumeNomChamps(2) = "Prop_ProfitEQ" ' Succursale - Logiciels Succ_ResumeNomChamps(3) = "Prop_PrixTotalLG" Succ_ResumeNomChamps(4) = "Prop_CoutTotalLG" Succ_ResumeNomChamps(5) = "Prop_ProfitLG" ' Succursale - Services Succ_ResumeNomChamps(6) = "Prop_PrixTotalSV" Succ_ResumeNomChamps(7) = "Prop_CoutTotalSV" Succ_ResumeNomChamps(8) = "Prop_ProfitSV"
' Succursale - Total Succ_ResumeNomChamps(9) = "Prop_PrixTotalSucc" Succ_ResumeNomChamps(10) = "Prop_CoutTotalSucc" Succ_ResumeNomChamps(11) = "Prop_ProfitSucc"
' Entretien - Logiciels Succ_ResumeNomChamps(14) = "Prop_EntretienMensuelLG" Succ_ResumeNomChamps(12) = "Prop_EntretienAnnuelLG" Succ_ResumeNomChamps(13) = "Prop_EntretienAnnuelSDS"
' Valeurs des champs du résumé de la succursale ' Équipement v_Succ_PrixTotalEQ = xEvaluate( |@Sum(@IfError(@DbLookup("" : "NoCache"; "| & gndb_xSDSP3.Server & |" : "| &_ Replace(gndb_xSDSP3.FilePath, "\", "\\") & |"; "V_Prod30"; "| & xVar(pnd_Succ, "Site_NoSite", "") &_ |"+ ";EQ."; 5 ;[PartialMatch]); 0))|, Nothing)
v_Succ_CoutTotalEQ = xEvaluate( |@Sum(@IfError(@DbLookup("" : "NoCache"; "| & gndb_xSDSP3.Server & |" : "| &_ Replace(gndb_xSDSP3.FilePath, "\", "\\") & |"; "V_Prod30"; "| & xVar(pnd_Succ, "Site_NoSite", "") &_ |"+ ";EQ."; 7 ;[PartialMatch]); 0))|, Nothing)
' Logiciel v_Succ_PrixTotalLG = xEvaluate( |@Sum(@IfError(@DbLookup("" : "NoCache"; "| & gndb_xSDSP3.Server & |" : "| &_ Replace(gndb_xSDSP3.FilePath, "\", "\\") & |"; "V_Prod30"; "| & xVar(pnd_Succ, "Site_NoSite", "") &_ |"+ ";LG."; 5 ;[PartialMatch]); 0))|, Nothing)
v_Succ_CoutTotalLG = xEvaluate( |@Sum(@IfError(@DbLookup("" : "NoCache"; "| & gndb_xSDSP3.Server & |" : "| &_ Replace(gndb_xSDSP3.FilePath, "\", "\\") & |"; "V_Prod30"; "| & xVar(pnd_Succ, "Site_NoSite", "") &_ |"+ ";LG."; 7 ;[PartialMatch]); 0))|, Nothing)
v_Succ_EntretienAnnuelLG = xEvaluate( |@Sum(@IfError(@DbLookup("" : "NoCache"; "| & gndb_xSDSP3.Server & |" : "| &_ Replace(gndb_xSDSP3.FilePath, "\", "\\") & |"; "V_Prod30"; "| & xVar(pnd_Succ, "Site_NoSite", "") &_ |"+ ";LG."; 8 ;[PartialMatch]); 0))|, Nothing)
' Service v_Succ_PrixTotalSV = xEvaluate( |@Sum(@IfError(@DbLookup("" : "NoCache"; "| & gndb_xSDSP3.Server & |" : "| &_ Replace(gndb_xSDSP3.FilePath, "\", "\\") & |"; "V_Prod30"; "| & xVar(pnd_Succ, "Site_NoSite", "") &_ |"+ ";SV."; 5 ;[PartialMatch]); 0))|, Nothing)
v_Succ_CoutTotalSV = xEvaluate( |@Sum(@IfError(@DbLookup("" : "NoCache"; "| & gndb_xSDSP3.Server & |" : "| &_ Replace(gndb_xSDSP3.FilePath, "\", "\\") & |"; "V_Prod30"; "| & xVar(pnd_Succ, "Site_NoSite", "") &_ |"+ ";SV."; 7 ;[PartialMatch]); 0))|, Nothing)
v_Succ_EntretienAnnuelSV = xEvaluate( |@Sum(@IfError(@DbLookup("" : "NoCache"; "| & gndb_xSDSP3.Server & |" : "| &_ Replace(gndb_xSDSP3.FilePath, "\", "\\") & |"; "V_Prod30"; "| & xVar(pnd_Succ, "Site_NoSite", "") &_ |"+ ";SV."; 8 ;[PartialMatch]); 0))|, Nothing)
Succ_ResumeValeurChamps(0) = SDSCIm_FormatDevise(v_Succ_PrixTotalEQ, g_LangueProp_SDSCIm) Succ_ResumeValeurChamps(1) = SDSCIm_FormatDevise(v_Succ_CoutTotalEQ, g_LangueProp_SDSCIm) Succ_ResumeValeurChamps(2) = SDSCIm_FormatDevise((v_Succ_PrixTotalEQ - v_Succ_CoutTotalEQ), g_LangueProp_SDSCIm) Succ_ResumeValeurChamps(3) = SDSCIm_FormatDevise(v_Succ_PrixTotalLG, g_LangueProp_SDSCIm) Succ_ResumeValeurChamps(4) = SDSCIm_FormatDevise(v_Succ_CoutTotalLG, g_LangueProp_SDSCIm) Succ_ResumeValeurChamps(5) = SDSCIm_FormatDevise((v_Succ_PrixTotalLG - v_Succ_CoutTotalLG), g_LangueProp_SDSCIm) Succ_ResumeValeurChamps(6) = SDSCIm_FormatDevise(v_Succ_PrixTotalSV, g_LangueProp_SDSCIm) Succ_ResumeValeurChamps(7) = SDSCIm_FormatDevise(v_Succ_CoutTotalSV, g_LangueProp_SDSCIm) Succ_ResumeValeurChamps(8) = SDSCIm_FormatDevise((v_Succ_PrixTotalSV - v_Succ_CoutTotalSV), g_LangueProp_SDSCIm) Succ_ResumeValeurChamps(9) = SDSCIm_FormatDevise((v_Succ_PrixTotalEQ + v_Succ_PrixTotalLG + v_Succ_PrixTotalSV), g_LangueProp_SDSCIm) Succ_ResumeValeurChamps(10) = SDSCIm_FormatDevise((v_Succ_CoutTotalEQ + v_Succ_CoutTotalLG + v_Succ_CoutTotalSV), g_LangueProp_SDSCIm) Succ_ResumeValeurChamps(11) = SDSCIm_FormatDevise((v_Succ_PrixTotalEQ + v_Succ_PrixTotalLG + v_Succ_PrixTotalSV) - (v_Succ_CoutTotalEQ + v_Succ_CoutTotalLG + v_Succ_CoutTotalSV), g_LangueProp_SDSCIm) Succ_ResumeValeurChamps(14) = SDSCIm_FormatDevise(v_Succ_EntretienAnnuelLG / 12, g_LangueProp_SDSCIm) Succ_ResumeValeurChamps(12) = SDSCIm_FormatDevise(v_Succ_EntretienAnnuelLG, g_LangueProp_SDSCIm) Succ_ResumeValeurChamps(13) = SDSCIm_FormatDevise((v_Succ_EntretienAnnuelLG * 5), g_LangueProp_SDSCIm)
Call SDSCIm_RemplacerSignets(pnrti_SICT_Message,Succ_ResumeNomChamps,Succ_ResumeValeurChamps)
SDSCIm_GenererResumeSucc = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCIm, gc_Element_SDSCIm, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SDSCIm_Initialisations(pnd_Prop As NotesDocument)
If gns_SDSCIm Is Nothing Then Set gns_SDSCIm = New Notessession Set gndb_SDSCIm= gns_SDSCIm.Currentdatabase
Call xSDSP3_Initialisations
' Initialise la langue (langue du rep.) g_LangueProp_SDSCIm = xSIRR_xVarRepr(xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoRepresentant", ""), "Repr_Langue", "FR", True)
' Initialiser les courriels types Set gnd_T_Succ_EquiEnt = xndSICT("T_Succ_EquiEnt", False) Set gnd_T_Succ_LogiEnt = xndSICT("T_Succ_LogiEnt", False) Set gnd_T_Succ_ServEnt = xndSICT("T_Succ_ServEnt", False)
' Définir les colonnes du tableau ga_Couleurs(0) = COLOR_WHITE ga_Couleurs(1) = Evaluate("236:231:213")
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Intialise variables pour tableau des équipements '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Définir les formules du tableau ga_Formules_EQ(0) = |@Text(Prod_DepartementDesc| & g_LangueProp_SDSCIm & |)| ga_Formules_EQ(1) = |@Text(Prod_CodeProduit)| ga_Formules_EQ(2) = |@Text(Prod_DescProduit| & g_LangueProp_SDSCIm & |)| ga_Formules_EQ(3) = |@Text(Prod_Quantite)| ga_Formules_EQ(4) = |@Text(Prod_PrixUnitaire;| & |"F2"| & | )| ga_Formules_EQ(5) = |@Text(Prod_PrixTotal;| & |"F2"| & | )| ga_Formules_EQ(6) = |@Text(Prod_CoutUnitaire;| & |"F2"| & | )| ga_Formules_EQ(7) = |@Text(Prod_CoutTotal;| & |"F2"| & | )| ga_Formules_EQ(8) = |@Text((Prod_PrixTotal - Prod_CoutTotal) ;| & |"F2"| & | )|
' Définir les colonnes du tableau ga_LargeurColonnes_EQ(0) = 2.5 ga_LargeurColonnes_EQ(1) = 2.5 ga_LargeurColonnes_EQ(2) = 3 ga_LargeurColonnes_EQ(3) = 1 ga_LargeurColonnes_EQ(4) = 1.5 ga_LargeurColonnes_EQ(5) = 1.5 ga_LargeurColonnes_EQ(6) = 1.5 ga_LargeurColonnes_EQ(7) = 1.5 ga_LargeurColonnes_EQ(8) = 1.5
' Définir les entêtes du tableau ga_Entetes_EQ(0) = "Dept." ga_Entetes_EQ(1) = "Code" ga_Entetes_EQ(2) = "Description"
If g_LangueProp_SDSCIm = "EN" Then ga_Entetes_EQ(3) = "Qty" ga_Entetes_EQ(4) = "Unit Price" ga_Entetes_EQ(5) = "Total Price" ga_Entetes_EQ(6) = "Unit Cost" ga_Entetes_EQ(7) = "Total Cost" ga_Entetes_EQ(8) = "Profit" Else ga_Entetes_EQ(3) = "Qté" ga_Entetes_EQ(4) = "Prix unitaire" ga_Entetes_EQ(5) = "Prix total" ga_Entetes_EQ(6) = "Coût unitaire" ga_Entetes_EQ(7) = "Coût total" ga_Entetes_EQ(8) = "Profit" End If
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Intialise variables pour tableau des logiciels '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Définir les formules du tableau ga_Formules_LG(0) = |@Text(Prod_CategorieDesc| & g_LangueProp_SDSCIm & |)| ga_Formules_LG(1) = |@Text(Prod_CodeProduit)| ga_Formules_LG(2) = |@Text(Prod_DescProduit| & g_LangueProp_SDSCIm & |)| ga_Formules_LG(3) = |@Text(Prod_Quantite)| ga_Formules_LG(4) = |@Text(Prod_PrixUnitaire;| & |"F2"| & | )| ga_Formules_LG(5) = |@Text(Prod_PrixTotal;| & |"F2"| & | )| ga_Formules_LG(6) = |@Text((Prod_PrixTotal - Prod_CoutTotal) ;| & |"F2"| & | )| ga_Formules_LG(7) = |@Text((Prod_Quantite * (@If(@IsNull(Prod_FraisEntretienAnnuels); 0; Prod_FraisEntretienAnnuels))) ;| & |"F2"| & | )|
' Définir les colonnes du tableau ga_LargeurColonnes_LG(0) = 2.5 ga_LargeurColonnes_LG(1) = 2.5 ga_LargeurColonnes_LG(2) = 3 ga_LargeurColonnes_LG(3) = 1 ga_LargeurColonnes_LG(4) = 1.5 ga_LargeurColonnes_LG(5) = 1.5 ga_LargeurColonnes_LG(6) = 1.5 ga_LargeurColonnes_LG(7) = 1.5
' Définir les entêtes du tableau ga_Entetes_LG(0) = "Cat." ga_Entetes_LG(1) = "Code" ga_Entetes_LG(2) = "Description"
If g_LangueProp_SDSCIm = "EN" Then ga_Entetes_LG(3) = "Qty" ga_Entetes_LG(4) = "Unit Price" ga_Entetes_LG(5) = "Total Price" ga_Entetes_LG(6) = "Profit" ga_Entetes_LG(7) = "Annual" Else ga_Entetes_LG(3) = "Qté" ga_Entetes_LG(4) = "Prix unitaire" ga_Entetes_LG(5) = "Prix total" ga_Entetes_LG(6) = "Profit" ga_Entetes_LG(7) = "Annuel" End If
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Intialise variables pour tableau des services '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Définir les formules du tableau ga_Formules_SV(0) = |@Text(Prod_CategorieDesc| & g_LangueProp_SDSCIm & |)| ga_Formules_SV(1) = |@Text(Prod_CodeProduit)| ga_Formules_SV(2) = |@Text(Prod_DescProduit| & g_LangueProp_SDSCIm & |)| ga_Formules_SV(3) = |@Text(Prod_Quantite)| ga_Formules_SV(4) = |@Text(Prod_PrixUnitaire;| & |"F2"| & | )| ga_Formules_SV(5) = |@Text(Prod_PrixTotal;| & |"F2"| & | )| ga_Formules_SV(6) = |@Text(Prod_CoutUnitaire;| & |"F2"| & | )| ga_Formules_SV(7) = |@Text(Prod_CoutTotal;| & |"F2"| & | )| ga_Formules_SV(8) = |@Text((Prod_PrixTotal - Prod_CoutTotal) ;| & |"F2"| & | )|
' Définir les colonnes du tableau ga_LargeurColonnes_SV(0) = 2.5 ga_LargeurColonnes_SV(1) = 2.5 ga_LargeurColonnes_SV(2) = 3 ga_LargeurColonnes_SV(3) = 1 ga_LargeurColonnes_SV(4) = 1.5 ga_LargeurColonnes_SV(5) = 1.5 ga_LargeurColonnes_SV(6) = 1.5 ga_LargeurColonnes_SV(7) = 1.5 ga_LargeurColonnes_SV(8) = 1.5
' Définir les entêtes du tableau ga_Entetes_SV(0) = "Cat." ga_Entetes_SV(1) = "Code" ga_Entetes_SV(2) = "Description"
If g_LangueProp_SDSCIm = "EN" Then ga_Entetes_SV(3) = "Qty" ga_Entetes_SV(4) = "Unit Price" ga_Entetes_SV(5) = "Total Cost" ga_Entetes_SV(6) = "Unit Cost" ga_Entetes_SV(7) = "Total Cost" Else ga_Entetes_SV(3) = "Qté" ga_Entetes_SV(4) = "Prix unitaire" ga_Entetes_SV(5) = "Prix total" ga_Entetes_SV(6) = "Coût unitaire" ga_Entetes_SV(7) = "Coût total" End If
ga_Entetes_SV(8) = "Profit" End If
End Sub

Function SDSCIm_GenererEnteteSucc(pnd_Succ As NotesDocument, pnrti_SICT_Message As notesrichtextitem) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de générer l'image de la succursale. ' ' Paramètres: ' pnd_Succ : document de la succursale ' pnrti_SICT_Message : champ Rich Text qui recevra l'image de la succursale '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim Succ_EnteteNomChamps(1) As String Dim Succ_EnteteValeurChamps(1) As Variant
' Initialisations SDSCIm_GenererEnteteSucc = False
' Champs de l'entête de la succursale Succ_EnteteNomChamps(0) = "Succ_ClientNom" Succ_EnteteNomChamps(1) = "Succ_BanniereDesc"
' Valeur des champs de l'entête de la succursale Succ_EnteteValeurChamps(0) = xVar(pnd_Succ,"Succ_ClientNom","") Succ_EnteteValeurChamps(1) = xVarImplode(pnd_Succ, "Succ_BanniereDesc", ", ")
Call SDSCIm_RemplacerSignets(pnrti_SICT_Message,Succ_EnteteNomChamps,Succ_EnteteValeurChamps)
SDSCIm_GenererEnteteSucc = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCIm, gc_Element_SDSCIm, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCIm_GenererSuccursales(pnd_Prop As notesdocument) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de générer le document image lié à une succursale. ' ' Paramètres: ' pnd_Prop : document de la proposition '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_PrIm As NotesDocument Dim nd_Succursale As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim ndc_Succursales As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nrti_Body As NotesRichTextItem Dim nv_Succ11 As NotesView
' Initialisations Call SDSCIm_Initialisations(pnd_Prop) SDSCIm_GenererSuccursales = False
' Créer le document qui contient l'image de la proposition Set nd_PrIm = pnd_Prop
' Créer le champ qui recevra l'image de la succursale If Not nd_PrIm Is Nothing Then Set nrti_Body = New NotesRichTextItem(nd_PrIm, "Body") End If
' Batir la liste des succursales Set nv_Succ11 = gndb_SDSCIm.Getview("V_Succ11") Set ndc_Succursales = xndc(xVar(nd_PrIm, "Prop_Unid", ""), gndb_SDSCIm, "V_Succ11", nv_Succ11)
If ndc_Succursales.Count > 0 Then Set nd_Suivant = ndc_Succursales.GetFirstDocument
Print "--------------- Générér succursales " Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd_Succursale = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc_Succursales.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
If Not SDSCIm_GenererSuccursale(nd_Succursale, nrti_Body) Then Exit Function End If
Loop End If
' Compacter le champ Rich Text des succursales If Not (nrti_Body Is Nothing) Then Call nrti_Body.compact End If
Call nd_PrIM.save(True,False)
SDSCIm_GenererSuccursales = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCIm, gc_Element_SDSCIm, Getthreadinfo(1), _ xVar(nd_PrIm, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCIm_GenererLogiciels(pnd_Succ As NotesDocument, pnrti_Body As NotesRichTextItem) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de générer une liste des logiciels ' ' Paramètres: ' pnd_Succ : document de la succursale ' pnrti_Body : champ Rich Text qui recevra la liste des logiciels '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv As NotesView Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Suivant As Notesdocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Logiciels() As NotesDocument Dim k As Integer
' Initialisations SDSCIm_GenererLogiciels = False k = -1 Redim Preserve nd_Logiciels(1000) As NotesDocument
' Générer les logiciels Set nv = gndb_xSDSP3.GetView("V_Prod30") Call nv.Refresh
Set ndc = nv.GetAllDocumentsByKey((xVar(pnd_Succ, "Site_NoSite", "") & ";LG."), False)
If ndc.Count > 0 Then
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.GetFirstDocument
Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing
Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
' Ne pas traiter les composants If xVar(nd, "Prod_TypeDescendant", "") <> "C" And xVar(nd, "Prod_Quantite", "") <> 0 Then k = k +1
nd.Tmp_CleTri = xVar(nd, "Prod_CategorieProduit", "") & ";" & xVar(nd, "Prod_CategorieDesc" & g_LangueProp_SDSCIm, "") & ";" &xVar(nd, "Prod_DescProduit" & g_LangueProp_SDSCIm, "")
Set nd_Logiciels(k) = nd If k = 253 Then Exit Do ' Limit de 255 lignes dans un tableau. Si cela arrive, créer tableau avec premier 255 records. End If End If
Loop
If k >= 0 Then Redim Preserve nd_Logiciels(k) As NotesDocument
Call TrierArrayDocs(nd_Logiciels, "Tmp_CleTri", "")
If Not SDSCIm_AjouterLogiciels(nd_Logiciels, pnrti_Body) Then Exit Function End If
End If End If
SDSCIm_GenererLogiciels = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCIm, gc_Element_SDSCIm, Getthreadinfo(1), _ xVar(pnd_Succ, "Site_NoSite", ""), False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SDSCIm_RemplacerSignets(pnrti_SICT_Message As notesrichtextItem, p_NomChamps As Variant, p_ValeurChamps As Variant) '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de remplacer des signets ' ' Paramètres: ' pnrti_SICT_Message : champ Rich Text qui contient l'image de la succursale ' p_NomChamps : nom du champ signet ' p_ValeurChamps : valeur à insérer dans le signet '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim i As Integer
If Isarray(p_NomChamps) Then For i = Lbound(p_NomChamps) To Ubound(p_ValeurChamps)
If Cstr(p_ValeurChamps(i)) = "" Then p_ValeurChamps(i) = " " End If
Call SItRT_Remplacer(pnrti_SICT_Message, "[" & p_NomChamps(i) & "]", p_ValeurChamps(i)) Next Else Call SItRT_Remplacer(pnrti_SICT_Message, "[" & p_NomChamps & "]", p_ValeurChamps) End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCIm, gc_Element_SDSCIm, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SDSCIm_FormatDevise(p_Montant As Double, p_Langue As String) As String On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Montant As String
v_Montant = SItN_Format(p_Montant, "Standard")
If p_Langue = "FR" Then SDSCIm_FormatDevise = v_Montant & " $" Else SDSCIm_FormatDevise = "$" & v_Montant End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCIm, gc_Element_SDSCIm, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCIm_GenererEquipement(pnd_Succ As NotesDocument, pnrti_Body As NotesRichTextItem) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de générer une liste des équipements. ' ' Paramètres: ' pnd_Succ : document de la succursale ' pnrti_Body : champ Rich Text qui recevra la liste des équipements '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv As NotesView Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Suivant As Notesdocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Equipments() As NotesDocument Dim k As Integer
' Initialisations SDSCIm_GenererEquipement = False k = -1 Redim Preserve nd_Equipments(1000) As NotesDocument
' Générer l'équipement Set nv = gndb_xSDSP3.GetView("V_Prod30") Call nv.Refresh
Set ndc = nv.GetAllDocumentsByKey((xVar(pnd_Succ, "Site_NoSite", "") & ";EQ."), False)
If ndc.Count > 0 Then Set nd_Suivant = ndc.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
' Ne pas traiter les composants If xVar(nd, "Prod_TypeDescendant", "") <> "C" And xVar(nd, "Prod_Quantite", "") <> 0 Then k = k +1
nd.Tmp_CleTri = xVar(nd, "Prod_DepartementDesc" & g_LangueProp_SDSCIm, "") & ";" & xVar(nd, "Prod_CategorieDesc" & g_LangueProp_SDSCIm, "") & ";" & _ xVar(nd, "Prod_DescProduit" & g_LangueProp_SDSCIm, "")
Set nd_Equipments(k) = nd If k = 253 Then Exit Do ' Limit de 255 lignes dans un tableau. Si cela arrive, créer tableau avec premier 255 records. End If End If Loop
If k >= 0 Then Redim Preserve nd_Equipments(k) As NotesDocument Call TrierArrayDocs(nd_Equipments, "Tmp_CleTri", "")
If Not SDSCIm_AjouterEquipments(nd_Equipments, pnrti_Body) Then Exit Function End If End If End If
SDSCIm_GenererEquipement = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCIm, gc_Element_SDSCIm, Getthreadinfo(1), _ xVar(pnd_Succ, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCIm_GenererIdentificationSucc(pnd_Succ As NotesDocument , pnrti_SICT_Message As notesrichtextitem) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de générer l'image de l'identification d'un Succ_Resume. ' ' Paramètres: ' pnd_Succ : document de la succursale ' pnrti_SICT_Message : champ Rich Text qui recevra l'image de l'identification de la succursale '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim Succ_IdentificationNomChamps(9) As String Dim Succ_IdentificationValeurChamps(9) As Variant Dim i As Integer
' Initialisations SDSCIm_GenererIdentificationSucc = False
' Champs de l'identification de la succursale Succ_IdentificationNomChamps(0) = "Succ_ClientAdresse1" Succ_IdentificationNomChamps(1) = "Succ_ClientAdresse2" Succ_IdentificationNomChamps(2) = "Succ_ClientVille" Succ_IdentificationNomChamps(3) = "Succ_ClientCodePostal" Succ_IdentificationNomChamps(4) = "Succ_ContactNom" Succ_IdentificationNomChamps(5) = "Succ_ContactFonction" Succ_IdentificationNomChamps(6) = "Succ_ContactTitre" Succ_IdentificationNomChamps(7) = "Succ_ContactTelephone" Succ_IdentificationNomChamps(8) = "Succ_ContactTelecopieur" Succ_IdentificationNomChamps(9) = "Succ_ContactCourriel"
' Valeur des champs de l'identification de la succursale For i = Lbound(Succ_IdentificationNomChamps) To Ubound(Succ_IdentificationNomChamps) Succ_IdentificationValeurChamps(i) = xVar(pnd_Succ,Succ_IdentificationNomChamps(i) ,"") Next
Call SDSCIm_RemplacerSignets(pnrti_SICT_Message,Succ_IdentificationNomChamps,Succ_IdentificationValeurChamps)
' Pays & Province Call SDSCIm_RemplacerSignets(pnrti_SICT_Message , "Succ_ClientProvince",xEvaluate( |@Replace(Succ_ClientProvince; @IfError(@DbLookup(""; @ServerName : "SI_GDK.nsf"; "V_Tabl20"; "ISO3166-2| & "CA" & g_LangueProp_SDSCIm & |"; 4); ""); @IfError(@DbLookup(""; @ServerName : "SI_GDK.nsf"; "V_Tabl20"; "ISO3166-2| & "CA" & g_LangueProp_SDSCIm & |"; 5); "")) |, pnd_Succ)) Call SDSCIm_RemplacerSignets(pnrti_SICT_Message , "Succ_ClientPays",xEvaluate( |@Replace(Succ_ClientPays; @IfError(@DbLookup(""; @ServerName : "SI_GDK.nsf"; "V_Tabl20"; "ISO3166-1| & g_LangueProp_SDSCIm & |"; 4); ""); @IfError(@DbLookup(""; @ServerName : "SI_GDK.nsf"; "V_Tabl20"; "ISO3166-1| & g_LangueProp_SDSCIm & |"; 5); "")) |, pnd_Succ))
SDSCIm_GenererIdentificationSucc = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCIm, gc_Element_SDSCIm, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCIm_AjouterEquipments(pnd_Equipements() As Notesdocument, pnrti_Body As NotesRichTextItem) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de générer le tableau des équipments de la succursale ' ' Paramètres: ' pnd_Equipements : document des équipements ' pnrti_Body : champ Rich Text qui recevra le tableau des équipments de la succursale '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim rt_Body As notesrichtextitem Dim nrti_gnd_T_Succ_EquiEnt As notesrichtextitem Dim nrti_pnd_PrIM As notesrichtextitem Dim nrti_SICT_Message As notesrichtextitem
' Initialisations SDSCIm_AjouterEquipments = False
' Ajouter entête de l'équipement Set nrti_SICT_Message = gnd_T_Succ_EquiEnt.GetFirstItem("SICT_Message" & g_LangueProp_SDSCIm) Call pnrti_Body.AppendRTItem(nrti_SICT_Message)
' Construire le tableau des Produits Set rt_Body = New notesrichtextitem(gnd_T_Succ_EquiEnt,"Body") 'créer un champ body temporaire pour générer le tableau Call rt_Body.AppendText("[Succ_Resume_Equipement]") Call SICT_AjouterTableau(gnd_T_Succ_EquiEnt, "[Succ_Resume_Equipement]", pnd_Equipements, ga_Formules_EQ, ga_Couleurs, ga_LargeurColonnes_EQ, _ ga_Entetes_EQ, 0 )
' Ajouter le tableau dans le document image Set nrti_gnd_T_Succ_EquiEnt = gnd_T_Succ_EquiEnt.GetFirstItem("Body") Call pnrti_Body.AppendRTItem(nrti_gnd_T_Succ_EquiEnt)
SDSCIm_AjouterEquipments = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCIm, gc_Element_SDSCIm, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCIm_AjouterServices(pnd_Services() As NotesDocument, pnrti_Body As NotesRichTextItem) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de générer le tableau des services de la succursale. ' ' Paramètres: ' pnd_Services : document des services ' pnrti_Body : champ Rich Text qui recevra le tableau des services de la succursale '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim rt_Body As notesrichtextitem Dim nrti_gnd_T_Succ_ServEnt As notesrichtextitem Dim nrti_pnd_PrIM As notesrichtextitem Dim nrti_SICT_Message As notesrichtextitem
' Initialisations SDSCIm_AjouterServices = False 'Set nrti_pnd_PrIM = pnd_PrIM.GetFirstItem("Body")
' Ajouter entête du logiciel Set nrti_SICT_Message = gnd_T_Succ_ServEnt.GetFirstItem("SICT_Message" & g_LangueProp_SDSCIm) Call pnrti_Body.AppendRTItem(nrti_SICT_Message)
' Construire le tableau des Services Set rt_Body = New notesrichtextitem(gnd_T_Succ_ServEnt,"Body") 'créer un champ body temporaire pour générer le tableau Call rt_Body.AppendText("[Succ_Resume_Service]") Call SICT_AjouterTableau(gnd_T_Succ_ServEnt, "[Succ_Resume_Service]", pnd_Services, ga_Formules_SV, ga_Couleurs, ga_LargeurColonnes_SV, _ ga_Entetes_SV, 0 )
' Ajouter le tableau dans le document image Set nrti_gnd_T_Succ_ServEnt= gnd_T_Succ_ServEnt.GetFirstItem("Body") Call pnrti_Body.AppendRTItem(nrti_gnd_T_Succ_ServEnt)
SDSCIm_AjouterServices = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCIm, gc_Element_SDSCIm, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCIm_GenererServices(pnd_Succ As NotesDocument, pnrti_Body As NotesRichTextItem) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de générer une liste des services ' ' Paramètres: ' pnd_Succ : document de la cuccursale ' pnrti_Body : champ Rich Text qui recevra la liste des services '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv As NotesView Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Suivant As Notesdocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Services() As NotesDocument Dim k As Integer
' Initialisations SDSCIm_GenererServices = False k = -1 Redim Preserve nd_Services(1000) As NotesDocument
' Générer les services Set nv = gndb_xSDSP3.GetView("V_Prod30") Call nv.Refresh
Set ndc = nv.GetAllDocumentsByKey((xVar(pnd_Succ, "Site_NoSite", "") & ";SV."), False)
If ndc.Count > 0 Then
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.GetFirstDocument
Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing
Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
' Ne pas traiter les composants If xVar(nd, "Prod_TypeDescendant", "") <> "C" And xVar(nd, "Prod_Quantite", "") <> 0 Then k = k +1
nd.Tmp_CleTri = xVar(nd, "Prod_CategorieProduit", "") & ";" & xVar(nd, "Prod_CategorieDesc" & g_LangueProp_SDSCIm, "") & ";" & xVar(nd, "Prod_DescProduit" & g_LangueProp_SDSCIm, "")
Set nd_Services(k) = nd If k = 253 Then Exit Do ' Limit de 255 lignes dans un tableau. Si cela arrive, créer tableau avec premier 255 records. End If End If
Loop
If k >= 0 Then
Redim Preserve nd_Services(k) As NotesDocument
Call TrierArrayDocs(nd_Services, "Tmp_CleTri", "")
If Not SDSCIm_AjouterServices(nd_Services, pnrti_Body) Then
Exit Function End If End If End If
SDSCIm_GenererServices = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCIm, gc_Element_SDSCIm, Getthreadinfo(1), _ xVar(pnd_Succ, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), False) Exit Function End Function
