Dim gns_A As NotesSession Dim gndb_A As NotesDatabase
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_A = "A" Const gc_Element_A = "A_PropStat"

Sub Initialize '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Ce script est exécuté par SDS Pro SL "SDSP_Workflow" ' Le script permet de faire une mise à jour de statut d'une proposition '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndb_Temp_SITp As NotesDatabase Dim nd_Temp As NotesDocument Dim nd_Prop As NotesDocument Dim v_NoProposition As String Dim v_Statut As String Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim v_Username As String
Dim v_DocId As String Dim v_Maj As Boolean
'Initialisations Print "Début A_PropStat" Call SIGE_OuvrirLog(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A) Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Début A_PropStat", 0, 0, False)
Call A_Initialisations
v_Maj = False
' Trouver le document de travail '--------------------------------- v_DocId = gns_A.Currentagent.ParameterDocId
Set ndb_Temp_SITp = xGDK_xndbNDB("SITp") If ndb_Temp_SITp Is Nothing Then Exit Sub ElseIf Not ndb_Temp_SITp.IsOpen Then Exit Sub End If
If v_DocId = "" Then Exit Sub End If
Set nd_Temp = ndb_Temp_SITp.Getdocumentbyid(v_DocId)
If nd_Temp Is Nothing Then Exit Sub End If
' Set nd_Prop = gndb_A.Getdocumentbyunid("2A399588231C2288852583C40060EF63") " DEBUG
v_NoProposition = xVar(nd_Temp, "Prop_NoProposition", "")
Set nd_Prop = xSDSC3_xndProp(v_NoProposition, True)
If nd_Prop Is Nothing Then Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Document proposition " & xVar(nd_Temp, "Prop_NoProposition", "") & "introuvable", 0, 0, False) Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog Exit Sub Else Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Document proposition trouvé", 0, 0, False) End If
v_Statut = xVar(nd_Temp, "Prop_Statut", "") v_Commentaire = xVar(nd_Temp, "Prop_Commentaire", "") v_UserName = xVar(nd_Temp, "Prop_UserName", "")
' Assigner le nouveau statut de la proposition If SDSPP_AssignerStatut(nd_Prop, v_Statut, False, v_Commentaire, v_UserName) Then Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Statut de la proposition" & CStr(xVar(nd_Prop, "Prop_NbProposition", "")) & " modifié pour " & v_Statut, 0, 0, False)
If v_Statut = "90" Or v_Statut = "92" Then
v_Statut = "95"
If A_ChangerStatutProposition(v_NoProposition, v_Statut, v_Commentaire, "SDSC3") Then Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Statut de la proposition" & CStr(xVar(nd_Prop, "Prop_NbProposition", "")) & " modifié pour " & v_Statut, 0, 0, False)
End If
End If
End If
Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Fin A_PropStat", 0, 0, False) Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), v_DocId, False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function A_ChangerStatutProposition(p_NoProposition As String, p_Statut As String, _ p_Commentaire As String, p_UserName As String) As Boolean
A_ChangerStatutProposition = False
Dim nd_Prop As NotesDocument Dim nd_DB As NotesDocument Dim v_Origine As String Dim v_StatutProp As String
Dim ws_Proposition As Cl_Proposition Dim ws_Proposition2 As Cl_Proposition2
'Initialisations If p_UserName = "" Then p_UserName = gns_A.UserName End If
Set nd_Prop = xSDSP3_xndProp(p_NoProposition, True)
If Not nd_Prop Is Nothing Then v_Origine = "SDSP3" Else Set nd_Prop = xSDSPP_xndProp(p_NoProposition, True) If Not nd_Prop Is Nothing Then v_Origine = "SDSPP" End If End If
If Not nd_Prop Is Nothing Then
If v_Origine = "SDSP3" Then Set nd_DB = SITp_ndTemp("SDSP3.acChangerStatut") nd_DB.Form = "DB_Stat" nd_DB.DB_Commentaire = p_Commentaire Call nd_DB.Save(True, False)
Set ws_Proposition = New Cl_proposition v_StatutProp = ws_Proposition.ChangerStatutSDSP3(p_NoProposition, p_Statut, p_UserName, nd_DB.UniversalId) Else Set nd_DB = SITp_ndTemp("SDSPP.acChangerStatut") nd_DB.Form = "DB_Stat" nd_DB.DB_Commentaire = p_Commentaire Call nd_DB.Save(True, False)
Set ws_Proposition2 = New Cl_proposition2 v_StatutProp = ws_Proposition2.Changerstatutsdspp(p_NoProposition, p_Statut, p_UserName, nd_DB.UniversalId) End If End If
If v_StatutProp <> "" Then A_ChangerStatutProposition = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), p_NoProposition, False) Exit Function End Function

Dim gns_A As NotesSession Dim gndb_A As NotesDatabase

Sub Initialize On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As Notesdocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd_Comm As NotesDocument Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection
Dim v_Formule As String Dim v_Commentaire As String
Dim v_NoDernLigneHisto As Long Dim v_NoDernLigneHistoSDSPro As Long Dim v_NoDernLigneHistoSDSC As Long Dim v_NouvDateHisto As Variant Dim db As NotesDatabase
Dim nd_Prop As NotesDocument Dim v_StatutProp As String Dim v_Origine As String Dim i As Integer Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long Dim v_NomItem As String Dim v_Unid As String
Print "Début" Call A_Initialisations Call SIGE_OuvrirLog(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A)
v_Commentaire = "Synchronization of status 85 with Proposals and SI Commissions."
'v_Formule = |Form = "F_Prop" & PROP_STATUT = "80" & Prop_NoProposition != ""|
v_Formule = |Form = "F_Prop" & Cle="BN3RENR295"| Set ndc = gndb_A.Search(v_Formule, Nothing, 0)
If ndc.Count = 0 Then Exit Sub End If
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument
Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing
Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) v_Unid = nd.Universalid
v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1
Set nd_Prop = xSDSP3_xndProp(xVar(nd, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), True) If Not nd_Prop Is Nothing Then v_Origine = "SDSP3" Else Set nd_Prop = xSDSPP_xndProp(xVar(nd, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), True) If Not nd_Prop Is Nothing Then v_Origine = "SDSP2" End If End If
If Not nd_Prop Is Nothing Then
v_StatutProp = xVar(nd_Prop, "Prop_Statut", "")
'If v_StatutProp = "80" Then If v_StatutProp = "80" Then Print xVar(nd_Prop, "Prop_NbPropositionTXT","")
v_NoDernLigneHistoSDSPro = SIHi_NoDerniereLigne(nd_Prop)
For i = v_NoDernLigneHistoSDSPro To 1 Step -1 v_NomItem = "SIHi_Statut" & CStr(i) If Left(Xvar(nd_Prop, v_NomItem, ""), 2) = v_StatutProp Then v_NouvDateHisto = xVar(nd_Prop,"SIHi_Date" & CStr(i), "") Exit For End If Next
If Not SDSPP_AssignerStatut(nd, "85", False, v_Commentaire, gns_A.Username) Then 'If Not SDSPP_AssignerStatut(nd, "85", False, v_Commentaire, gns_A.Username) Then Exit sub End If
Set nd_Comm = gndb_A.Getdocumentbyunid(v_Unid) v_NoDernLigneHistoSDSC= SIHi_NoDerniereLigne(nd_Comm)
Call nd_Comm.replaceitemvalue("SIHi_Date" & CStr(v_NoDernLigneHistoSDSC), v_NouvDateHisto) Call nd_Comm.replaceitemValue("Prop_StatutDate", v_NouvDateHisto) Call nd_Comm.Save(True, False) Call SIHi_BatirHistorique(nd_Comm)
End if End If
loop
Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Fin " & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus), 0, 0, True) Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), "", True) Exit Sub End Sub

Dim gns_A As NotesSession Dim gndb_A As NotesDatabase
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_A = "A" Const gc_Element_A = "A_osCorrigerStat95" ' Inscrire l'alias de l'agent

Sub Initialize On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As Notesdocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument DIm nd_Site As NotesDocument Dim nd_SiteSuivant As NotesDocument Dim nd_BCom As NotesDocument Dim nd_BCom2 As NotesDocument Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim ndc_Sites As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_DB As NotesDocument Dim v_Formule As String Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim v_PrixTotal As Variant Dim a_StatutBC As Variant Dim v_NoBCSite As String Dim nd_Prop As NotesDocument Dim nd_PropSDSP As NotesDocument Dim v_StatutProp As String Dim v_StatutBC As String Dim v_Origine As String Dim v_changerstatut As String Dim i As Integer Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long Dim v_Unid As String Dim v_StatutDate As Variant Dim v_NoDernLigneHistoSDSP As Long Dim v_NoDernLigneHistoSIBDC As Long Dim ndb As notesDatabase
Print "Début" Call A_Initialisations Call SIGE_OuvrirLog(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A)
v_Commentaire = "" ' & Prop_NoRepresentant != ""
v_Formule = |Form = "F_Prop" & PROP_STATUT = "92" & Prop_NoProposition != ""| Set ndc = gndb_A.Search(v_Formule, Nothing, 0)
If ndc.Count = 0 Then Exit Sub End If
v_Commentaire = "Synchronization of status 95 With Proposals and SI Commissions."
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument
Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing
Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
v_StatutDate = xVar(nd, "Prop_StatutDate", "")
v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1
Set nd_Prop = xSDSP3_xndProp(xVar(nd, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), True)
If Not nd_Prop Is Nothing Then v_Origine = "SDSP3" Set ndc_Sites = xSDSP3_xndcSite(xVar(nd_Prop, "Prop_NoProposition", "")) v_Unid = nd_Prop.Universalid
Else Set nd_Prop = xSDSPP_xndProp(xVar(nd, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), True)
If Not nd_Prop Is Nothing Then v_Origine = "SDSPP" Set ndc_Sites = xSDSPP_xndcSite(xVar(nd_Prop, "Prop_NoProposition", "")) v_Unid = nd_Prop.Universalid End If End If
If Not nd_Prop Is Nothing Then
v_StatutProp = xVar(nd_Prop, "Prop_Statut", "")
If v_StatutProp = "80" Then
Set nd_DB = SITp_ndTemp(v_Origine & ".acChangerStatut") nd_DB.Form = "DB_Stat" nd_DB.DB_Commentaire = v_Commentaire Call nd_DB.Save(True, False)
Print xVar(nd, "Prop_NoProposition", "")
v_changerstatut = A_ChangerStatutProp(v_Origine, xVar(nd, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), "95", gns_A.Username , nd_DB.UniversalId)
'Set ndb = xGDK_xndbNDB(v_Origine) Set nd_PropSDSP = A_ndProp(v_Origine, v_Unid, xVar(nd, "Prop_NoProposition", ""))
If v_changerstatut <> "" Then
v_NoDernLigneHistoSDSP= SIHi_NoDerniereLigne(nd_PropSDSP)
Call nd_PropSDSP.replaceitemvalue("SIHi_Date" & CStr(v_NoDernLigneHistoSDSP), v_StatutDate) Call nd_PropSDSP.replaceitemValue("Prop_StatutDate", v_StatutDate) Call nd_PropSDSP.Save(True, False) Call SIHi_BatirHistorique(nd_PropSDSP)
If ndc_Sites.Count > 0 Then
ReDim a_StatutBC(ndc_Sites.Count -1) i = 0
Set nd_SiteSuivant = ndc_Sites.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_SiteSuivant Is Nothing Set nd_Site = nd_SiteSuivant Set nd_SiteSuivant = ndc_Sites.Getnextdocument(nd_SIteSuivant) v_NoBCSite = xVar(nd_Site, "Site_NoBonCommandeFmtSIBDC" , "")
If v_NoBCSite <> "" Then Set nd_BCom = xSIBDC2_xndBCom(v_NoBCSite, True)
v_Unid = nd_BCom.Universalid
If Not nd_BCom Is Nothing Then If xVar(nd_BCom, "BCom_Statut", "") = "80" Then Print v_NoBCSite
If A_ChangerStatutBC(v_NoBCSite, "95", v_Commentaire, gns_A.Username) <> 0 Then a_StatutBC(i) = xVar(nd_BCom, "BCom_NoBonCommandeFmt", "") & " (" & xVar(nd_BCom, "BCom_Statut", "") & ")"
Set nd_BCom2 = gndb_xSIBDC2.Getdocumentbyunid(v_Unid)
v_NoDernLigneHistoSIBDC= SIHi_NoDerniereLigne(nd_BCom2)
Call nd_BCom2.replaceitemvalue("SIHi_Date" & CStr(v_NoDernLigneHistoSIBDC), v_StatutDate) Call nd_BCom2.replaceitemValue("BCom_StatutDate", v_StatutDate) Call nd_BCom2.Save(True, False) Call SIHi_BatirHistorique(nd_BCom2) End If
Else If xVar(nd_BCom, "BCom_Statut", "") = "95" Then v_NoDernLigneHistoSIBDC= SIHi_NoDerniereLigne(nd_BCom) Call nd_BCom.replaceitemvalue("SIHi_Date" & CStr(v_NoDernLigneHistoSIBDC), v_StatutDate) Call nd_BCom.replaceitemValue("BCom_StatutDate", v_StatutDate) Call nd_BCom.Save(True, False) Call SIHi_BatirHistorique(nd_BCom) End if
End If End If i = i + 1 End If v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 Loop
a_StatutBC = FullTrim(a_StatutBC) a_StatutBC = Implode(a_StatutBC, ";") End If
End If
Call SIGE_AjouterLog(v_Origine & " / " & "Proposition : " & xVar(nd_Prop, "PROP_NBPROPOSITIONTXT", "") & " 90 -> 95 " & _ " --> " & "Statut BC : " & a_StatutBC & " -> 95 ." , 0, 0, True)
End If
End If
If (v_NbLus Mod 1000) = 0 Then Print CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus) End If Loop
Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Fin " & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus), 0, 0, True) Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), "", True) Exit Sub End Sub
Sub A_Initialisations If gns_A Is Nothing Then Set gns_A = New NotesSession Set gndb_A = gns_A.Currentdatabase End If End Sub

A_ChangerStatutProp= ""

If p_Origine = "SDSP3" Then A_ChangerStatutProp = ws_Proposition.ChangerStatutSDSP3(p_NoProposition, p_Statut, p_UserName , p_Unid) ElseIf p_Origine = "SDSPP" Then A_ChangerStatutProp = ws_Proposition2.ChangerStatutSDSPP(p_NoProposition, p_Statut, p_UserName , p_Unid) End If

If p_Origine = "SDSP3" Then Set nd_PropSDSP = xSDSP3_xndProp(p_NoProp, False) ElseIf p_Origine = "SDSPP" Then Set nd_PropSDSP = xSDSPP_xndProp(p_NoProp, False) End If
Set A_ndProp = nd_PropSDSP End Function

code.lotusscript: Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Extractions" Use "x_GDK" ' ' Cette bibliothèque de script permet d'extraire un document ou un item d'un document. Les documents ' à extraire ne se trouvent pas dans la base de documents courante. Il faut rechercher la base de documents ' à utiliser dans le GDK. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être "x_SIBDC2" ou "SIBDC2" est ' l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' 2. Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, le nom de l'item qui contient ' la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Declarations). ' 3. Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "x_SIBDT" Use "x_SIBDC2" Use "x_SDSP3"

' Déclarations globales ' --------------------- Dim gns_SDSBT As NotesSession Dim gndb_SDSBT As NotesDatabase
' Traitement des erreurs ' ---------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SDSBT = "SL" Const gc_Element_SDSBT = "SDSC_BonsTravail"

Sub Terminate
End Sub
Sub SDSBT_Initialisations If gns_SDSBT Is Nothing Then Set gns_SDSBT = New NotesSession Set gndb_SDSBT = gns_SDSBT.Currentdatabase End If End Sub

Function SDSBT_BonsTravailFacture(pnd_Prop As NotesDocument, pa_NoBonsCommandeEnCours As Variant) As Boolean 'Cette Fonction permet de vérifier si tous BT sont facturé 'Parametres: pnd: L'objet document de la proposition
On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_Prop_SDSP3 As NotesDocument
Dim a_NoBonsCommande As Variant Dim i As Integer Dim v_NoBonCommande As String Dim v_NoProposition As String Dim v_ServeurSIBDT As String Dim v_ServeurSDSP3 As String Dim v_StatutBonsTravail As Variant Dim v_StatutBonsTravail_ATraiter As Variant Dim v_StatutBonsTravail_Max As Variant Dim v_StatutBonsTravail_Min As Variant Dim v_StatutBonCommande As String Dim a_NoBonsCommandeEnCours As Variant
SDSBT_BonsTravailFacture = False
'Initialisations Call SDSBT_Initialisations
v_NoProposition = xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoProposition", "")
v_ServeurSIBDT = xGDK_xFormulaNDB("SIBDT") v_ServeurSDSP3 = xGDK_xFormulaNDB("SDSP3")
Set nd_Prop_SDSP3 = xSDSP3_xndProp(v_NoProposition, True)
If Not nd_Prop_SDSP3 Is Nothing Then a_NoBonsCommande = Evaluate(|@DbLookup("":"NoCache"; |& v_ServeurSDSP3 & |; "V_Site21";"|& v_NoProposition &|";10; [FAILSILENT])|)
If IsArray(a_NoBonsCommande) Then
If a_NoBonsCommande(LBound(a_NoBonsCommande)) = "" Then SDSBT_BonsTravailFacture = True Exit Function End If
ReDim a_NoBonsCommandeEnCours(UBound(a_NoBonsCommande))
For i = 0 To UBound(a_NoBonsCommande)
v_NoBonCommande = a_NoBonsCommande(i) v_StatutBonCommande = xSIBDC2_xVarBCom(v_NoBonCommande, "BCom_Statut", "", True)
v_StatutBonsTravail = Evaluate(|@DbLookup("":"NoCache"; |& v_ServeurSIBDT & |; "V_BTra21";"|& v_NoBonCommande &|";5; [FAILSILENT])|)
If v_StatutBonsTravail(0) = "" Then ' SI aucun BT
If v_StatutBonCommande >= "90" And v_StatutBonCommande < "99" Then SDSBT_BonsTravailFacture = True Else SDSBT_BonsTravailFacture = False a_NoBonsCommandeEnCours(i) = v_NoBonCommande End If
Else v_StatutBonsTravail_ATraiter = Evaluate(|@Trim(@Replace(@Explode("| & Implode(v_StatutBonsTravail) & |");"99";""))|) v_StatutBonsTravail_Min = Evaluate(|@Min(@Explode("| & Implode(v_StatutBonsTravail_ATraiter) & |"))|) v_StatutBonsTravail_Max = Evaluate(|@Max(@Explode("| & Implode(v_StatutBonsTravail_ATraiter) & |"))|)
If v_StatutBonsTravail_Max(0) = "92" And v_StatutBonsTravail_Min(0) = "92" Then SDSBT_BonsTravailFacture = True Else SDSBT_BonsTravailFacture = False a_NoBonsCommandeEnCours(i) = v_NoBonCommande End If End If
Next
End If
If IsArray(a_NoBonsCommandeEnCours) Then pa_NoBonsCommandeEnCours = FullTrim(a_NoBonsCommandeEnCours) Else pa_NoBonsCommandeEnCours = a_NoBonsCommandeEnCours End If
End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSBT, gc_Element_SDSBT, LSI_Info(2), _ xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), False) Exit Function End Function

' Doit avoir le rôle Admin pour utiliser cette action v_Roles = Evaluate(|@IsMember("[Admin]"; @UserRoles)|) If v_Roles(0) <> 1 Then Messagebox "Vous n'êtes pas autorisé à utiliser cette action.", 16, "Opération annulée" Exit Sub End If
Set ndb = ns.Currentdatabase Set ndc = ndb.UnprocessedDocuments If ndc.Count = 0 Then Print "Aucun document sélectionné" Exit Sub End If

v_Statut = xVar(nd_DB, "DB_Statut", "") v_Commentaire = xVar(nd_DB, "DB_Commentaire", "")
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1

v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If

Dim ns As Notessession Dim ndb As Notesdatabase Dim nv As Notesview Dim nd As Notesdocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_PropSDSP As NotesDocument Dim v_StatutSDSP As String Dim v_StatutSDSC As String Dim v_Formule As String Dim v_PrixTotal As Double Dim v_Escompte As Double Dim v_Origine As String
Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long Dim v_NbTrouve As Long
%REM Dans les commissions, vérifier s'il y a des PP qui ont un statut entre 45 et 50 et dont la valeur de la PP (Prop_PrixTotalSucc) - escompte est 0. Il ne devrait pas y en avoir. %END REM
Print "Début" Call SIGE_OuvrirLog(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A) Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Debut", 0, 0, True) Set ns = New Notessession Set ndb = ns.Currentdatabase
v_Formule = |Form = "F_Prop" & PROP_STATUT => "45" & PROP_STATUT =< "49"| v_Formule = |Form = "F_Prop" & PROP_NoProposition = "BPLLYBR361"|
Set ndc = ndb.Search(v_Formule, Nothing, 0)
If ndc.Count = 0 Then Exit Sub End If
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1
v_StatutSDSC = xVar(nd, "Prop_Statut", "")
Set nd_PropSDSP = xSDSP3_xndProp(xVar(nd, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), True)
If Not nd_PropSDSP Is Nothing Then v_Origine = "SDSP3" Else Set nd_PropSDSP = xSDSPP_xndProp(xVar(nd, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), True)
If Not nd_PropSDSP Is Nothing Then v_Origine = "SDSPP" End If End If
v_StatutSDSP = xVar(nd_PropSDSP, "Prop_Statut", "") v_PrixTotal = A_PrixTotal(nd_PropSDSP, v_Origine, True) v_Escompte = (xVar(nd_PropSDSP, "Prop_EscompteMontant", 0) + xVar(nd_PropSDSP, "Prop_EscompteCorporatif", 0))
If (v_PrixTotal - v_Escompte) = 0 Then v_NbTrouve = v_NbTrouve + 1 Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Proposition " & ":" & cstr(CInt(xVar(nd, "Prop_NbProposition", ""))) & " // " & "Statut" & v_Origine & ":" & v_StatutSDSP & " / " & "PrixTotal=" & v_PrixTotal & _ " / " & "StatutSDSC " & ":" & v_StatutSDSC & " / " & "Escompte " & ":" & v_Escompte & "." , 0, 0, False)
End If
''Call nd.save(True, True) ''v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 ' Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Document " & X & " mis à jour.", 0, 0, False)
If (v_NbLus Mod 1000) = 0 Then Print Cstr(v_NbTrouve) & "/" & Cstr(v_NbLus) End If Loop
Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Fin " & Cstr(v_NbTrouve) & "/" & Cstr(v_NbLus), 0, 0, True) 'If v_NbMaj <> 0 Then Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog 'End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), "", True) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub Terminate
End Sub

Function A_PrixTotal(pnd_Prop As NotesDocument, p_Origine As String, p_ProdCommissionable As Boolean) As Double ' -------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de déterminer le prix total d'une proposition. ' Si les prix totaux EQ, LG et SV ne sont pas requis, passer 0 en paramètre. ' -------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_PrixEQ As Variant Dim v_PrixLG As Variant Dim v_PrixSV As Variant Dim v_NoProp As String Dim v_ServeurSDSPP As String ' Initialisations A_PrixTotal = 0
v_NoProp = xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoProposition", "") v_ServeurSDSPP = xGDK_xFormulaNDB(p_Origine)
If p_ProdCommissionable = False Then
v_PrixEQ = Evaluate({@Sum(@IfError(@DbLookup("";} & v_ServeurSDSPP & {; "V_Prod23"; "} & _ (v_NoProp & ";" & "EQ.") & {"; 5; [PARTIALMATCH]); 0))}) v_PrixLG = Evaluate({@Sum(@IfError(@DbLookup("";} & v_ServeurSDSPP & {; "V_Prod23"; "} & _ (v_NoProp & ";" & "LG.") & {"; 5; [PARTIALMATCH]); 0))}) v_PrixSV = Evaluate({@Sum(@IfError(@DbLookup("";} & v_ServeurSDSPP & {; "V_Prod23"; "} & _ (v_NoProp & ";" & "SV.") & {"; 5; [PARTIALMATCH]); 0))})
Else
v_PrixEQ = Evaluate({@Sum(@IfError(@DbLookup("";} & v_ServeurSDSPP & {; "V_Prod21"; "} & _ (v_NoProp & ";" & "EQ.") & {"; 4; [PARTIALMATCH]); 0))}) v_PrixLG = Evaluate({@Sum(@IfError(@DbLookup("";} & v_ServeurSDSPP & {; "V_Prod21"; "} & _ (v_NoProp & ";" & "LG.") & {"; 8; [PARTIALMATCH]); 0))}) v_PrixSV = Evaluate({@Sum(@IfError(@DbLookup("";} & v_ServeurSDSPP & {; "V_Prod21"; "} & _ (v_NoProp & ";" & "SV.") & {"; 5; [PARTIALMATCH]); 0))})
End If
A_PrixTotal = v_PrixEQ(0) + v_PrixLG(0) + v_PrixSV(0)
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", True) Exit Function End Function

code.lotusscript: Option Public Option Declare Use "SDSC_Proposition" Use "SI_Exportations" Use "SI_Temp"

' Déclarations globales ' --------------------- Dim gns_SDSCEx As NotesSession Dim gndb_SDSCEx As NotesDatabase
' Traitement des erreurs ' ---------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SDSCEx = "SL" Const gc_Element_SDSCEx = "SDSC_Exportations"

Function SDSCEx_ExporterPropositions(pndc As NotesDocumentCollection, p_Exportation As String, p_CheminFichier As String) As Long ' RQ51336 PBE ' Valeur retournée : 1 = Exportation sauvegardée, 0 = Exportation annulée, -1 = Erreur On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_NomMasque As String Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd_Prod As NotesDocument Dim nd_Temp As NotesDocument Dim ndc_Temp As NotesDocumentCollection Dim v_DocId As String Dim l_Commissions As Variant Dim v_AfficherDB As Integer
Dim v_NbLus As Long
SDSCEx_ExporterPropositions = -1
' Initialisations Call SDSCEx_Initialisations If Not SITp_Initialisations Then Exit Function End If Set ndc_Temp = gndb_Temp_SITp.CreateDocumentCollection v_NomMasque = xUnique("") Print "Copie des propositions dans la db temporaitre..."
' Copier les propositions dans la base de documents temporaire Set nd_Suivant = pndc.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd_Prod = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = pndc.GetNextDocument(nd_Suivant) v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1
v_DocId = xVar(nd_Prod, "Prop_DocId", nd_Prod.Universalid) Set nd_Temp = New NotesDocument(gndb_Temp_SITp) Call nd_Prod.CopyAllItems(nd_Temp) nd_Temp.Form = v_NomMasque Call nd_Temp.RemoveItem("Lecteur") Call nd_Temp.RemoveItem("LecteurAdmin") Call nd_Temp.RemoveItem("Auteur") Call nd_Temp.RemoveItem("AuteurAdmin") Call nd_Temp.Save(True, False)
' Copier l'information calculée l_Commissions = SDSPP_CalculerCommissions(v_DocId, nd_Temp) ForAll v_Element In l_Commissions Call nd_Temp.ReplaceItemValue("Prop_" & ListTag(v_Element), v_Element) End ForAll
Call nd_Temp.Save(True, False) Call ndc_Temp.AddDocument(nd_Temp)
If v_NbLus Mod 100 = 0 Then Print "Copie des propositions dans la db temporaire - " & CStr(v_NbLus) & "/" & CStr(pndc.Count) End If Loop
If v_NbLus = 0 Then SDSCEx_ExporterPropositions = 0 Exit Function End If
' Exporter les documents de la collection Print "Exportation vers MS Excel..." v_AfficherDB = (p_CheminFichier = "") SDSCEx_ExporterPropositions = SIEx_ExporterCollection(ndc_Temp, p_Exportation, "", "", "", True, p_CheminFichier, v_AfficherDB)
' Effacer les documents temporaires Print "Suppression des documents temporaires..." Call ndc_Temp.RemoveAll(True)
If SDSCEx_ExporterPropositions > 0 then Print "Exportation terminée - " & CStr(SDSCEx_ExporterPropositions) " documents exportés." Else Print "Exportation Annulée." End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCEx, gc_Element_SDSCEx, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
Sub SDSCEx_Initialisations If gns_SDSCEx Is Nothing Then Set gns_SDSCEx = New NotesSession Set gndb_SDSCEx = gns_SDSCEx.CurrentDatabase End If End Sub
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_GestionErreurs"

' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SLFWIN= "SL" Const gc_Element_SLFWIN = "SL_FichierWIN"
Const FILE_SHARE_READ = &H1 Const OPEN_EXISTING = 3 Const FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ARCHIVE = &H20 Const GENERIC_READ = &H80000000
Declare Function CreateFile Lib "kernel32.dll" Alias "CreateFileA" (Byval lpFileName As String, Byval dwDesiredAccess As Long, Byval dwShareMode As Long, lpSecurityAttributes As Any, Byval dwCreationDisposition As Long, Byval dwFlagsAndAttributes As Long, Byval hTemplateFile As Long) As Long Declare Function CloseHandle Lib "kernel32.dll" (Byval hObject As Long) As Long
Type FILETIME dwLowDateTime As Long dwHighDateTime As Long End Type
Type SYSTEMTIME wYear As Integer wMonth As Integer wDayOfWeek As Integer wDay As Integer wHour As Integer wMinute As Integer wSecond As Integer wMilliseconds As Integer End Type
Declare Function FileTimeToLocalFileTime Lib "kernel32.dll" (lpFileTime As FILETIME, lpLocalFileTime As FILETIME) As Long Declare Function GetFileTime& Lib "kernel32" (Byval hFile As Long, lpCreationTime As FILETIME, lpLastAccessTime As FILETIME, lpLastWriteTime As FILETIME) Declare Function FileTimeToSystemTime& Lib "kernel32" (lpFileTime As FILETIME, lpSystemTime As SYSTEMTIME)

Function SLFWIN_NomFichierUnique(p_NomFichier As String) As String ' RQ51336 PBE ' Retourne un nom de fichier unique en ajoutent "(n)" au nom du fichier au besoin ' Fichier ABC.PDF --> Fichier ABC (2).pdf ' p_NomFichier : Le nom du fichier doit inclure le chemin d'accès On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_Continuer As Boolean Dim v_Dossier As String Dim v_NomFichier As String Dim v_Suffixe As String Dim i As integer Dim v_NomFichierUnique As String Dim s As string
SLFWIN_NomFichierUnique = p_NomFichier v_Continuer = False
If p_NomFichier <> "" Then If InStr(p_NomFichier, "\") > 0 Then s = Dir$(p_NomFichier, 0) If s <> "" Then v_Continuer = True End If End If End If
If v_Continuer then v_Dossier = StrLeftBack(p_NomFichier, "\") & "\" v_NomFichier = StrRightBack(p_NomFichier, "\")
If InStr(v_NomFichier, ".") > 0 Then v_Suffixe = "." & StrRightBack(v_NomFichier, ".") v_NomFichier = StrLeftBack(v_NomFichier, ".") Else v_Suffixe = "" End If
i = 1 Do i = i + 1 v_NomFichierUnique = v_Dossier & v_NomFichier & " (" & CStr(i) & ")" & v_Suffixe s = Dir$(v_NomFichierUnique) Loop Until s = ""
SLFWIN_NomFichierUnique = v_NomFichierUnique End if Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLFWIN, gc_Element_SLFWIN, GetThreadInfo(1), p_NomFichier, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SLFWIN_DateFichier(p_CheminFichier As String, p_TypeInfo As String) As Variant '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de retourne les date de création, modif ou consutation d'un fichier windows. ' Paramètres : p_TypeInfo ---> Le type info fichier a retourner ( C = date création, M = date modification, A = date dern. accès) '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur On Error 76 Goto FichierInexistant
Dim v_ValRetour As Long ' valeur de retour Dim v_Date As Variant Dim v_Fichier As Long ' handle du fichier ouvert Dim v_DateCreation As FILETIME ' variable pour date et heure de création Dim v_DateDernAcces As FILETIME ' variable pour date et heure dernière consultation Dim v_DateModif As FILETIME ' varible pour date et heure de dernière modification Dim v_DateFichier As SYSTEMTIME ' variable pour manipuler l'heure et date de FILETIME
' Initialisations SLFWIN_DateFichier = ""
If Dir$(p_CheminFichier) = "" Then Goto FichierInexistant End If
v_Fichier = CreateFile(p_CheminFichier, GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, Byval Clng(0), OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ARCHIVE, 0) If v_Fichier = -1 Then Exit Function End If
' Retourne heures...creation, dern-accès, and dern-modification. v_ValRetour = GetFileTime(v_Fichier, v_DateCreation, v_DateDernAcces, v_DateModif)
' Fermer la connection au fichier. v_ValRetour = CloseHandle(v_Fichier) If v_ValRetour = 0 Then Print "ERREUR - Le fichier " & p_CheminFichier & " n'a pas été fermé normalement. (" & Cstr(v_ValRetour) & ")" End If
' Convertir la zone pour l'heure et Convertir le format FILETIME en format SYSTEMTIME Select Case p_TypeInfo Case "C" v_ValRetour = FileTimeToLocalFileTime(v_DateCreation, v_DateCreation) v_ValRetour = FileTimeToSystemTime(v_DateCreation, v_DateFichier) Case "M" v_ValRetour = FileTimeToLocalFileTime(v_DateModif, v_DateModif) v_ValRetour = FileTimeToSystemTime(v_DateModif, v_DateFichier) Case "A" v_ValRetour = FileTimeToLocalFileTime(v_DateDernAcces, v_DateDernAcces) v_ValRetour = FileTimeToSystemTime(v_DateDernAcces, v_DateFichier) End Select
v_Date = Evaluate(| @Date(| & v_DateFichier.wYear & |;| & v_DateFichier.wMonth & |;| & v_DateFichier.wDay & _ |;| & v_DateFichier.wHour & |;| & v_DateFichier.wMinute & |;| & v_DateFichier.wSecond & |) |)
If Isarray(v_Date) Then SLFWIN_DateFichier = v_Date(0) End If Exit Function
FichierInexistant: Print "Fichier " & p_CheminFichier & " introuvable." Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLFWIN, gc_Element_SLFWIN, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SLFWIN_EncoderFichierBase64(p_CheminFichierOrigine As String, p_CheminFichierDestination As String, p_Remplacer As Boolean) As Boolean '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de convertir un fichier en base 64. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_FichierTempOrigine As Boolean Dim v_CheminFichierOrigine As String Dim v_CheminFichierTempDestination As String Dim a_Commande(1) As String Dim v_Commande As String Dim i As integer Dim v_Resultat As Integer
' Initialisations SLFWIN_EncoderFichierBase64 = False
' Validation des paramètres If p_CheminFichierOrigine = "" Then Exit function End If If Dir$(p_CheminFichierOrigine, 0) = "" Then Exit function End If
v_CheminFichierOrigine = p_CheminFichierOrigine p_CheminFichierDestination = Replace(p_CheminFichierDestination, |’|, |-|)
v_FichierTempOrigine = False If InStr(v_CheminFichierOrigine, |’|) > 0 Then v_CheminFichierOrigine = p_CheminFichierDestination & ".si.tmp1" If Dir$(v_CheminFichierOrigine, 0) <> "" Then Kill v_CheminFichierOrigine End If FileCopy p_CheminFichierOrigine, v_CheminFichierOrigine v_FichierTempOrigine = True End If
If Dir$(p_CheminFichierDestination, 0) <> "" Then If p_Remplacer then Kill p_CheminFichierDestination Else p_CheminFichierDestination = SLFWIN_NomFichierUnique(p_CheminFichierDestination) End if End If
' Suppression du fichier temporaire v_CheminFichierTempDestination = p_CheminFichierDestination & ".si.tmp2" If Dir$(v_CheminFichierTempDestination, 0) <> "" Then Kill v_CheminFichierTempDestination End If
' ===== Encodage du fichier ===== ' certutil -encode [Origine] [Temporaire] && findstr /v /c:- [Temp] > [Destination] && del [Temp] %rem a_Commande(0) = |/c certutil -encode "| & p_CheminFichierOrigine & |" "| & v_CheminFichierTemp & |"| a_Commande(1) = |/c findstr /v /c:- "| & v_CheminFichierTemp & |" > "| & p_CheminFichierDestination & |"| a_Commande(2) = |/c del "| & v_CheminFichierTemp & |"| %end rem
a_Commande(0) = |certutil -encode "| & v_CheminFichierOrigine & |" "| & v_CheminFichierTempDestination & |"| a_Commande(1) = |findstr /v /c:- "| & v_CheminFichierTempDestination & |" > "| & p_CheminFichierDestination & |"| v_Commande = |/c | & Implode(a_Commande, |&&|) v_Resultat = ShellExecute(0&, "open", "cmd", v_Commande, "", SW_HIDE) If v_Resultat < 32 Then Exit Function End If
' Attendre jusqu'à ce que le fichier encodé soit créé Do If Dir$(p_CheminFichierDestination, 0) <> "" Then Exit Do End If Sleep 1 i = i + 1 Loop Until i > 10 ' Maximum 10 secondes
' Supprimer les fichier temporaires On Error 75 Resume next If v_FichierTempOrigine Then If Dir$(v_CheminFichierOrigine, 0) <> "" Then Kill v_CheminFichierOrigine End if End If If Dir$(v_CheminFichierTempDestination, 0) <> "" Then Kill v_CheminFichierTempDestination End If
If Dir$(p_CheminFichierDestination, 0) <> "" Then SLFWIN_EncoderFichierBase64 = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLFWIN, gc_Element_SLFWIN, GetThreadInfo(1), p_CheminFichierOrigine & " --> " & p_CheminFichierDestination, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SLFWIN_LireFichierString(p_CheminFichierOrigine As String) As String On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim s As String Dim v_NoFichier As Integer Dim v_Texte As String
SLFWIN_LireFichierString = ""
v_NoFichier = FreeFile Open p_CheminFichierOrigine For Input As #v_NoFichier Do Until EOF(v_NoFichier) Line Input #v_NoFichier, s v_Texte = v_Texte & s Loop Close #v_NoFichier
SLFWIN_LireFichierString = v_Texte Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLFWIN, gc_Element_SLFWIN, GetThreadInfo(1), p_CheminFichierOrigine, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SLFWIN_SauvegarderFichierString(p_Data As String, p_CheminFichier As String) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim s As String Dim v_NoFichier As Integer Dim v_Texte As String
SLFWIN_SauvegarderFichierString = False
On Error 75 Resume next Kill p_CheminFichier
v_NoFichier = FreeFile Open p_CheminFichier For Output As #v_NoFichier Write #p_Data Close #v_NoFichier
SLFWIN_SauvegarderFichierString = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLFWIN, gc_Element_SLFWIN, GetThreadInfo(1), p_CheminFichier, False) Exit Function End Function
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_GestionErreurs"

Dim gns_SLSM As NotesSession
' Liste des champs AUTHORS - initialisée dans le sub Initialisations Dim g_NomItemsAuteurs_SLSM As Variant
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_SLSM = "SL" Const gc_Element_SLSM = "SL_SecuriteMasque"
' Instructions pour changer la liste des champs AUTHORS ' Dans le SL appelant: ' Call SLSM_Initialisations ' g_NomItemsAuteurs_SLSM = Evaluate(|"Liste":"des":"champs":"AUTHORS"|)

Function SLSM_PeutModifierDocument(pnd As NotesDocument, p_NomItemsAuteurs As Variant) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim a_NomItemsAuteurs As Variant Dim v_ContientChampAuteurs As Boolean Dim i As Integer Dim a_ValeurItem As Variant Dim a_AuteursAutorises As Variant Dim v_RolesPermis As string Dim a_Roles As Variant
SLSM_PeutModifierDocument = False Call SLSM_Initialisations v_ContientChampAuteurs = False
' Construire la liste des champs AUTHORS If IsArray(p_NomItemsAuteurs) Then a_NomItemsAuteurs = p_NomItemsAuteurs Else a_NomItemsAuteurs = Evaluate(|"| & p_NomItemsAuteurs & |"|) End If
If a_NomItemsAuteurs(LBound(a_NomItemsAuteurs)) = "" Then ' Pas de champs AUTHORS SLSM_PeutModifierDocument = True Else For i = LBound(a_NomItemsAuteurs) To UBound(a_NomItemsAuteurs) If pnd.HasItem(a_NomItemsAuteurs(i)) Then v_ContientChampAuteurs = True Exit For End if Next
If v_ContientChampAuteurs = False Then SLSM_PeutModifierDocument = True ' Le document ne contient pas de champs AUTHORS Else
' Construire la liste des auteurs autorisés (Ids et rôles) For i = LBound(a_NomItemsAuteurs) To UBound(a_NomItemsAuteurs) a_ValeurItem = xVarArray(pnd, a_NomItemsAuteurs(i)) If IsArray(a_ValeurItem) Then If IsArray(a_AuteursAutorises) Then a_AuteursAutorises = ArrayAppend(a_AuteursAutorises, a_ValeurItem) Else a_AuteursAutorises = a_ValeurItem End If End If Next
' Vérifier si l'utilisateur fais partie des auteurs autorisés If IsArray(a_AuteursAutorises) then If Not IsNull(ArrayGetIndex(a_AuteursAutorises, gns_SLSM.UserName, 1)) Then ' Username SLSM_PeutModifierDocument = True Else ' Rôles v_RolesPermis = |"| & Join(a_AuteursAutorises, |":"|) & |"| a_Roles = Evaluate(|!@IsNotMember(| & v_RolesPermis & |; @UserRoles)|) If a_Roles(0) = 1 Then SLSM_PeutModifierDocument = True End If End If End if End If End if Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLSM, gc_Element_SLSM, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SLSM_QueryModeChange(pnuid_Source As NotesUIDocument, p_Continue As Variant) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ni As NotesItem Dim v_PlateformeSDS As Boolean
p_Continue = False
If pnuid_Source.EditMode Then p_Continue = True ElseIf SLSM_PeutModifierDocument(pnuid_Source.Document, g_NomItemsAuteurs_SLSM) Then p_Continue = True End If
If p_Continue = False Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 255, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLSM, gc_Element_SLSM, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub SLSM_QueryOpen(pnuid_Source As NotesUIDocument, p_Mode As Integer, p_Isnewdoc As Variant, p_Continue As Variant) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ni As NotesItem Dim v_PlateformeSDS As Boolean
p_Continue = False
If p_Mode <> 1 Or p_IsNewDoc Then p_Continue = True ElseIf SLSM_PeutModifierDocument(pnuid_Source.Document, g_NomItemsAuteurs_SLSM) Then p_Continue = True End If
If p_Continue = False Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 255, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLSM, gc_Element_SLSM, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Exit Sub

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Function SDSIP3_DupliquerEquipements(p_clProposition_SDSCC As cl_Proposition_SDSIP3, pnd_Site_SDSCC As NotesDocument, p_UserName As String) '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndc_Equipements As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Equipement As NotesDocument Dim nd_EProd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Equi As NotesDocument Dim a_Items As Variant Dim v_Commission As String
' Initialisations SDSIP3_DupliquerEquipements = 0
a_Items = Evaluate(|"PrixUnitaire" : "CoutUnitaire" : "CoutTotal": "PrixTotal" : "Profit" : "FraisEntretien": "Equi_FraisEntretienAnnuels" : "Quantite" | & _ |: "VerificationTechnique" : "ContratRequis" : "CategorieDescFR": "CategorieDescEN" : "Garantie" : "FraisEntretienAnnuels" | & _ |: "CategorieIcone" : "Departement": "DepartementDescFR" : "DepartementDescEN"|)
If p_UserName = "" Then p_UserName = gns_SDSIP3.UserName End If
Set ndc_Equipements = gnv_Prod30_SDSP3_SDSCIP3.GetAllDocumentsByKey((xVar(pnd_Site_SDSCC, "Site_NoSite", "") & ";EQ."), False)
Set nd_Equipement = ndc_Equipements.GetFirstDocument
'Boucler pour créer des copies de tous les équipements While Not nd_Equipement Is Nothing
If xVar(nd_Equipement,"Prod_TypeDescendant", "") <> "C" Then
' Extraire le document de produit d'équipement ' -------------------------------------------- Set nd_EProd = xSDSBB_xndProd(xVar(nd_Equipement,"Prod_CleProduit","") , True)
If nd_EProd Is Nothing Then ' 108 - Le produit d'équipement & n'existe pas. Print xGDK_xMessage("SDSPP", 108, "", xVar(nd_Equipement, "Prod_CodeProduit", "")) End If
Set nd_Equi = New NotesDocument(pnd_Site_SDSCC.ParentDatabase) 'Call nd_Equipement.CopyAllItems(nd_Equi) nd_Equi.Form = "F_Equi" Call nd_Equi.MakeResponse(pnd_Site_SDSCC) nd_Equi.Origine = "SDSP3" nd_Equi.Succ_ClientNom = xVar(pnd_Site_SDSCC, "Succ_ClientNom", "")
nd_Equi.Equi_Categorie = xVar(nd_Equipement, "Prod_CategorieProduit", "") nd_Equi.Equi_DescriptionFR = xVar(nd_Equipement, "Prod_DescProduitFR", "") nd_Equi.Equi_DescriptionEN = xVar(nd_Equipement, "Prod_DescProduitEN", "") nd_Equi.Equi_Code = xVar(nd_Equipement, "Prod_CodeProduit", "") nd_Equi.Prop_EQMajoMens = xVar(p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop, "Prop_EQMajoMens", 0)
If xVar(nd_Equipement,"Prod_TypeDescendant", "") = "C" Then nd_Equi.Equi_Type = "1" Else nd_Equi.Equi_Type = "0" End If
ForAll v_ItemEqui In a_Items Call nd_Equi.ReplaceItemValue("Equi_" & v_ItemEqui, xVar(nd_Equipement, "Prod_" & v_ItemEqui, "")) End ForAll
' Si le produit, dans SDS Base II, est à commission v_Commission = xVar(nd_EProd, "Prod_Commissions", "") If v_Commission = "1" Or (xVar(p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop, "Prop_Type", "") < "2" And v_Commission = "2") Then nd_Equi.Equi_ExempterCommission = "" Else nd_Equi.Equi_ExempterCommission = "1" End If
nd_Equi.HistoDC = Now nd_Equi.HistoUC = p_UserName nd_Equi.HistoDM = "" nd_Equi.HistoUM = ""
'Initialiser les clés pour que l'équipement soit classé dans la nouvelle copie de succursale Call nd_Equi.ReplaceItemValue("CleProposition", p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.UniversalID) Call nd_Equi.ReplaceItemValue("CleSuccursale", pnd_Site_SDSCC.UniversalID)
'Réinitialiser la sécurité Call SDSIP3_AssignerSecurite(nd_Equi) Call nd_Equi.Save(True, False)
End If
Set nd_Equipement = ndc_Equipements.GetNextDocument(nd_Equipement) Wend
SDSIP3_DupliquerEquipements = 1 Exit Function
GererErreur: SDSIP3_DupliquerEquipements = -1 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSIP3, gc_Element_SDSIP3, LSI_Info(2), "", False) Exit Function End Function

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Function SDSIP3_DupliquerServices(p_clProposition_SDSCC As cl_Proposition_SDSIP3, pnd_Site_SDSCC As NotesDocument, p_UserName As String) As Boolean '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' p_UNIDSO = Unique document identifier pour Succursale Originale ' pnd_Site_SDSCC = NouvelleSuccursale ' p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop = Nouvelle proposition ' pndb_NP = Base de documents de la nouvelle proposition ' p_heure = Heure qu'il était au début de la procédure pour mettre la même sur tous les ' nouveaux éléments créés '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndc_Services As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Service As NotesDocument Dim nd_SProd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Serv As NotesDocument Dim a_Items As Variant Dim v_Commission As String
'Initialisations SDSIP3_DupliquerServices = 0
a_Items = Evaluate(|"PrixUnitaire" : "CoutUnitaire" : "CoutTotal": "PrixTotal" : "Profit" : "Quantite" : "VerificationTechnique"| & _ | : "Garantie" : "CategorieDescFR" : "CategorieDescEN" : "ContratRequis"|)
If p_UserName = "" Then p_UserName = gns_SDSIP3.Username End If
Set ndc_Services = gnv_Prod30_SDSP3_SDSCIP3.GetAllDocumentsByKey((xVar(pnd_Site_SDSCC, "Site_NoSite", "") & ";SV."), False)
Set nd_Service = ndc_Services.GetFirstDocument
'Boucler pour créer des copies de tous les équipements While Not nd_Service Is Nothing
' Extraire le document de produit service ' --------------------------------------- Set nd_SProd = xSDSBB_xndProd(xVar(nd_Service,"Prod_CleProduit","") , True)
If nd_SProd Is Nothing Then ' 108 - Le produit d'équipement & n'existe pas. Print xGDK_xMessage("SDSPP", 108, "", xVar(nd_Service, "Prod_CodeProduit", "")) End If
'Créer la copie du Service Set nd_Serv = New NotesDocument(pnd_Site_SDSCC.ParentDatabase) nd_Serv.Form = "F_Serv" 'Call nd_Service.CopyAllItems(nd_Serv) Call nd_Serv.MakeResponse(pnd_Site_SDSCC) nd_Serv.Origine = "SDSP3" nd_Serv.Succ_ClientNom = xVar(pnd_Site_SDSCC, "Succ_ClientNom", "") nd_Serv.Serv_Code = xVar(nd_Service, "Prod_CodeProduit", "") nd_Serv.Serv_DescriptionFR = xVar(nd_Service, "Prod_DescProduitFR", "") nd_Serv.Serv_DescriptionEN = xVar(nd_Service, "Prod_DescProduitEN", "") nd_Serv.Serv_Categorie = xVar(nd_Service, "Prod_CategorieProduit", "") nd_Serv.Serv_DescriptionFR = xVar(nd_Service, "Prod_DescProduitFR", "") nd_Serv.Serv_DescriptionEN = xVar(nd_Service, "Prod_DescProduitEN", "") nd_Serv.Serv_UniteFR = xSDSBB_xVarProd(xVar(nd_Service,"Prod_CleProduit",""), "Prod_UniteEN", "", True) nd_Serv.Serv_UniteEN = xSDSBB_xVarProd(xVar(nd_Service,"Prod_CleProduit",""), "Prod_UniteEN", "", True)
If xVar(nd_Serv,"Prod_TypeDescendant", "") = "C" Then nd_Serv.Serv_Type = "1" End If
ForAll v_ItemServ In a_Items Call nd_Serv.ReplaceItemValue("Serv_" & v_ItemServ, xVar(nd_Service, "Prod_" & v_ItemServ, "")) End ForAll
' Si le produit, dans SDS Base II, est à commission v_Commission = xVar(nd_SProd, "Prod_Commissions", "") If v_Commission = "1" Or (xVar(p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop, "Prop_Type", "") < "2" And v_Commission = "2") Then nd_Serv.Serv_ExempterCommission = "" Else nd_Serv.Serv_ExempterCommission = "1" End If
nd_Serv.HistoDC = Now nd_Serv.HistoUC = p_UserName nd_Serv.HistoDM = "" nd_Serv.HistoUM = ""
'Initialiser les clés pour que l'équipement soit classé dans la nouvelle copie de succursale Call nd_Serv.ReplaceItemValue("CleProposition", p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.UniversalID)
'Réinitialiser la sécurité Call SDSIP3_AssignerSecurite(nd_Serv) Call nd_Serv.Save(True, False)
Set nd_Service = ndc_services.GetNextDocument(nd_Service) Wend
SDSIP3_DupliquerServices = 1 Exit Function
GererErreur: SDSIP3_DupliquerServices = -1 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSIP3, gc_Element_SDSIP3, LSI_Info(2), "", False) Exit Function End Function

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Function SDSIP3_CreerProposition(p_clProposition_SDSP3 As cl_Proposition_SDSIP3, p_clProposition_SDSCC As cl_Proposition_SDSIP3, p_UserName As String) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_TypeProposition As String Dim v_Statut As String
SDSIP3_CreerProposition = 0
' Creer la nouvelle copie de Proposition Set p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop = New NotesDocument(gndb_SDSIP3) Call p_clProposition_SDSP3.nd_Prop.CopyAllItems(p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop, False) Call p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.Removeitem("Prop_DescDetaillee") ' champ Rich Text, ne pas le copier dans Commission II p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.Prop_Description = xVar(p_clProposition_SDSP3.nd_Prop, "Prop_DescProposition", "") p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.Prop_DescriptionComm = xVar(p_clProposition_SDSP3.nd_Prop, "Prop_DescProposition", "") p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.Description = xVar(p_clProposition_SDSP3.nd_Prop, "Prop_ClientNom", xVar(p_clProposition_SDSP3.nd_Prop, "Prop_ClientNomInterne", "")) p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.Prop_NbProposition = CDbl(xVar(p_clProposition_SDSP3.nd_Prop, "Prop_NbProposition", "")) p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.Prop_ClientNoFmt = xVar(p_clProposition_SDSP3.nd_Prop, "Prop_ClientNoFmt", "")
'Req# 42249. Copier les champs Prop_NoDirecteur, Prop_NomDirecteur, Prop_IdDirecteur ' nd_Prop.Prop_NoDirecteur = xVar(p_clProposition_SDSP3.nd_Prop, "Prop_NoDirecteur", "") RQ59317 ' nd_Prop.Prop_NomDirecteur = xVar(p_clProposition_SDSP3.nd_Prop, "Prop_NomDirecteur", "") 'Nom usuel ' nd_Prop.Prop_IdDirecteur = xVar(p_clProposition_SDSP3.nd_Prop, "Prop_IdDirecteur", "") 'Prop_Directeur
v_TypeProposition = xVar(p_clProposition_SDSP3.nd_Prop, "Prop_TypeProposition", "") p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.Prop_Type = v_TypeProposition
p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.Prop_TypeIcone = xSDSBB_xVarTpPp(v_TypeProposition, "TpPp_Icone", "", True) p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.Origine = "SDSP3"
' Initialiser les champs des commissions p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.Prop_EQMajoMens = xVarProf("Prof_EQMajoMens", 0) p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.Prop_LGMajoMens = xVarProf("Prof_LGMajoMens", 0)
'Réinitialiser les champs de base p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.HistoDC = Now p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.HistoUC = p_UserName p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.HistoDM = "" p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.HistoUM = "" p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.Prop_Contrat = ""
p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.Prop_DateTransfert = Now
' Initialiser les commissions RQ59317 Call SDSIP3_InitialiserCommissions(p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop)
'Réinitialiser la sécurité Call SDSIP3_AssignerSecurite(p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop)
'Effacer l'historique qui avait été copié Call SIHi_EffacerHistorique(p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop)
'Assigner le nouveau statut If v_TypeProposition = "0" Then v_Statut = "10" Else v_Statut = "40" ' RQ55667 End If p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.Prop_Statut = v_Statut p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.Prop_StatutDate = Now p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.Prop_StatutIcone = xSDSC3_xIcnTabl(v_Statut, "StatProp_FR", True) p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.Prop_StatutDescFR = v_Statut & " - " & xSDSC3_xDescTabl(v_Statut, "StatProp_FR", True) p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.Prop_StatutDescEN = v_Statut & " - " & xSDSC3_xDescTabl(v_Statut, "StatProp_EN", True)
' Retirer les documents attachés If p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.HasEmbedded Then If p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.HasItem("$File") Then Call p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.RemoveItem("$File") End If End If
Call p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.Save(True, False)
p_clProposition_SDSCC.Langue = xVar(p_clProposition_SDSP3.nd_Prop, "Prop_Langue", "")
SDSIP3_CreerProposition = 1 Exit Function
GererErreur: SDSIP3_CreerProposition = -1 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSIP3, gc_Element_SDSIP3, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Function SDSIP3_ImporterProposition_A(p_ParameterDocId As String) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_Temp As NotesDocument Dim v_NoProposition As String Dim v_NoSites As String Dim v_NoSitePrincipal As String Dim v_UserName As String Dim v_clProposition_SDSP3 As New cl_Proposition_SDSIP3 Dim v_Resultat As Integer
' Initialisations SDSIP3_ImporterProposition_A = 0 Call SDSIP3_Initialisations
Call SIGE_OuvrirLog(gc_TypeElement_SDSIP3, gc_Element_SDSIP3) Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Function " & GetThreadInfo(1), 0, 0, False) Call SIGE_AjouterLog("------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------", 0, 0, False)
' Extraire le document temporaire Call SITp_Initialisations Set nd_Temp = gndb_Temp_SITp.GetDocumentById(p_ParameterDocId) v_NoProposition = xVar(nd_Temp, "NoProposition", "") v_NoSites = xVar(nd_Temp, "NoSites", "") v_NoSitePrincipal = xVar(nd_Temp, "NoSitePrincipal", "") v_UserName = xVar(nd_Temp, "UserName", "") Call SIGE_AjouterLog("No proposition = " & v_NoProposition, 0, 0, False) Call SIGE_AjouterLog("No sites = " & v_NoSites, 0, 0, False) Call SIGE_AjouterLog("No site principal = " & v_NoSitePrincipal, 0, 0, False) Call SIGE_AjouterLog("UserName = " & v_UserName, 0, 0, False)
If SDSIP3_InitialiserclProp_SDSP3(v_NoProposition, v_NoSites, v_NoSitePrincipal, v_clProposition_SDSP3) Then ' Importer la proposition SDSIP3_ImporterProposition_A = SDSIP3_ImporterProposition(v_clProposition_SDSP3, v_UserName) Else SDSIP3_ImporterProposition_A = v_clProposition_SDSP3.Resultat End If
' Enregistrer le résultat nd_Temp.Resultat = v_clProposition_SDSP3.Resultat Call nd_Temp.Save(True, False)
Call SIGE_AjouterLog("------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------", 0, 0, False) Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Résultat = " & v_clProposition_SDSP3.Resultat, 0, 0, False) Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog Exit Function
GererErreur: SDSIP3_ImporterProposition_A = -1 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSIP3, gc_Element_SDSIP3, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog Exit Function End Function

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Function SDSIP3_CreerSite(p_clProposition_SDSP3 As cl_Proposition_SDSIP3, pnd_Site_SDSP3 As NotesDocument, p_clProposition_SDSCC As cl_Proposition_SDSIP3, _ p_UserName As String) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_NoSite As String Dim nd_Site_SDSCC As NotesDocument Dim nd_SiteParent_SDSP3 As NotesDocument
' Initialisations SDSIP3_CreerSite = 0 v_NoSite = xVar(pnd_Site_SDSP3, "Site_NoSite", "")
' Créer le site (SDSCC) Set nd_Site_SDSCC = New NotesDocument(p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.ParentDatabase) nd_Site_SDSCC.Form = "F_Succ" 'Call pnd_Site_SDSP3.CopyAllItems(nd_Site_SDSCC) Call nd_Site_SDSCC.MakeResponse(p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop)
nd_Site_SDSCC.Description = xVar(pnd_Site_SDSP3, "Site_BanniereDesc", "") nd_Site_SDSCC.Origine = "SDSP3" nd_Site_SDSCC.Cle = xVar(pnd_Site_SDSP3, "Site_ClientNomInterne", "") nd_Site_SDSCC.Site_NoSite = v_NoSite
nd_Site_SDSCC.Prop_Notes = xVar(pnd_Site_SDSP3, "Site_Note", "") nd_Site_SDSCC.Succ_ClientNom = xVar(pnd_Site_SDSP3, "Site_ClientNomInterne", xVar(pnd_Site_SDSP3, "Site_ClientNom", "")) nd_Site_SDSCC.Succ_Banniere = xVar(pnd_Site_SDSP3,"Site_Banniere", "") nd_Site_SDSCC.Succ_BanniereDesc = xVar(pnd_Site_SDSP3,"Site_BanniereDesc", "")
''nd_Site_SDSCC.Site_NoProposition = xVar(pnd_NP, "Prop_NoPropositon","") nd_Site_SDSCC.Succ_Langue = p_clProposition_SDSCC.Langue nd_Site_SDSCC.Succ_ContactFonction = xVar(pnd_Site_SDSP3, "Site_ContactFonction" & p_clProposition_SDSCC.Langue, "")
If xGDK_xValeurExisteTabl("Civilite" & p_clProposition_SDSCC.Langue, xVar(pnd_Site_SDSP3, "Site_ContactTitre", ""), True) Then nd_Site_SDSCC.Succ_ContactTitre = xVar(pnd_Site_SDSP3, "Site_ContactTitre", "") Else nd_Site_SDSCC.Succ_ContactTitre = xGDK_xVarTabl("Civilite" & p_clProposition_SDSCC.Langue, "Tabl_ValeurDefaut", "", True) End If
Set nd_SiteParent_SDSP3 = xSDSP3_xndSite(xVar(pnd_Site_SDSP3, "Site_NoSiteSDSParent", ""), True)
If xVar(pnd_Site_SDSP3, "Site_NoSite", "") = p_clProposition_SDSP3.NoSitePrincipal Then nd_Site_SDSCC.Succ_Type ="0" ElseIf xVar(pnd_Site_SDSP3, "Site_ServeurSDS", "") = "1" Or _ xVar(nd_SiteParent_SDSP3, "Site_ServeurSDS", "") = "1" Then nd_Site_SDSCC.Succ_Type ="1" Else nd_Site_SDSCC.Succ_Type ="2" End If
nd_Site_SDSCC.Succ_Usagers = xVar(pnd_Site_SDSP3, "Site_D0_NbUtilisateurs", 0) + xVar(pnd_Site_SDSP3, "Site_D2_NbUtilisateurs", 0) & _ + xVar(pnd_Site_SDSP3, "Site_D3_NbTechniciens", 0) + xVar(pnd_Site_SDSP3, "Site_D4_NbUtilisateurs", 0) + xVar(pnd_Site_SDSP3, "Site_D5_NbUtilisateurs", 0)
nd_Site_SDSCC.Succ_UsagersVentes = xVar(pnd_Site_SDSP3, "Site_D1_NbUtilisateurs", 0)

nd_Site_SDSCC.HistoDC = Now nd_Site_SDSCC.HistoUC = p_UserName nd_Site_SDSCC.HistoDM = "" nd_Site_SDSCC.HistoUM = ""

If nd_Site_SDSCC.Save(True, False) Then p_clProposition_SDSCC.NbSites = p_clProposition_SDSCC.NbSites + 1 Call p_clProposition_SDSCC.ndc_Sites.AddDocument(nd_Site_SDSCC) Call SIGE_AjouterLog ("Le site " & v_NoSite & " a été copié dans SDS Commissions", 0, 0, False) Else Call SIGE_AjouterLog ("ERREUR: Le site " & v_NoSite & " n'a pas été copié dans SDS Commissions", 1, 0, False) p_clProposition_SDSCC.Resultat = -2 End If

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Function SDSIP3_DupliquerLogiciels(p_clProposition_SDSCC As cl_Proposition_SDSIP3, pnd_Site_SDSCC As NotesDocument, p_UserName As String) As Integer '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' p_UNIDSO = Unique document identifier pour Succursale Originale ' pnd_Site_SDSCC = Nouvelle Succursale ' p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop = Nouvelle Proposition ' pndb_NP = Base de documents de la nouvelle proposition ' p_heure = Heure qu'il était au début de la procédure pour mettre la même sur tous les ' nouveaux éléments créés '-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndc_Logiciels As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Logiciel As NotesDocument Dim nd_LProd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Logi As NotesDocument Dim a_Items As Variant Dim v_Quantite As Long Dim v_FraisMensuels As Variant Dim v_Commission As String
SDSIP3_DupliquerLogiciels = 0
a_Items = Evaluate(|"PrixUnitaire" : "CoutUnitaire" : "CoutTotal": "PrixTotal" : "Profit" : "Quantite" : "VerificationTechnique" | & _ |: "ContratRequis" : "CategorieDescFR": "CategorieDescEN" : "Garantie" : "CategorieIcone" : "Departement" : "DepartementDescFR" : "DepartementDescEN"| & _ |: "NbUtilisateursObligatoire" : "NbUtilisateursInclus" : "PrixParUtilisateur"|)
If p_UserName = "" Then p_UserName = gns_SDSIP3.UserName End If
Set ndc_Logiciels = gnv_Prod30_SDSP3_SDSCIP3.GetAllDocumentsByKey((xVar(pnd_Site_SDSCC, "Site_NoSite", "") & ";LG."), False)
Set nd_Logiciel = ndc_Logiciels.GetFirstDocument
'Boucler pour créer des copies de tous les logiciels While Not nd_Logiciel Is Nothing
' Ne pas copier les produits importés du contrat de service If xVar(nd_Logiciel, "Prod_NoContratFmt_CS", "") = "" Then
' Extraire le document de produit de logiciel ' ------------------------------------------- Set nd_LProd = xSDSBB_xndProd(xVar(nd_Logiciel,"Prod_CleProduit","") , True)
If nd_LProd Is Nothing Then ' 108 - Le produit de logiciel & n'existe pas. Print xGDK_xMessage("SDSPP", 108, "", xVar(nd_Logiciel, "Prod_CodeProduit", "")) End If
'Créer la copie du logiciel Set nd_Logi = New NotesDocument(pnd_Site_SDSCC.ParentDatabase) nd_Logi.Form = "F_Logi" 'Call nd_Logiciel.CopyAllItems(nd_Logi) Call nd_Logi.MakeResponse(pnd_Site_SDSCC) nd_Logi.Origine = "SDSP3" nd_Logi.Succ_ClientNom = xVar(pnd_Site_SDSCC, "Succ_ClientNom", "") nd_Logi.Logi_Categorie = xVar(nd_Logiciel, "Prod_CategorieProduit", "") nd_Logi.Logi_Code = xVar(nd_Logiciel, "Prod_CodeProduit", "") nd_Logi.Logi_DescriptionFR = xVar(nd_Logiciel, "Prod_DescProduitFR", "") nd_Logi.Logi_DescriptionEN = xVar(nd_Logiciel, "Prod_DescProduitEN", "") v_Quantite = xVar(nd_Logiciel, "Prod_Quantite", 0) v_FraisMensuels = SItN_Round(xVar(nd_Logiciel, "Prod_FraisEntretienAnnuels", 0) / 12, 2) nd_Logi.Logi_FraisUnitairesMensuels = v_FraisMensuels nd_Logi.Logi_FraisUnitairesAnnuels = v_FraisMensuels * 12 nd_Logi.Logi_FraisTotauxMensuels = v_Quantite * v_FraisMensuels nd_Logi.Logi_FraisTotauxAnnuels = v_Quantite * v_FraisMensuels * 12 nd_Logi.Logi_CodeProduitAH = xVar(nd_Logiciel, "Prod_CodeProduitAH", "")
If xVarContient(nd_LProd, "Prod_PropOptions", "CR") Then nd_Logi.Logi_ContratRequis = "1" Else nd_Logi.Logi_ContratRequis = "0" End If
nd_Logi.Logi_CommissionFixe = xVar(nd_LProd, "Prod_CommissionFixe", 0)
ForAll v_ItemLogi In a_Items Call nd_Logi.ReplaceItemValue("Logi_" & v_ItemLogi, xVar(nd_Logiciel, "Prod_" & v_ItemLogi, "")) End ForAll
If xVar(nd_LProd, "Prod_NoContratFmt_CS", "") = "" Then ' Si le produit, dans SDS Base II, est à commission v_Commission = xVar(nd_LProd, "Prod_Commissions", "") If v_Commission = "1" Or (xVar(p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop, "Prop_Type", "") < "2" And v_Commission = "2") Then nd_Logi.Logi_ExempterCommission = "" Else nd_Logi.Logi_ExempterCommission = "1" End If Else nd_Logi.logi_ExempterCommission = "1" End If
nd_Logi.HistoDC = Now nd_Logi.HistoUC = p_UserName nd_Logi.HistoDM = "" nd_Logi.HistoUM = ""
'Initialiser les clés pour que l'équipement soit classé dans la nouvelle copie de 'succursale Call nd_Logi.ReplaceItemValue("CleProposition", p_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.UniversalID)
'Mettre à jour les informations qui ont peut-être changé depuis la création de 'la proposition originale ex: les prix '------------------------------------------------------------------------------ nd_Logi.CategorieDescFR = xSDSBB_xVarCate(xVar(nd_Logi, "Logi_Categorie", ""), "Cate_DescCategorieFR", "", True) nd_Logi.CategorieDescEN = xSDSBB_xVarCate(xVar(nd_Logi, "Logi_Categorie", ""), "Cate_DescCategorieEN", "", True)
'Réinitialiser la sécurité Call SDSIP3_AssignerSecurite(nd_Logi) Call nd_Logi.Save(True, False)
End If
Set nd_Logiciel = ndc_Logiciels.GetNextDocument(nd_Logiciel) Wend
SDSIP3_DupliquerLogiciels = 1 Exit Function
GererErreur: SDSIP3_DupliquerLogiciels = -1 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSIP3, gc_Element_SDSIP3, LSI_Info(2), "", False) Exit Function End Function

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Function SDSIP3_InitialiserclProp_SDSP3(p_NoProposition As String, p_NoSites As String, p_NoSitePrincipal As String, p_clProposition_SDSP3 As cl_Proposition_SDSIP3) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur
'------------------------------------------------ ' RQ59317 Initialiser les documents de commission de la PP '------------------------------------------------ On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_Resultat As Integer Dim a_NoSites As Variant Dim nd_Site_SDSP3 As NotesDocument Dim v_ErreurSite As Boolean
SDSIP3_InitialiserclProp_SDSP3 = False p_clProposition_SDSP3.Resultat = 0 p_clProposition_SDSP3.NoProposition = p_NoProposition p_clProposition_SDSP3.NoSites = p_NoSites p_clProposition_SDSP3.NoSitePrincipal = p_NoSitePrincipal
' Extraire la proposition Set p_clProposition_SDSP3.nd_Prop = xSDSP3_xndProp(p_clProposition_SDSP3.NoProposition, False) If p_clProposition_SDSP3.nd_Prop Is Nothing Then p_clProposition_SDSP3.Resultat = -6 Call SIGE_AjouterLog("ERR: Proposition inexistante", 1, 0, False) Exit Function End If
' Extraire les sites a_NoSites = Split(p_NoSites,";") Set p_clProposition_SDSP3.ndc_Sites = gndb_xSDSP3.CreateDocumentCollection() ForAll v_NoSite In a_NoSites Set nd_Site_SDSP3 = xSDSP3_xndSite(v_NoSite, True)
If nd_Site_SDSP3 Is Nothing Then p_clProposition_SDSP3.Resultat = -12 v_ErreurSite = True Call SIGE_AjouterLog("ERR: Site " & v_NoSite & " inexistant.", 1, 0, False) ElseIf Not p_clProposition_SDSP3.ndc_Sites.Contains(nd_Site_SDSP3) Then Call p_clProposition_SDSP3.ndc_Sites.AddDocument(nd_Site_SDSP3) p_clProposition_SDSP3.NbSites = p_clProposition_SDSP3.NbSites + 1 End If End ForAll If v_ErreurSite = True Then Exit Function End If
If p_clProposition_SDSP3.NbSites = 0 Then p_clProposition_SDSP3.Resultat = -173 Call SIGE_AjouterLog("ERR: Aucun site à importer.", 1, 0, False) Exit Function End If
p_clProposition_SDSP3.Resultat = 1 SDSIP3_InitialiserclProp_SDSP3 = True Exit Function
GererErreur: p_clProposition_SDSP3.Resultat = -1 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSIP3, gc_Element_SDSIP3, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Function SDSIP3_ImporterProposition_WS(p_NoProposition As String, p_NoSites As String, p_NoSitePrincipal As String, p_UserName As String) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur

Call SIGE_OuvrirLog(gc_TypeElement_SDSIP3, gc_Element_SDSIP3) Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Function " & GetThreadInfo(1), 0, 0, False) Call SIGE_AjouterLog("------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------", 0, 0, False) Call SIGE_AjouterLog("No proposition = " & p_NoProposition, 0, 0, False) Call SIGE_AjouterLog("No sites = " & p_NoSites, 0, 0, False) Call SIGE_AjouterLog("No site principal = " & p_NoSitePrincipal, 0, 0, False) Call SIGE_AjouterLog("UserName = " & p_UserName, 0, 0, False)
If SDSIP3_InitialiserclProp_SDSP3(p_NoProposition, p_NoSites, p_NoSitePrincipal, v_clProposition_SDSP3) Then ' Importer la proposition SDSIP3_ImporterProposition_WS = SDSIP3_ImporterProposition(v_clProposition_SDSP3, p_UserName) Else SDSIP3_ImporterProposition_WS = v_clProposition_SDSP3.Resultat End If
Call SIGE_AjouterLog("------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------", 0, 0, False) Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Résultat = " & v_clProposition_SDSP3.Resultat, 0, 0, False) Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog Exit Function

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Function SDSIP3_ImporterProposition(p_clProposition_SDSP3 As cl_Proposition_SDSIP3, p_UserName As String) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_clProposition_SDSCC As New cl_Proposition_SDSIP3 Dim v_Resultat As Integer Dim nd_Site_SDSP3 As NotesDocument
' Initialisations SDSIP3_ImporterProposition = 0 Call SDSIP3_Initialisations
' Valider les sites à copier
' Créer la proposition (SDSCC) SDSIP3_ImporterProposition = SDSIP3_CreerProposition(p_clProposition_SDSP3, v_clProposition_SDSCC, p_UserName) If SDSIP3_ImporterProposition < 0 Then Exit Function End If
' Créer les sites (SDSCC) Set v_clProposition_SDSCC.ndc_Sites = v_clProposition_SDSCC.nd_Prop.ParentDatabase.CreateDocumentCollection Set nd_Site_SDSP3 = p_clProposition_SDSP3.ndc_Sites.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_Site_SDSP3 Is Nothing SDSIP3_ImporterProposition = SDSIP3_CreerSite(p_clProposition_SDSP3, nd_Site_SDSP3, v_clProposition_SDSCC, p_UserName) If SDSIP3_ImporterProposition < 0 Then v_clProposition_SDSCC.Resultat = SDSIP3_ImporterProposition Exit Function End If
Set nd_Site_SDSP3 = p_clProposition_SDSP3.ndc_Sites.GetNextDocument(nd_Site_SDSP3) Loop
SDSIP3_ImporterProposition = v_clProposition_SDSCC.NbSites Exit Function
GererErreur: SDSIP3_ImporterProposition = -1 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSIP3, gc_Element_SDSIP3, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SINDC_TrierEntryCollectionArray(pnvec As NotesViewEntryCollection, p_fxTri As String, p_ValeurNulle As Variant, pand As Variant) As Boolean '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de trier une collection de documents. ' pnvec = NotesViewEntryCollection ' p_fxTri = Formule pour déterminer la valeur utilisée pour le tri. Peut êre un nom de champ. ' ex: v_fxTri = |Requ_ClientNom + @Right("000" + @Text(Cand_NoRequete); 5) + Cand_NomCandidat| ' pand = Array des documents trriés '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nve As NotesViewEntry Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim i As Long Dim vand As Variant
SINDC_TrierEntryCollectionArray = False pand = "" If pnvec.Count = 0 Then Exit Function End If
' Transférer la collection dans un array de documents Redim and_(pnvec.Count - 1) As NotesDocument Set nve = pnvec.GetFirstEntry Do Until nve Is Nothing Set and_(i) = nve.Document i = i + 1 Set nve = pnvec.GetNextEntry(nve) Loop
' Trier l'array de documents vand = and_ If TrierArrayDocs(vand, p_fxTri, p_ValeurNulle) Then pand = vand SINDC_TrierEntryCollectionArray = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINDC, gc_Element_SINDC, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SINDC_TrierCollectionArray(pndc As NotesDocumentCollection, p_fxTri As String, p_ValeurNulle As Variant, pand As Variant) As Boolean '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de trier une collection de documents. ' pndc = NotesDocumentCollection ' p_fxTri = Formule pour déterminer la valeur utilisée pour le tri. Peut êre un nom de champ. ' ex: v_fxTri = |Requ_ClientNom + @Right("000" + @Text(Cand_NoRequete); 5) + Cand_NomCandidat| ' pand = Array des documents trriés '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim i As Long Dim vand As Variant
SINDC_TrierCollectionArray = False pand = "" If pndc.Count = 0 Then Exit Function End If
' Transférer la collection dans un array de documents Redim and_(pndc.Count - 1) As NotesDocument Set nd = pndc.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd Is Nothing Set and_(i) = nd i = i + 1 Set nd = pndc.GetNextDocument(nd) Loop
' Trier l'array de documents vand = and_ If TrierArrayDocs(vand, p_fxTri, p_ValeurNulle) Then pand = vand SINDC_TrierCollectionArray = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINDC, gc_Element_SINDC, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SINDC_EpurerCollection(pndc As NotesDocumentCollection, p_fSelection As String) As Boolean '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de trier une collection de documents. ' pndc = NotesDocumentCollection ' p_fSelection = Formule pour déterminer s'il faut conserver le document. La formule doit retourner une valeur @True ou @False (1/0). ' Valeur retournée: True si la collection contient au moins un document. '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v As Variant
SINDC_EpurerCollection = False If pndc.Count = 0 Then Exit Function End If
' Boucler sur tous les documents de la collection Set nd_Suivant = pndc.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = pndc.GetNextDocument(nd_Suivant)
' Déterminer s'il faut conserver le document dans la collection v = Evaluate(p_fSelection, nd) If Not IsNumeric(v(0)) Then Call pndc.DeleteDocument(nd) ElseIf Clng(v(0)) = 1 Then SINDC_EpurerCollection = True Else Call pndc.DeleteDocument(nd) End If
Loop
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINDC, gc_Element_SINDC, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SINDC_TrierCollection(pndc As NotesDocumentCollection, p_fxTri As String, p_ValeurNulle As Variant) As Boolean '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de trier une collection de documents. ' pndc = NotesDocumentCollection ' p_fxTri = Formule pour déterminer la valeur utilisée pour le tri. Peut êre un nom de champ. '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim i As Long Dim and_ As Variant
SINDC_TrierCollection = False If pndc.Count = 0 Then Exit Function End If
' Transférer la collection dans un array de documents et trier If SINDC_TrierCollectionArray(pndc, p_fxTri, p_ValeurNulle, and_) Then ' Retransférer l'array dans une collection Set ndc = pndc.Parent.CreateDocumentCollection For i = Lbound(and_) To Ubound(and_) Call ndc.Adddocument(and_(i)) Next Set pndc = ndc SINDC_TrierCollection = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINDC, gc_Element_SINDC, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Selection" Use "x_SIRR"

' Déclarations globales ' ---------------------------------- Dim gns_SIRR As Notessession Dim gndb_SIRR As Notesdatabase Dim gndb_SIRR_SIRR As NotesDatabase
Dim gnuiws_SIRR As Notesuiworkspace
' Base de documents SI Projets ' ----------------------------------------- Const gc_NomBaseSIPj = "SIRR" Dim gnv_Repr15_SIRR As NotesView Dim gnv_Repr18_SIRR As NotesView
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SIRR = "SL" Const gc_Element_SIRR = "SI_Representants"
'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Class cl_Commissions_SIRR
Public NoRepresentant As String Public nd_Repr As NotesDocument Public NoEquipe As String Public nd_Equi As NotesDocument Public RempCommEquipe As String Public RempCommDefaut As String Public SourceCommissions As String Public NoRepresentantComm As String Public nd_Comm_RP As NotesDocument Public Commissions_RP As String Public NoDirecteur_DR As String Public nd_Repr_DR As NotesDocument Public nd_Comm_DR As NotesDocument Public Commissions_DR As String Public NoDirecteur_DN As String Public nd_Repr_DN As NotesDocument Public nd_Comm_DN As NotesDocument Public Commissions_DN As String Public NoDirecteur_DM As String Public nd_Repr_DM As NotesDocument Public nd_Comm_DM As NotesDocument Public Commissions_DM As String Public Resultat As Integer
Sub New(ByVal p_NoRepresentant As String, ByVal p_Pays As String, ByVal p_Province As String) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Me.Resultat = 0
If p_NoRepresentant = "" Then Me.Resultat = -1 Exit Sub End If
Me.NoRepresentant = p_NoRepresentant Set Me.nd_Repr = xSIRR_xndRepr(Me.NoRepresentant, True) If Me.nd_Repr Is Nothing Then Me.Resultat = -2 Exit Sub End If
Me.NoEquipe = xVar(Me.nd_Repr, "Repr_NoEquipe", "") If Me.NoEquipe <> "" Then Set Me.nd_Equi = xSIRR_xndEqui(Me.NoEquipe, True) If Me.nd_Equi Is Nothing Then Me.Resultat = -3 Exit Sub End If End If
If Me.NoEquipe <> "" Then Me.RempCommEquipe = xVar(Me.nd_Repr, "Repr_RempCommEquipe", "") If Me.RempCommEquipe = "1" Then Me.SourceCommissions = "R" ' Représentant ' Me.CleCommissions = Me.NoRepresentant Else Me.RempCommDefaut = xVar(Me.nd_Equi, "Equi_RempCommDefaut", "") If Me.RempCommDefaut = "1" Then Me.SourceCommissions = "E" ' Equipe ' Me.CleCommissions = Me.NoRepresentant Else Me.SourceCommissions = "P" ' Profil End If End If Else Me.RempCommDefaut = xVar(Me.nd_Repr, "Repr_RempCommDefaut", "") If Me.RempCommDefaut = "1" Then Me.SourceCommissions = "R" ' Représentant Else Me.SourceCommissions = "P" ' Profil End If End If
Select Case Me.SourceCommissions Case "R": ' Représentant Me.NoRepresentantComm = Me.NoRepresentant Me.NoDirecteur_DR = xVar(Me.nd_Repr, "Repr_NoDirecteur_R", "") Me.NoDirecteur_DN = xVar(Me.nd_Repr, "Repr_NoDirecteur_N", "") Me.NoDirecteur_DM = xVar(Me.nd_Repr, "Repr_NoDirecteur_M", "") Case "E": ' Équipe Me.NoDirecteur_DR = xVar(Me.nd_Equi, "Equi_NoDirecteur_R", "") Me.NoDirecteur_DN = xVar(Me.nd_Equi, "Equi_NoDirecteur_N", "") Me.NoDirecteur_DM = xVar(Me.nd_Equi, "Equi_NoDirecteur_M", "") Case Else: ' Profil Me.NoRepresentantComm = "0" Me.NoDirecteur_DR = xSIRR_xVarProf("Prof_NoDirecteur_R", "") Me.NoDirecteur_DN = xSIRR_xVarProf("Prof_NoDirecteur_N", "") Me.NoDirecteur_DM = xSIRR_xVarProf("Prof_NoDirecteur_M", "") End Select
Set Me.nd_Repr_DR = xSIRR_xndRepr(Me.NoDirecteur_DR, True) Set Me.nd_Repr_DN = xSIRR_xndRepr(Me.NoDirecteur_DN, True) Set Me.nd_Repr_DM = xSIRR_xndRepr(Me.NoDirecteur_DM, True)
If Me.SourceCommissions = "E" Then ' Équipe Set Me.nd_Comm_RP = xSIRR_xndComm_Equi(Me.NoEquipe, "1", "", p_Pays, p_Province)
If Me.NoDirecteur_DR <> "" Then Set Me.nd_Comm_DR = xSIRR_xndComm_Equi(Me.NoEquipe, "0", "R", p_Pays, p_Province) End If If Me.NoDirecteur_DN <> "" Then Set Me.nd_Comm_DN = xSIRR_xndComm_Equi(Me.NoEquipe, "0", "N", p_Pays, p_Province) End If If Me.NoDirecteur_DM <> "" Then Set Me.nd_Comm_DM = xSIRR_xndComm_Equi(Me.NoEquipe, "0", "M", p_Pays, p_Province) End If Else ' Représentant, Profil Set Me.nd_Comm_RP = xSIRR_xndComm_Repr(Me.NoRepresentantComm, "1", "", p_Pays, p_Province)
If Me.NoDirecteur_DR <> "" Then Set Me.nd_Comm_DR = xSIRR_xndComm_Repr(Me.NoRepresentantComm, "0", "R", p_Pays, p_Province) End If If Me.NoDirecteur_DN <> "" Then Set Me.nd_Comm_DN = xSIRR_xndComm_Repr(Me.NoRepresentantComm, "0", "N", p_Pays, p_Province) End If If Me.NoDirecteur_DM <> "" Then Set Me.nd_Comm_DM = xSIRR_xndComm_Repr(Me.NoRepresentantComm, "0", "M", p_Pays, p_Province) End If End If
Me.Commissions_RP = xVar(Me.nd_Comm_RP, "Comm_CodeCommissionsAH", "")
If Me.NoDirecteur_DR <> "" Then Me.Commissions_DR = xVar(Me.nd_Comm_DR, "Comm_CodeCommissionsAH", "") End If If Me.NoDirecteur_DN <> "" Then Me.Commissions_DN = xVar(Me.nd_Comm_DN, "Comm_CodeCommissionsAH", "") End If If Me.NoDirecteur_DM <> "" Then Me.Commissions_DM = xVar(Me.nd_Comm_DM, "Comm_CodeCommissionsAH", "") End If
Me.Resultat = 1 Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIRR, gc_Element_SIRR, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub End Class

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Function SIRR_Initialisations As Boolean SIRR_Initialisations = False
If gns_SIRR Is Nothing Then Set gns_SIRR = New Notessession Set gndb_SIRR = gns_SIRR.Currentdatabase
Set gnuiws_SIRR = New Notesuiworkspace
' Extraire la base de documents SI Projets ' ------------------------------------------------------- Set gndb_SIRR_SIRR = xGDK_xndbNDB(gc_NomBaseSIPj) If gndb_SIRR_SIRR Is Nothing Then ' 48 - La base de documents & est introuvable. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 48, "", gc_NomBaseSIPj), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function Elseif Not gndb_SIRR_SIRR.IsOpen Then ' 48 - La base de documents & est introuvable. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 48, "", gc_NomBaseSIPj), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If End If
SIRR_Initialisations = True End Function

'+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Function SIRR_ndSelectionnerRepresentant(p_Departement As String, p_TypePersone As String) As Notesdocument %REM ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Paramètres: p_ClientNoFmt String. Le numéro de client duquel il faut sélectionner un projet. Valeur retournée: Notesdocument. Le projet sélectionné. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ %ENDREM On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv As NotesView
Set SIRR_ndSelectionnerRepresentant = Nothing
' Initialisations If Not SIRR_Initialisations Then Exit Function End If If p_TypePersone = "0" Then ' Directeur If gnv_Repr18_SIRR Is Nothing Then Set gnv_Repr18_SIRR = gndb_SIRR_SIRR.Getview("V_Repr18") End If Set nv = gnv_Repr18_SIRR Else If gnv_Repr15_SIRR Is Nothing Then Set gnv_Repr15_SIRR = gndb_SIRR_SIRR.Getview("V_Repr15") End If Set nv = gnv_Repr15_SIRR End If Call nv.Refresh
' Sélectionner d'un représentant ' -------------------------------------- Set SIRR_ndSelectionnerRepresentant = SISe_ndPickList(nv, "Sélection d'un représentant", p_Departement) Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIRR, gc_Element_SIRR, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
